Role Title: Mechanical Engineering Technician

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Remote

micro1 is engaging Mechanical Engineering Technicians to contribute to a customer's project involving the development of advanced AI benchmarks. Scope of Work

  1. Design and author authentic technician workflow tasks that reflect real-world challenges, including test setup, instrumentation, data collection, and failure diagnosis.

  6. Ensure all evaluation tasks meet the complexity and realism standards representative of professional practice, surpassing simplified textbook examples.

Preferred Qualifications

  1. Minimum 4 years of hands-on experience in lab, test, or production environments within mechanical engineering technology.
  2. Associate degree or recognized trade credential in mechanical engineering technology or related discipline.
  3. Extensive experience with instrumentation, sensors, data acquisition systems, and prototype testing workflows.
  4. Demonstrated ability to perform in-depth technical documentation of test procedures, outcomes, and failure modes.
  5. Strong analytical skills for interpreting complex datasets and diagnosing equipment or process failures.
  6. Familiarity with technical documentation formats, such as CSVs, spreadsheets, PDFs, and other relevant files.
  7. Comfort working independently, contributing to remote projects, and aligning deliverables with high technical standards.

Compensation Structure

Compensation is output-based; experts are paid per task that meets the project specifications. The time required to complete work may vary depending on the expert’s experience and workflow. Minimum submission requirements apply. Experts must submit a minimum of tasks per week.

Start Timeline & Availability

We typically fill roles within 48 hours and are looking for experts ready to jump in right away. If selected, we expect you to start your first tasks within 24–48 hours of completing onboarding.

jobs.title: Pricing Manager
jobs.excerpt: GHX is seeking a strategic, systems-oriented Product Commercialization Manager to own and elevate the end-to-end commercialization process across our portfolio, including pricing, SKUs, process and tool management.
jobs.description:
GHX is seeking a strategic, systems-oriented Product Commercialization Manager to own and elevate the end-to-end commercialization process across our portfolio, including pricing, SKUs, process and tool management. The role serves as the connective tissue between commercial strategy and operational execution — driving efficiency, scalability, and data integrity across the entire product commercialization lifecycle.

The right candidate brings both operational rigor and transformational vision — someone who can rationalize a complex SKU library, redesign product commercialization operating system using AI-powered automation, and build governance frameworks that enable faster, more precise market entry.Someone who is enthusiastic about managing projects but also willing to roll up their sleeves and do the work. A personable, determined individual who enjoys leading and facilitating cross-functional collaborations will thrive in this role.

Responsibilities:

Commercialization Process Ownership

  • Own the end-to-end commercialization process — from product definition through SKU creation to Launch— in partnership with Product Management, Corporate Systems, Deals Desk, Contract Ops, Order Processing, Revenue Recognition, and Asset Management.
  • Establish and continuously improve SOPs, tooling configurations, and business rules that reduce cycle time, eliminate ambiguity, and scale across GHX's expanding portfolio; maintain the commercialization playbook as the single source of truth for pricing, SKUs, and business rules.
  • Partner with Product Management to translate new offerings into sellable, billable constructs aligned to commercial strategy; serve as cross-functional liaison for complex SKUs and pricing decisions requiring commercial judgment.
  • Define, monitor, and report on SLAs, KPIs, and quality metrics for commercialization activities, delivering executive-ready insights on a regular cadence.
  • Stay current on AI and ML capabilities in CPQ; proactively surface forward-looking recommendations to leadership and cross-functional partners.

SKU Management & Catalog Governance

  • Own the full SKU lifecycle in CPQ (currently Conga) — including creation, testing, release, modification, and deprecation.
  • Lead a structured cross-functional SKU audit; rationalize the catalog and present findings and recommendations to leadership; establish ongoing governance including intake/approval workflows, naming conventions, taxonomy standards, and hygiene reviews.
  • Partner with Product, Finance, and Sales to ensure every SKU maps to a clear commercial purpose, pricing strategy, contractual language, and business rules; develop a change management process that minimizes disruption to active quotes, in-flight contracts, and renewal cycles.
  • Own the AI and automation innovation roadmap for SKU and commercialization processes — identifying high-value opportunities and driving measurable reduction in manual processing time.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Strategy

  • Serve as the connective tissue between Product Management and all partner functions, including Sales, Revenue Operations, Deal Desk, Contract Operations, FP&A, Corporate Systems, and Revenue Enablement — aligning teams on process, tooling, and commercialization standards.
  • Contribute to pricing strategy and monetization model design; champion data-driven decision-making through dashboards and reporting frameworks that give leadership visibility into commercialization health.
  • Coordinate launch readiness for new products and pricing changes, ensuring Sales, Deal Desk, and Contract Operations are prepared before market release; act as a trusted advisor and go-to resource for commercialization process questions.

Key Competencies:

  • Translates business objectives into commercialization strategies; anticipates downstream impacts of process, pricing, and catalog decisions on revenue recognition, margin, and customer lifetime value.
  • Understands SaaS business models, subscription economics, and ARR/MRR dynamics; connects P&L awareness and process efficiency to growth acceleration.
  • Designs scalable, end-to-end commercialization processes with an automation-first, exception-second bias — comfortable operating from architecture-level design down to hands-on configuration and SOP documentation.
  • Uses quantitative analysis and operational data to identify problems, size opportunities, and evaluate trade-offs; designs reporting frameworks and dashboards that give leadership actionable visibility into commercialization health.
  • Sets clear goals, tracks progress rigorously, and communicates status proactively to executive, commercial, and technical audiences alike.
  • Builds trust across Product, Sales, Finance, Legal, and Technology without direct authority; navigates competing priorities with diplomacy and persistence.
  • Anticipates resistance to change and designs enablement strategies that drive adoption; delivers results with speed and quality in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.
  • Actively explores and applies AI and automation to commercialization challenges; evaluates tools critically with attention to limitations, compliance implications, and auditability.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, Finance, Operations, Information Systems, or a related field; or equivalent professional experience.
  • 5+ years of progressive experience in product operations, revenue operations, deal desk, commercial program management, or a closely related function within a B2B SaaS company.
  • Demonstrated hands-on experience with Salesforce Conga (Apttus) — including product catalog management, pricing rules, approval workflows, and SKU configuration.
  • Proven track record leading cross-functional process improvement or transformation initiatives with measurable business outcomes (e.g., cycle time reduction, error rate improvement, revenue acceleration)
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to produce executive-ready documentation, SOPs, and business cases.

  • Project management discipline: ability to manage multiple concurrent workstreams, prioritize effectively under pressure, and deliver against commitments.

  • Willingness to travel quarterly for team meetings (approximately 10-20%).

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Familiarity with AI and automation concepts as they apply to commercial operations, quoting, or contract workflows.
  • Experience conducting SKU, product catalog, or similar rationalization audits in complex, multi-product environments.
  • Prior involvement in a quote-to-cash re-platforming or major system migration.
  • Proficiency with BI and analytics tools such as Sigma or Power BI for building commercialization performance dashboards.
  • Any of the following certifications:
    • Salesforce Certified CPQ Specialist or Salesforce Certified Administrator
    • Conga CPQ Product Administration Certification (Level 1 or Level 2)
    • PMP, Agile/Scrum, or SAFe® Product Owner / Product Manager certification

Estimated salary range: $91,000 - $121,000

The base salary range represents the anticipated low and high end of the GHX’s salary range for this position. Actual salaries will vary and will be based on various factors, such as candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies and proficiency for the role. The base salary is one component of GHX’s total compensation package for employees. Other rewards and benefits include: health, vision, and dental insurance, accident and life insurance, 401k matching, paid-time off, and education reimbursement, to name a few. To view more details of our benefits, visit us here:

Global Healthcare Exchange (GHX) enables better patient care and billions in savings for the healthcare community by maximizing automation, efficiency and accuracy of business processes.

GHX is a healthcare business and data automation company, empowering healthcare organizations to enable better patient care and maximize industry savings using our world class cloud-based supply chain technology exchange platform, solutions, analytics and services. We bring together healthcare providers and manufacturers and distributors in North America and Europe - who rely on smart, secure healthcare-focused technology and comprehensive data to automate their business processes and make more informed decisions.

It is our passion and vision for a more operationally efficient healthcare supply chain, helping organizations reduce - not shift - the cost of doing business, paving the way to delivering patient care more effectively. About this position:

We're looking for a Paid Social Media Specialist to drive measurable impact for Later Influence customers through high performance paid social campaigns. You'll manage campaigns end to end, planning, launching, optimizing, and reporting across key social platforms, to ensure they deliver against client objectives and business KPIs. This role sits within Later's Professional Services team and reports directly to the Director of Services, with close day to day collaboration across Account Managers, Coordinators, and creative teams. We're looking for someone with deep paid social expertise, direct agency or client services experience, and a strong ability to collaborate cross-functionally.

What you'll be doing:

Technical / Execution

  • Plan, launch, and manage paid social influencer and brand campaigns across Meta, TikTok, LinkedIn, YouTube, Snapchat, and emerging social platforms.
  • Own campaign QA, tracking setup (UTMs, pixels, conversion events), and media delivery standards.
  • Monitor performance and pacing continuously, making proactive adjustments to hit KPIs.
  • Translate campaign data into actionable insights and optimizations that improve efficiency and outcomes.
  • Build, deliver, and present reports (weekly, monthly, quarterly) that combine analysis with clear strategic recommendations.

Team / Collaboration

  • Partner closely with Account Managers and Coordinators to align on messaging, creative, CTAs, and campaign objectives.
  • Provide proactive guidance on paid content best practices and help educate internal teams on what drives performance.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with creative, analytics, and client success teams to ensure campaigns meet client expectations and business goals.

Research / Best Practices

  • Stay sharp on evolving platform algorithms, bidding strategies, and performance content trends.
  • Experiment with new ad formats, targeting tactics, and creator led paid media approaches.
  • Share learnings with the wider team to uplevel collective expertise and campaign outcomes.

What success looks like:

  • Campaigns consistently deliver against client KPIs (CTR, CPA, ROAS, engagement rates, or brand lift, depending on objectives).
  • Data and insights are presented clearly, driving strategic decisions and client trust.
  • You anticipate risks and opportunities, proactively adjusting tactics to ensure campaign success.
  • Internal stakeholders see you as a trusted expert in paid social, someone who raises the bar for execution and client results.
  • You bring resourcefulness to ambiguity, thrive on data driven problem solving, and collaborate to deliver measurable business impact for clients.

What you bring:

We are committed to building an inclusive, supportive place for you to do the best and most rewarding work of your career. If you identify with any of the following, we encourage you to apply!

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
  • 2-3+ years of hands-on experience managing paid media campaigns, with a focus on social platforms.
  • Proven track record of hitting and exceeding performance goals in a paid social role, ideally within an agency or fast paced client services environment.
  • Strong analytical mindset, with a solid grasp of campaign performance metrics and reporting tools (Meta/TikTok/Google Ads reporting, Google Analytics, Tableau, Looker Studio, etc.) and the ability to turn data into clear, actionable recommendations.
  • Expertise with campaign management platforms (Meta Ads Manager, TikTok Ads Manager, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, Pinterest Ads, etc.).

jobs.description:
Accounts Receivable Specialist

Reports To: Lead Revenue Cycle
Locations Hiring From: Arizona, Delaware, Florida, Georgia, Idaho, Indiana, Louisiana, Minnesota, Missouri, New Hampshire, North Carolina, Pennsylvania, South Carolina, Tennessee, Texas, Vermont, Virginia ONLY.Must currently reside and plan on residing in the entire employment.
Schedule: Monday- Friday 9-6pm EST
Employment Type: Full-Time

Role Overview

As an Account Receivable Specialist, you will be responsible for managing insurance accounts receivable and ensuring accurate, timely posting and reconciliation of payments. This role focuses on maximizing reimbursement through proactive claim follow-up, denial resolution, payment investigation, and cash reconciliation. You will work closely with our Revenue Cycle leads, other members of the Revenue Cycle team, finance, and clinical teams to resolve payment discrepancies, improve AR performance, and maintain accurate financial records. This role also supports reporting and identifies trends to improve revenue cycle processes and overall financial performance. Your attention to detail, excellent organizational skills, and commitment to customer access will contribute to the financial stability and success of Oshi as we pioneer the way in GI care.

What You'll Do: Key Responsibilities

  • Manage assigned insurance accounts receivable to ensure timely reimbursement and reduce aging balances.
  • Follow up with insurance payers on outstanding claims, underpayments, denials, and payment discrepancies.
  • Investigate and resolve claim denials by submitting corrected claims, appeals, reconsiderations, and supporting documentation in accordance with payer requirements.
  • Review claim edits and rejections to ensure accurate resubmission and minimize future denials.
  • Accurately post insurance payments, adjustments, and remittances into the billing system.
  • Perform daily payment reconciliation by ensuring posted payments align with electronic remittance advice (ERA), explanation of benefits (EOB), bank deposits, and payment reports.
  • Research and resolve unapplied cash, payment variances, overpayments, and underpayments.
  • Reconcile payer payments against contracted reimbursement rates and escalate payment discrepancies as appropriate.
  • Maintain accurate documentation of AR activities, payer communications, payment research, and resolution outcomes.
  • Respond professionally and empathetically to patient inquiries regarding insurance claims, billing statements, payment activity, balances, and Oshi's billing model, policies, procedures, and applicable healthcare regulations.
  • Maintain open communication with providers, payers, and internal stakeholders to investigate, resolve, and prevent claim and payment issues.
  • Collaborate with Eligibility & Benefits, Credentialing, Finance, Clinical Operations, and other cross-functional teams to resolve reimbursement issues and improve revenue cycle performance.
  • Analyze accounts receivable, payment, and denial data to identify trends, root causes, and opportunities for process improvement.
  • Monitor and report on AR performance, payment posting accuracy, denial trends, aging, and other key revenue cycle metrics, providing insights and recommendations to leadership.
  • Support month-end close activities, payment balancing, reporting, and audit requests.
  • Identify recurring reimbursement or operational issues and recommend process improvements to improve payment accuracy, accelerate cash collections, and reduce denials.
  • Ensure compliance with organizational policies, payer requirements, financial regulations, HIPAA, and healthcare billing standards while maintaining accuracy and integrity in all revenue cycle activities.

What We're Looking For: Qualifications & Requirements

Required

  • Bachelor's Degree in Business Administration or relevant course work.
  • 2+ years of healthcare revenue cycle experience with a focus on accounts receivable, payment posting, or insurance billing.
  • Knowledge of medical billing, insurance claims processing, and payer reimbursement.
  • Experience resolving claim denials, underpayments, and payment discrepancies.
  • Experience posting payments and reconciling ERAs, EOBs, deposits, and unapplied cash.
  • Experience working successfully in a remote work environment with the ability to manage priorities independently.
  • Proficiency with EMR and medical billing systems.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills with excellent attention to detail.
  • Excellent communication and customer service skills.
  • Proficiency with Google Workspace (Sheets, Docs, Gmail) and the ability to quickly learn new systems and technology.

Preferred

  • Experience in a startup or high-growth healthcare organization.
  • Experience in telehealth or virtual care.
  • Experience with payer contract reimbursement analysis and payment variance investigations.
  • Familiarity with payer portals, clearinghouses, EFT/ERA processing, and payment reconciliation.
  • Experience tracking and reporting revenue cycle metrics (e.g., AR aging, denials, net collection rate).
  • Experience with Athenahealth, Apero, Salesforce, or similar healthcare platforms.
  • CRCR, CPB, CPC, or other healthcare revenue cycle certification.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Salary Range: 47,000-52,000 per year plus bonus eligibility
  • Health Benefits: Employer-sponsored medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Time Off: Unlimited PTO + 11 paid company holidays
  • Retirement: Eligibility to contribute to 401(k)
  • Work Style: Remote-first — work from home within our approved states
  • Growth: Tailored professional development opportunities as we scale
  • Life Concierge: Access to Overalls, because we know life happens

About Oshi Health

Oshi Health is a virtual digestive health practice on a mission to transform GI care. We combine compassionate, multidisciplinary care with innovative technology to help people with chronic digestive conditions get the answers and relief they deserve. When you join Oshi, you're joining a team and a mission that's changing what great healthcare looks like. Oshi Health is revolutionizing GI care with a digital clinic model that provides easy, convenient access to an integrated and multidisciplinary care team that takes a whole-person approach to diagnosing, managing, and treating digestive health conditions. We take time to get to know each patient, develop a personalized, whole-person care plan that includes identification of symptom triggers and prescription of evidence-based interventions, including medications, dietary changes, and mental health support.

For Every Oshi Team Member We Want:

  • Genuine passion for improving patient lives and transforming GI care
  • Strong communication skills and emotional intelligence
  • Comfort in a fast-paced, remote-first, mission-driven environment
Compensation Range

jobs.description:
We're so happy you're here! Thank you for checking our job out and we hope to have the chance to meet you in our interview process!

About the role

We're hiring a Senior Retail Operations Specialist to run the daily engine behind Grüns retail fulfillment. You'll ensure every order ships accurately, on time, and in full - protecting revenue, keeping retail partners happy, and catching problems before they become costly. This role connects internal ops, 3PLs, and retail accounts, and owns the proactive inventory and OTIF work that keeps our retail business scaling cleanly. This role reports to our Director of Retail Operations.

This role is part of our remote HQ! We have a fully remote, high-trust work environment - and also come together on a biannual basis for amazing off-sites where we can connect IRL.

In this role, you will:

  • Own day-to-day retail order fulfillment, monitoring and resolving "where's my product" issues before they turn into late or incomplete shipments.
  • Proactively manage base inventory to get ahead of shortages - flagging risk before orders are shorted, not after.
  • Process new orders accurately and on schedule to keep product flowing without disruption.
  • Run proactive inventory reviews for promotions and new item launches to ensure plans execute cleanly.
  • Track OTIF performance, chargebacks, and late trucks, and drive the process improvements that move those numbers.
  • Manage 3PL and logistics partner relationships, resolving escalations and holding partners to SLA.
  • Build and document SOPs across retail ops - receiving, lot/expiry management, promotions, and returns - so the function scales with the business.
  • Identify tools (including AI) and workflow changes that make the role and the broader retail ops function more efficient.

We're looking for someone who:

  • Has 3+ years of experience in retail operations, order fulfillment, or replenishment in a CPG environment, with a genuinely analytical approach to the work.
  • Has direct experience with Walmart and Club channel (Sam's Club, Costco), and ideally distributors like UNFI or KeHE.
  • Understands EDI order management, lot codes, and expiration handling in a retail fulfillment context.
  • Is fluent in Excel or Google Sheets - pivot tables, VLOOKUPs, basic modeling - and comfortable with ERP/WMS systems (Fulfil.io a strong plus).
  • Communicates clearly and confidently with both internal teams and external retail/logistics partners.
  • Is comfortable using AI tools like Claude to move faster and think more clearly, not just check a box.
  • Has a track record of finding and fixing inefficiency, not just maintaining what exists.

Approach to the role:

  • Proactive - flags problems before they become fires, not after.
  • Organized under pressure - manages competing priorities without dropping the important ones.
  • Independent - doesn't need to be managed to stay ahead of the work.
  • Data-driven - makes the call based on facts, not assumptions.
  • Curious and iterative - always looking for a cleaner, faster way to do it.

Compensation & Benefits:

At Grüns, we're committed to providing a competitive total compensation package — grounded in market data that considers our size, stage, industry, and location. For this role, the base salary range is $90,000 - $100,000 plus bonus depending on experience, paired with a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the well-being and growth of our team.

A bit about us...

At Grüns, we believe that foundational nutrition should be simple and convenient for everyone. We're dedicated to bringing comprehensive and real nutrition to you through our gummies, formulated from 60 nutrient-dense and whole-food ingredients. Simply enjoy a grab-and-go snack pack of gummies daily whenever fits best in your schedule and wherever life takes you.

Like you, we were disappointed. There’s an infinite number of “nutrition” companies, all focused on what’s best for them — not what’s best for you. Hundreds of products to sell you on, low-quality ingredients, and small nutrient doses. We’ve seen it all.

So we decided it was time to fix it. No more choking on and popping pills like a pharmacy. No more clean-up and disgust from gross powders. And no more cobbling together handfuls to dozens of supplements. Grüns is comprehensive nutrition, made convenient and delicious.

What we care about...

Be the Best: We hold ourselves, our teams, and our partners to an incredibly high standard - and we raise the bar constantly. "We've never done this before" isn't an excuse here. It's an invitation.

Own It: We act like our name is on the door. That means taking complete ownership of outcomes, collaborating deeply, working through roadblocks - not around them - and never waiting for someone else to solve the problem. Great owners are great partners.

Drive Impact, Urgently: We measure impact, not effort. We work smart and hard, move fast, and use every tool at our disposal - including AI - to focus our energy where it matters most.

Compensation & Perks:

For every role, we aim to have highly competitive compensation and opportunity for impact and career growth.

Everyone at Grüns works hard, but we believe in wellness and balance too. We have super strong benefits coverage -- for you and your family, generous PTO, free Grüns subscriptions, and a few more perks centered around health and well-being that we can't wait to tell you about!

Mercor connects elite creative and technical talent with leading AI research labs. Headquartered in San Francisco, our investors include Benchmark, General Catalyst, Peter Thiel, Adam D'Angelo, Larry Summers, and Jack Dorsey.

Position: Experimental Scientist / Engineer – Superconductors
Type:Contract
Compensation:$84/hour
Location:Remote

Role Responsibilities

  • Contribute deep domain expertise across superconducting material synthesis, characterisation, experimental superconductivity, fabrication, and device physics to build high-quality training and evaluation data.
  • Review and evaluate AI-generated scientific reasoning related to superconducting materials and phenomena, identifying experimental or theoretical errors and improving technical accuracy.
  • Design and solve challenging, expert-level problems involving critical temperature (Tc), critical current density (Jc), critical magnetic fields, magnetic susceptibility, electrical transport, flux pinning, vortex behaviour, and structure–property relationships.
  • Analyse and reason about experimental results from techniques such as XRD, SEM/TEM, SQUID/VSM magnetometry, resistivity and magnetotransport measurements, spectroscopy, and cryogenic measurements.
  • Rate and rank model outputs against defined scientific criteria, providing clear written reasoning grounded in experimental superconductivity.
  • Structure technical knowledge — including synthesis procedures, processing parameters, phase and structural data, transport measurements, magnetic measurements, and device data — into well-organised, model-ready data.

Qualifications

Must-Have

  • Hands-on experimental experience with one or more classes of superconducting materials, including cuprate/high-temperature superconductors, iron-based superconductors, conventional superconductors, MgB₂, REBCO/YBCO systems, or emerging superconducting materials.
  • Experience with superconducting material synthesis or processing, such as solid-state synthesis, single-crystal growth, powder processing, thin-film deposition, or related techniques.
  • Strong experience characterising superconducting properties through electrical resistivity/transport, magnetotransport, magnetic susceptibility, SQUID/VSM magnetometry, critical current measurements, critical field measurements, or cryogenic experiments.
  • Strong understanding of superconducting phenomena, including Tc, Jc, critical magnetic fields, Meissner effect, flux pinning, vortex dynamics, and the relationship between material structure and superconducting performance.
  • An advanced degree (PhD/MS) or equivalent hands-on research experience in materials science, condensed matter physics, applied physics, chemistry, electrical engineering, or a closely related field.
  • Clear written English and the ability to explain complex experimental results and technical reasoning concisely.

Preferred

  • Experience with superconducting thin films, heterostructures, or device fabrication using techniques such as PLD, MBE/epitaxy, sputtering, lithography, etching, or clean-room micro/nanofabrication.
  • Experience with applied superconductors or superconducting devices, such as superconducting wires and tapes, coated conductors, Josephson junctions, SQUIDs, superconducting circuits, resonators, detectors, or superconducting quantum devices.

Technical Support Analyst

Remote-United States

Monday to Friday from 9 to 6 EST, 8-5 CST, and 7 to 4 MST

*Some weekend overtime may be required

The Technical Support Analyst (TSA) is a developmental level position within the Support organization primarily responsible for working with CSC Corptax® customers to help with inquiries related to the server and workstation installation and maintenance of Corptax products. The TSA develops a high-level knowledge of the Corptax products and couples that with technical knowledge of Microsoft enterprise systems and related information technologies to validate customer installations and triage customer questions.

The TSA’s primary role is to respond to all customer inquiries regardless of the inbound support channel: online case, phone, email, chat, etc. for questions of a technical nature. This role will occasionally require overtime, including weekends based on customer filing trends/needs. A rotating on-call will be required. Travel is not typically required for this position.

Some of the things you will be doing:

  • Provide technical case support (all channels) for all Corptax customers and other internal Corptax teams using the then-current tools available to the Support organization.
  • Understand customer needs and provide personalized support to assigned customers or other customers as requested based on areas of specialization/expertise and customer need.
  • Respond to and provide appropriate solutions to intermediate level customer inquiries while maintaining moderate case closure rates.
  • Collaborate with team members in a fast-paced environment.
  • Work under clearly defined guidelines, with moderate supervision, making sound decisions based on previous experience and confirming your conclusions with more senior level team members prior to execution.
  • Document all customer issues in the Corptax case tracking system and assign or document appropriate solutions to the customer issue.
  • Review knowledge base solutions within professional expertise to ensure overall quality of our resources and digital support capabilities.
  • Develop proficiency in all Corptax products from a technical perspective.
  • Perform release testing, as required, of customer scenarios both prior to and after a new Corptax product release. Testing is a shared responsibility, including triage of new product releases and identifying potential required software enhancements.
  • Assist on various projects as assigned.
  • Learn new technology and experiment with potential internal efficiency solutions.
  • Demonstrate consistent exemplary standards of ethical conduct.
  • Promote a culture of cooperation, collaboration, and connection within the support team, as well as globally with other CSC business units.

What technical skills, experience, and qualifications do you need?

  • Position requires 3-4 years of relevant software support experience, ideally in Microsoft systems such as Windows Server, IIS, SQL Server, and SharePoint.
  • Exposure to automation, packaging, and monitoring tools such as Ansible, PowerAutomate, SailPoint, Elastic, SSCM, Microsoft Intune, and API’s.
  • Bachelor’s degree in a technology field is preferred or relevant experience.
  • High standards of customer service and support, honesty, and integrity.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft products.
  • Ability to quickly learn Corptax technologies.
  • Ability to accurately and completely document case information into the Corptax case tracking software.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills.
  • Strong, positive attitude and work ethic desired.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team, possessing moderate conflict resolution and negotiation skills to provide positive customer experiences.
  • Strong communication skills – both written and verbal.
  • Strong interpersonal skills.
  • Self-motivated with a drive for continuous improvement.

*This role is not eligible for employment visa sponsorship (e.g., H‑1B, TN, E‑3) now or in the future.

jobs.description:
About the Role

Payroll isn't just numbers on a spreadsheet. It's the promise the company keeps to every employee, every pay cycle, no matter which state or territory they call home. As our Payroll Analyst, you'll be the technical and regulatory authority who makes sure that promise never breaks. You'll own end-to-end payroll settlement execution and tax compliance for a fully remote, all-states-and-territories workforce, and you'll be the connective tissue between Payroll and Accounting, making sure Finance leadership always has clear, trustworthy payroll reporting to work from.

This role is built on a clean separation of duties: you execute with precision after approval, and you guard compliance independently. That combination of executor and compliance guardian is what keeps our financial integrity and audit readiness rock solid.

What You'll Do

Settlement Execution 

  • Execute payroll settlement following the Senior Manager, Accounting's approval: bank upload, 401(k)/HSA remittances, post-payroll sign-off 
  • Process cancel/correct actions only under documented authorization from the Senior Manager, Accounting 
  • Prepare settlement summary reports for Finance leadership 

Tax Compliance 

  • Upload tax notifications to the HRIS as received to maintain compliance across state and local tax jurisdictions 
  • Analyze payroll tax variances and reconciliation items; escalate anomalies to the Senior Manager, Accounting 

Cross-Functional 

  • Serve as Finance's subject-matter expert on payroll tax and settlement questions from CX Partners and external auditors 
  • Maintain documentation supporting quarterly/annual compliance and settlement audits 
  • Provide technical guidance on payroll tax implications of new-state hiring, benefits changes, or comp structure updates 

What You Bring

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field; payroll certification (CPP or similar) strongly preferred 
  • 3–5+ years of experience in payroll settlement, payroll tax compliance, or multi-state payroll administration 
  • Deep knowledge of federal, state, and local payroll tax law for a remote, all-states/territories workforce 
  • Experience configuring tax and settlement modules within an HRIS platform (Paycom, Workday, ADP, UKG, or similar) 
  • Strong analytical and research skills to track and interpret evolving tax regulations 
  • Able to translate payroll and compliance details into clear, accessible updates for non-payroll audiences, including Finance leadership
  • High level of integrity and independence — this role executes settlement but does not approve its own work 

Why Join Us

At Nightingale, precision work like this ripples outward. Getting payroll right, on time, every time, is how we take care of the employees who take care of our students. If you love owning the details, protecting the integrity of a process, and being the person people trust to get compliance right, we'd love to talk.

At Nightingale Education Group, our Innovative Education model helps transform rural health landscapes through our blended-distance learning platform. Every person involved with Nightingale Education Group helps to change the lives of our learners, our communities, and ultimately the world by adding to the quality of healthcare. Die meisten Junior-Rollen im Customer Success geben dir ein Ticket-Postfach. Diese gibt dir Autohäuser von Mercedes-Benz bis Porsche. Du lernst den AlphaController von Grund auf und wirst zu der Person, die Händler anrufen, wenn ihr Verkaufsprozess klemmt.

Standort: Hamburg – nahezu 100 % Remote möglich (Wohnsitz in Deutschland erforderlich).

Über uns

Alpha Online entwickelt die Prozessmanagement-Software für den professionellen Gebrauchtwagenhandel in Deutschland. Unser Kernprodukt AlphaController steuert alle Arbeitsprozesse im Autohaus – von der Fahrzeugbewertung bis zum Verkauf. Zu unseren Kunden zählen Mercedes-Benz, BMW, Volkswagen, Porsche und Audi. Seit 2024 sind wir Teil von CarOnSale, dem KI-gestützten Betriebssystem für den B2B-Gebrauchtwagenhandel in Europa.

One Platform. One Profit Engine.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du betreust einen festen Kundenstamm aus Autohäusern und Autohausgruppen und bist ihre erste Ansprechperson für alles rund um den AlphaController
  • Du berätst Kunden bei der Gestaltung ihrer internen Prozesse, vom Fahrzeugankauf bis zum Verkauf
  • Du hältst Präsentationen und leitest Workshops für die Teams, die täglich mit der Software arbeiten
  • Du erkennst, wo Kunden das Produkt noch nicht ausschöpfen, und machst konkrete Vorschläge
  • Du steuerst Anforderungen und Fehlermeldungen aus dem Kundenkontakt als Tickets in Jira an die Entwicklung
  • Du dokumentierst deine Kundenfälle sauber in unseren Systemen

Du startest mit einer intensiven Einarbeitungsphase direkt bei der Geschäftsführung und lernst Produkt, Kunden und Markt von innen kennen. Danach entscheiden wir gemeinsam, ob dein Schwerpunkt im Customer Success oder im Kunden-Onboarding liegt.

Was du mitbringst

  • Deutsch auf C2-Niveau in Wort und Schrift
  • Interesse an komplexen Softwareprodukten und die Bereitschaft, dich tief einzuarbeiten
  • Lust auf direkten Kundenkontakt, am Telefon, im Video-Call und vor Ort im Autohaus
  • Strukturierte, analytische Arbeitsweise: du behältst mehrere Kunden parallel im Blick
  • IT-Affinität im Alltag: Webanwendungen, Microsoft 365 und Slack sind für dich Routine

Von Vorteil

  • Erste Berührungspunkte mit Kundenkontakt, ob aus Praktikum, Werkstudentenjob oder Ausbildung
  • Erfahrung aus dem Automobilhandel oder dem Autohaus-Alltag
  • KI-affine Arbeitsweise: du nutzt Tools wie Claude, ChatGPT oder Copilot aktiv im Arbeitsalltag
  • Erfahrung mit Jira, Salesforce oder vergleichbaren Tools

Was dich bei uns erwartet

  • Unbefristete Festanstellung mit attraktiver Vergütung
  • Nahezu 100 % Remote – Wohnsitz in Deutschland erforderlich
  • Flexibles Homeoffice
  • Ein Umfeld, in dem KI und Digitalisierung echte Rolle spielen – kein Lippenbekenntnis
  • Erfahrenes Team mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen
  • Mitarbeiter-Benefits

Bewirb dich jetzt – dein Lebenslauf reicht.

jobs.excerpt: Role Title: Military Writing SpecialistRole Type: ContractorLocation: Remote (US Only) micro1 is engaging Military Writing Specialists to support a unique project, leveraging expertise in military writing and reporting.
jobs.description:
Role Title: Military Writing Specialist

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Remote (US Only)

micro1 is engaging Military Writing Specialists to support a unique project, leveraging expertise in military writing and reporting. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters. Contributors will use their background in Department of War (Department of Defense) documentation to generate, review, and evaluate a wide range of reports, summaries, and status updates reflective of authentic military processes. Your input will help develop benchmarks and grading guidelines that will teach AI to understand and replicate effective, compliant government communication.

Scope of Work

  1. Create realistic military and federal status reports, summaries, and executive updates based on prompts and supplied artifacts.
  2. Develop “golden responses” that demonstrate high-quality, standards-aligned reporting for use in AI model training.
  3. Draft grading rubrics and guidelines that reflect best practices in federal and military writing assessment.
  4. Evaluate AI-generated reports, providing detailed feedback in both written and verbal form.
  5. Share context on stylistic differences and individual approaches to common military documents (e.g., WARs, SITREPs, AARs, executive summaries).
  6. Produce supporting documents such as decision briefs, memoranda, and action officer updates when required.
  7. Collaborate with other subject matter experts to ensure diversity of reporting styles and adherence to branch-specific terminology.

Preferred Qualifications

  1. Former U.S. Department of War (Department of Defense) professional with at least 3 years of relevant experience.
  2. Experience producing templated and standard reports such as Weekly Activity Reports (WARs), Situation Reports (SITREPs), After-Action Reviews, or similar artifacts.
  3. Expertise spanning two or more branches of the U.S. military is a plus; a diverse background across roles is highly valued.
  4. Proven proficiency in written and verbal communication, particularly in conveying technical or operational subject matter.
  5. Demonstrated ability to craft, grade, and review back office documents, PowerPoints, memos, and spreadsheets for military or federal purposes.
  6. US-based contributor with broad familiarity with federal documentation standards and compliance best practices.
  7. Comfortable collaborating remotely and sharing insights on nuanced, highly procedural reporting tasks.

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.


The Role

We are looking for a Senior Technical Recruiter (Global) to drive hiring across Engineering, Product, Data, AI, Infrastructure, and other technical functions globally.

This role combines hands-on recruitment execution with leadership responsibilities. You will be responsible for attracting top technical talent, partnering with senior stakeholders on hiring strategy, and helping build a high-performing Talent Acquisition function as the company continues to scale globally.

You will play a critical role in shaping BJAK’s technical workforce while mentoring junior recruiters and establishing best-in-class recruiting practices across the organization.

Technical Recruitment Leadership

  • Own the end-to-end recruitment process for technical positions across Engineering, Product, Data, AI, Machine Learning, Infrastructure, DevOps, Cybersecurity, QA, and related functions.

  • Act as a trusted talent advisor by providing market intelligence, talent mapping, compensation insights, and hiring recommendations.

  • Drive recruitment outcomes for complex, senior, niche, and business-critical technical positions globally.

  • Develop and execute innovative sourcing strategies to identify and engage top passive talent across competitive international markets.

Talent Pipeline & Market Intelligence

  • Build and maintain strong technical talent pipelines to support both immediate and future hiring needs.

  • Conduct talent mapping exercises across target companies, industries, and markets.

  • Stay current on technical hiring trends, market conditions, compensation benchmarks, and talent availability across key regions.

Team Development & Process Excellence

  • Mentor and support junior recruiters, helping improve sourcing capability, candidate assessment quality, and stakeholder management effectiveness.

  • Establish and continuously improve recruitment processes, sourcing methodologies, interview calibration standards, and hiring best practices.

  • Review recruitment performance, pipeline quality, and hiring outcomes to identify opportunities for improvement.

  • Contribute to the growth and development of the global Talent Acquisition team as the organization scales.

Recruitment Operations & Reporting

  • Maintain accurate ATS data, candidate records, and recruitment reporting.

  • Track key recruitment metrics including pipeline health, time-to-hire, source effectiveness, and hiring quality.

  • Ensure a positive, professional, and consistent candidate experience throughout the recruitment lifecycle.

  • Support compliance with local hiring regulations and recruitment best practices across multiple regions.


The Right Fit Has

  • 5-8 years of full-cycle recruitment experience, with significant exposure to technical hiring.

  • Proven track record recruiting for Software Engineering, Product Management, Data Science, AI/ML, Infrastructure, DevOps, Cybersecurity, or related technical functions.

  • Demonstrated success hiring senior and difficult-to-fill technical positions in competitive talent markets.

  • Strong sourcing expertise using LinkedIn Recruiter, talent mapping, networking, referrals, and other advanced sourcing techniques.

  • Experience managing multiple high-priority requisitions simultaneously while maintaining quality and speed.

  • Strong understanding of technical talent markets, technical role requirements, and engineering organizational structures.

  • Experience partnering with senior stakeholders and influencing hiring decisions through data, insights, and market expertise.

  • Experience mentoring, coaching, or guiding junior recruiters is highly preferred.

  • Familiarity with global hiring practices, compensation structures, and recruitment across multiple countries.

  • Strong proficiency with Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) and recruitment analytics.

  • Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and project management skills.

  • Experience in high-growth technology companies, startups, internet businesses, or fast-scaling organizations is strongly preferred.


What Success Looks Like

  • Consistently delivers high-quality technical hires across multiple functions and regions.

  • Builds strong, sustainable talent pipelines for critical technical roles.

  • Serves as a trusted hiring partner to technical leaders and executives.

  • Improves recruitment efficiency, hiring quality, and candidate experience.

  • Successfully develops junior recruiters and contributes to building a scalable Talent Acquisition function.

  • Comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment with evolving priorities, ambitious hiring goals, and a high degree of ownership.


Why Join BJAK

  • Above-market remuneration.

  • Fast-track career growth and leadership opportunities.

  • High ownership, autonomy, and direct impact on business growth.

  • Opportunity to build world-class technical teams globally.

Breathe for Change (B4C) is building the category of Human Intelligence in Education to address the crises of educator stress and burnout, student mental health, and AI disruption. Our accredited higher-education programs — anchored by our Master's of Education — equip educators with the human skills they and their students need most to thrive. We envision a world where school is about what truly matters: empowering students AND teachers to live purposeful, creative lives full of vitality, wholeness, and connection.

The role

You'll be a full-cycle inside sales professional guiding teachers through the decision to enroll in B4C's degree programs. Marketing fills your calendar with booked 1:1 phone calls — you run a consultative discovery conversation, help each educator reach an honest fit decision, and enroll the ones the program genuinely serves.

Know what you'd be selling: a Master's degree our graduates consistently describe as transformative — for their teaching, their wellbeing, and their lives. Every enrollment you close is a teacher who stays in the profession stronger than they came to it. Most sales jobs ask you to believe in the product as a professional courtesy; this one earns it.

Three things to know about how we work, because they tell you whether this seat is for you:

You'd be joining an awesome team

This is a small group of mission-driven professionals who genuinely like each other and are unusually good at what they do. We chase a team goal — the number belongs to all of us, not to a leaderboard of individuals — so the incentive is to make the person next to you better. Reps trade what's working in real time, review each other's calls in the film room, and celebrate each other's wins loudly. If you've worked somewhere the top closer hoarded their tricks and the floor went quiet when someone was behind, this will feel different on day one.

We take selling seriously as a craft

Our motion is documented and built from what our best people actually do, not from theory — most of our wins close on the first substantive conversation, carried by disciplined follow-up. Everything we've built around it — the playbook, the coaching, the AI tooling — exists to get you to full speed fast: weeks, not quarters. After that, the book is yours to run. There are no individual volume quotas and no commission — we make sure you have a strong, steady set of calls, flexing up and down a bit during the highest-demand weeks and months, but overall protecting your calendar against getting overloaded. We hire people who run their own week, and then we get out of the way.

We sell with integrity, structurally

Teachers are trust professionals and our buyers for life — pressure tactics, false urgency, and manufactured scarcity don't just violate our values, they're incompatible with how we're regulated and how we retain students. Honest disqualification is a celebrated outcome. The product is what makes this possible: our graduates rate the program at an NPS in the +70s, so the honest conversation and the effective one are the same conversation. If your best work happens when you're allowed to tell a prospect the truth, you'll like it here.

What you'll actually do

  • Run ~8–12 scheduled discovery calls a day* (20 minutes each) with teachers who booked time to talk about the M.Ed. — assess fit, run real discovery, answer program and financing questions, and ask for the enrollment decision when the signal is there. *Daily volume fluctuates with seasonality, events, and experience.

  • Own the follow-up between calls: short, purposeful texting that protects shows and carries momentum, completion calls that finish decisions, and the follow-through that means nothing you promised a teacher ever slips.

  • Sell when teachers can talk. During the school year our calls concentrate in two windows: teachers' planning/lunch periods (roughly noon–2pm ET) and after school (roughly 4–8pm ET); in summer the weight shifts earlier. Your core coverage window is approximately noon–8pm ET on weekdays — in Central or Mountain time that's an ordinary late-morning-to-early-evening day, which is why we prefer those zones. Our best reps design their week around the teacher's clock on purpose; this role requires that design to be genuine and sustainable, not overtime.

  • Hand each newly enrolled educator cleanly to our onboarding team. Your job is the decision — a dedicated team carries students from deposit to day one, so your selling time stays selling time.

  • Bring what you learn back to the team: film-room participation, script feedback, sharing what's working. Our playbook carries our reps' wording because their wording works.

Who we're looking for

  • A proven consultative closer. 2+ years in a full-cycle closing role — high-consideration B2C (education, financial services, insurance, home services, coaching/wellness programs) or similar consultative sales — with a track record you can quantify and explain how it was measured.

  • One-conversation instincts. You know how to earn a decision in the first call when the fit is real — discovery first, then a direct, unapologetic ask — and how to walk away warmly when it isn't.

  • Follow-through as craft. You can describe the actual system you use to keep 100+ open conversations from slipping. Organized is table stakes; we're looking for someone who treats follow-up as the job, not the interruption.

  • A fast, eager tool adopter. This role runs on systems — a CRM (HubSpot a plus), AI-assisted call review and coaching, texting and scheduling tools, Google Workspace — and the stack keeps getting better. You don't just tolerate new tools; you pick them up quickly, fold them into how you work, and treat them as part of the craft.

  • A calendar owner. You manage your own energy and hours like a professional athlete — boundaries, blocks, evening selling by design, recovery budgeted after surges.

  • A teammate on purpose. Our reps get better in public — film-room reviews, script feedback, lending your wording to the playbook when it works. You want colleagues who sharpen your game and you return the favor; closers who guard their tricks don't thrive here.

  • Mission-resonant. You care that the thing you're selling genuinely changes teachers' lives, and you can say why in your own words. Our best closers are here on purpose — selling work that matters is the point.

You do NOT need admissions, higher-ed, or education-industry experience. We'll teach you the domain, the program, and the playbook — that's what our onboarding and coaching system is for. What we can't teach in eight weeks is professional selling. If you're a great closer who has always wanted your work to mean something, this is the seat.

Growth

This role has a real career ladder: EDC → Senior EDC, with promotion earned on craft, ownership, team impact, and judgment — assessed from your actual work, not tenure. Our most recent Senior promotion went to a rep whose calls became the film-room examples the team learns from. We promote from within on purpose.

Why this seat

Sales careers rarely offer all three: a product with real outcomes, a team of mission-driven professionals who treat selling as a craft worth studying and pull for each other, and a mission you'd defend at dinner. Teachers are holding up the hardest job in America, and the ones who find us are looking for a way to grow without leaving the classroom. You'd be the person who helps them decide well. If you've been waiting for a reason to bring your best selling somewhere it counts, this is it.

Compensation & benefits

  • Base salary: $80,000–$100,000, depending on experience and demonstrated track record

  • Equity eligibility (varies by experience)

  • Health, vision, and dental insurance

  • 401k and FSA/HSA eligibility

  • Unlimited PTO

  • Note: per our accreditation and Title IV compliance posture, compensation is never linked to enrollment counts — raises and promotions are earned on craft and professional factors. (Stated here because good salespeople always ask.)

How to apply

The application asks five short questions — they matter more than your résumé, and we read every answer.

Breathe for Change is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Compensation Range: $80K - $100K

jobs.title: Strategic Finance Analyst
jobs.excerpt: Strategic Finance Analyst | M-KOPA You've built three-statement models under deadline pressure for deals that closed, got filed, and were forgotten within a quarter.
jobs.description:
Strategic Finance Analyst | M-KOPA

You've built three-statement models under deadline pressure for deals that closed, got filed, and were forgotten within a quarter. What if the next model you build determined how a company gets 3 million more customers access to credit for the first time?

That's the actual trade-off on the table here.

M-KOPA has just crossed 7 million customers across Kenya, Nigeria, Ghana, Uganda, and South Africa, with more than $2 billion in credit unlocked. Of those customers, 55% are accessing formal financial services for the first time, and 86% report a real improvement in their quality of life. We're not a mature business optimising at the margins — we're building the financial infrastructure for the next stage of that growth, from 5 million customers to 7 million, and now toward 10 million.

Why this role exists right now

Every one of those growth milestones has to be modelled, stress-tested, and defended before it becomes a board decision. That's the job of the Strategic Finance team — we own the Long-Range Plan, the market entry business cases, and the analysis that sits behind what the CEO, COO, and board actually decide to do next. As the business scales into new markets and new products, that modelling work is only getting more complex, and more visible. We need someone whose technical rigour can anchor it.

What makes this different from a typical FP&A or banking analyst seat

Most modelling roles either sit inside a bank, building work that ends at deal close, or inside a corporate finance function, running templates someone else designed years ago. This one is neither. You'll be building models from a blank sheet — for market entry decisions, unit economics, distribution cost structures, and funding scenarios — and you'll be doing it in direct partnership with the Head of Strategic Finance, on workstreams that land in front of the CEO and the board within weeks, not quarters. You stay as technical as you were in banking. You just get to see what your numbers actually build.

What you'd own

The core of the role is the company's Long-Range Plan — base, stretch, and market-specific upside/downside scenarios, with the assumptions packs and documentation that leadership and the board rely on. Beyond that, you'll build audit-ready models for special projects as they come up: a new market entry case one month, a distribution cost model the next, a funding analysis after that. You'll be the person who catches the balance sheet or cash flow tie-out break before it reaches the CEO's desk, not after. And you'll support the monthly and quarterly FP&A cycle — budget-vs-actual variance, performance commentary, reporting packs — while helping migrate planning processes into Anaplan as the team scales its tooling across markets.

A good amount of this role is architecture before arithmetic: taking a half-specified problem and figuring out the right model structure before you touch a single formula.

What you'd bring

  • Demonstrable experience building complex, three-statement models from scratch under deadline pressure, ideally from an investment banking, transaction services, or similarly rigorous modelling background

  • A genuine fluency in how operational drivers flow through to financial statements — you don't just build the model, you understand why each line moves the way it does

  • Relentless attention to detail paired with the communication skill to defend your assumptions and explain your logic to someone who's never opened the model

It also helps — though isn't required — if you've worked with Anaplan or another planning platform, have exposure to fintech, lending, or consumer credit, or have worked across multi-currency, multi-entity African businesses.

The honest version

This role moves between workstreams — the Long-Range Plan one week, an ECL question the next, a market entry case after that — often with incomplete information and a deadline that doesn't move. You'll need to get productive on unfamiliar terrain fast, more than once. If that sounds exhausting rather than energising, this probably isn't your seat. If it sounds like exactly the kind of variety your current role doesn't give you, it might be.

Why it's worth the trade-off

You stay deeply technical. Your analysis directly shapes what a high-growth company does next, with executive visibility from day one, and a clear line into senior strategic finance leadership as the team and the business scale together.

If you're reading this and already thinking about how you'd structure the model — that's probably the signal. Let's talk.

Why M-KOPA?

At M-KOPA, we empower our people to own their careers through diverse development programs, coaching partnerships, and on-the-job training. We support individual journeys with family-friendly policies, prioritize well-being, and embrace flexibility.

Join us in shaping the future of M-KOPA as we grow together. Explore more at .

Recognized four times by the Financial Times as one Africa's fastest growing companies (2022, 2023, 2024, 2025 and 2026), named on CNBC's World’s Top Fintech Companies 2025 & 2026 and by TIME100 Most influential companies in the world 2023 and 2024 , we've served over 10 million customers, unlocking $2 billion in cumulative credit for the everyday earners across Africa, in addition to over 10,000 e-bikes financed in Kenya.

Important Notice

M-KOPA is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer committed to assembling a diverse, broadly trained staff. Women, minorities, and people with disabilities are strongly encouraged to apply.

M-KOPA explicitly prohibits the use of Forced or Child Labour and respects the rights of its employees to agree to terms and conditions of employment voluntarily, without coercion, and freely terminate their employment on appropriate notice. M-KOPA shall ensure that its Employees are of legal working age and shall comply with local laws for youth employment or student work, such as internships or apprenticeships.

M-KOPA does not collect/charge any money as a pre-employment or post-employment requirement. This means that we never ask for ‘recruitment fees’, ‘processing fees’, ‘interview fees’, or any other kind of money in exchange for offer letters or interviews at any time during the hiring process.

Applications for this position will be reviewed on a rolling basis. Shortlisting and interviews will take place at any stage during the recruitment process. We reserve the right to close the vacancy early if a suitable candidate is selected before the advertised closing date.

If your application is successful M-KOPA undertakes pre-employment background checks as part of its recruitment process, these include; criminal records, identification verification, academic qualifications, employment dates and employer references.

About the Company

At Torc, we have always believed that autonomous vehicle technology will transform how we travel, move freight, and do business.A leader in autonomous driving since 2007, Torc has spent over a decade commercializing our solutions with experienced partners. Now a part of the Daimler family, we are focused solely on developing software for automated trucks to transform how the world moves freight.  Join us and catapult your career with the company that helped pioneer autonomous technology, and the first AV software company with the vision to partner directly with a truck manufacturer. 

Meet the Team

The Auto Tagger team is the engine behind our data flywheel, responsible for translating petabytes of raw, multi-modal vehicle data into a highly curated library of critical driving scenarios. By mining driving logs for long-tail events, we provide the foundational data required for safe autonomous trucking. Leveraging Pegasus logical layers, this team structures and catalogs findings into an observations database that directly accelerates development across autonomous perception, sensor fusion, and generative simulation testing.

What You'll Do

  • Integrate and deploy automated event-tagger into production pipelines, running and monitoring tagging tasks at scale across petabytes of vehicle log data.
  • Build and maintain the data engineering pipelines that organize, structure, and catalog tagged scenario data into the observations database.
  • Own CI/CD for the Auto Tagger pipeline using GitHub Actions, keeping deployments reliable, tested, and repeatable.
  • Write production grade code in Python across the pipeline, from data ingestion and transformation through model integration and deployment.
  • Build and operate on Databricks for large scale data processing, interactive querying, and pipeline orchestration.
  • Design, deploy, and scale AWS infrastructure (as code) to support high-volume, distributed processing of vehicle log pipelines — working with structured/tagged outputs and metadata.
  • Instrument pipelines with logging, metrics, and alerting; own on-call response for tagging job failures and data quality regressions.
  • Partner with ML engineers on the team to take tagging and classification models from development into a scalable, monitored production pipeline.
  • Ensure data quality and metadata integrity as tagged events move from raw logs into the observations database used by perception, simulation, and systems teams.
  • Troubleshoot and improve pipeline performance, reliability, and cost as data volume and model complexity grow.

What You'll Need to Succeed

  • BS or MS in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, with 5+ years of software engineering experience, including production data pipeline or ML infrastructure work.
  • Strong Python skills, with experience building and maintaining production data or ML pipelines.
  • Hands-on CI/CD experience, GitHub Actions required.
  • Required experience with Databricks for large scale data processing and orchestration.
  • Required experience with AWS, including infrastructure-as-code (Terraform or CloudFormation) for provisioning distributed processing infrastructure.
  • Experience processing large scale time series or unstructured datasets.
  • Experience with observability tooling (e.g., Datadog, Grafana, CloudWatch) for production pipeline monitoring and alerting.
  • Experience integrating and deploying ML models into production systems — serving, monitoring, and rollback, not just training.
  • Strong communication skills to work across ML, perception, and simulation teams.

Bonus Points!

  • Familiarity with auto-labeling pipelines, VLMs, or zero-shot classification for scenario extraction.
  • Experience with distributed compute frameworks such as Ray, Spark, or Daft.
  • Familiarity with robotics data formats (ROS bags, MCAP) and columnar storage formats (Parquet, Arrow).
  • Experience with model serving frameworks such as vLLM or SGLang.
  • Familiarity with scenario description standards like Pegasus layers.

Perks of Being a Torc'r

Torc cares about our team members and we strive to provide benefits and resources to support their health, work/life balance, and future. Our culture is collaborative, energetic, and team focused. Torc offers:

  • A competitive compensation package that includes a bonus component and stock options
  • 100% paid medical, dental, and vision premiums for full-time employees
  • 401K plan with a 6% employer match
  • Flexibility in schedule and generous paid vacation (available immediately after start date)
  • Company-wide holiday office closures

We celebrate the uniqueness of our Torc'rs and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, veteran status, or disabilities. Even if you don't meet 100% of the qualifications listed for this opportunity, we encourage you to apply.

jobs.title: Staff Product Manager, Monetization
jobs.excerpt: About the TeamHubSpot’s Downmarket Product Org is responsible for overseeing our broader portfolio of freemium products - shaping the core product experience and powering every key moment in the customer lifecycle, from the first interaction through long term retention and expansion.
jobs.description:
About the Team

HubSpot’s Downmarket Product Org is responsible for overseeing our broader portfolio of freemium products - shaping the core product experience and powering every key moment in the customer lifecycle, from the first interaction through long term retention and expansion.

We are scaling our Monetization function within this team. The group will focus on one of the most important and interesting challenges in software today: determining how to help customers discover and purchase your product in the age of AI and Agents, for headless and UI-based use cases, and with credits as an emerging pricing model.

About the Role

The traditional PLG monetization model was built for a world of static, tier-based upgrades accessed through a point-and-click UI. We are moving toward agent-based, credit-priced products distributed across multiple surfaces - including APIs and LLM interfaces - and our buying strategy must evolve to match.

As a Staff Product Manager for Monetization and Product Led Growth, you will own the evolution of this buying experience. This will include two charters:

  • Being the single person who can oversee the entire end-to-end buying journey across various prospect and customer touchpoints
  • Rebuilding our monetization infrastructure from static upgrade prompts in HubSpot’s UI, to agentically delivered, just-in-time, contextual upgrade moments delivered both in-app and via LLM interfaces. We will define and build the capabilities to recommend and sell the right product to the right customer at the right time, agnostic of whether they are using HubSpot in our app or via MCP.

What You Will Do

  • You will own the buying, product discovery, and upgrade experience across HubSpot. You will be the single Product Manager accountable for how customers move from our freemium funnel to the solutions that best meet their needs.
  • You will define HubSpot’s Product Led Monetization strategy for the AI era. This includes evolving from static upgrade triggers to personalized, context aware upgrade moments powered by large language models and delivered through conversational assistants and MCP. You will help define what an upgrade moment looks like and means when users don’t have a traditional UI to interact with and monetization becomes more usage-based.
  • You will partner with product teams across HubSpot to align buying patterns and create a coherent, consistent customer experience across the platform.
  • You will work closely with go to market teams on pricing launches, upgrade campaigns, and customer communication strategies related to driving monetization.
  • You will present strategies, progress, and results to senior leaders, including members of the executive team.

What We Are Looking For

  • You have owned monetization or the buying experience for a software as a service product. This is a core area of expertise for you.
  • You have worked on a product with credit based, usage based, or outcome based pricing. You understand how these models affect both how a product is built and how it is sold.
  • You have driven alignment across multiple product groups without relying on direct authority. You know how to influence decisions, build commitment, and move teams toward a shared outcome.
  • You have meaningful AI product experience. You have worked on or alongside products built around artificial intelligence, and you understand how large language models are changing product strategy, customer expectations, and business models.
  • You bring strong business model fluency. You can think strategically about pricing, packaging, monetization, and go to market motions, not only feature roadmaps.
  • You have worked in both a scaled organization and a more entrepreneurial environment. You can navigate the complexity of a large company while remaining comfortable building something new from the ground up.
  • You are a driver who moves quickly and takes ownership. You are comfortable challenging existing approaches when needed, and you do not wait for perfect information before making progress.

Why This Role Matters

The entire software industry is working to determine how AI products should be priced, packaged, and sold.

HubSpot has more than 250,000 customers, an active credit based monetization system, strong Agents and usage through MCPs. In this role, you will be at the center of translating those strengths into the next generation of Product Led Growth, not as a theoretical exercise, but through products and experiences used by real customers.

This is a Staff level opportunity with meaningful greenfield scope, direct visibility with executive leadership, and the chance to define what Product Led Growth looks like at one of the most recognized brands in software as a service.

Pay & Benefits

The cash compensation below includes base salary, on-target commission for employees in eligible roles, and annual bonus targets under HubSpot’s bonus plan for eligible roles. In addition to cash compensation, some roles are eligible to participate in HubSpot’s equity plan to receive restricted stock units (RSUs). Some roles may also be eligible for overtime pay. Individual compensation packages are tailored to your skills, experience, qualifications, and other job-related reasons.

This resource will help guide how we recommend thinking about the range you see. Learn more about HubSpot’s compensation philosophy.

Benefits are also an important piece of your total compensation package. Explore the benefits and perks HubSpot offers to help employees grow better.

At HubSpot, fair compensation practices aren’t just about checking off the box for legal compliance. It’s about living out our value of transparency with our employees, candidates, and community.

Annual Cash Compensation Range:
$205,500—$328,800 USD

We know theconfidence gap and impostor syndrome can get in the way of meeting spectacular candidates, so please don’t hesitate to apply — we’d love to hear from you.

If you need accommodations or assistance due to a disability, please reach out to us using this form.

At HubSpot, we value both flexibility and connection. Whether you’re a Remote employee or work from the Office, we want you to start your journey here by building strong connections with your team and peers. If you are joining our Engineering team, you will be required to attend a regional HubSpot office for in-person onboarding. If you join our broader Product team, you’ll also attend other in-person events, such as your Product Group Summit and other gatherings, to continue building on those connections.

About HubSpot

HubSpot (NYSE: HUBS) is an AI-powered customer platform with all the software, integrations, and resources customers need to connect marketing, sales, and service. HubSpot's connected platform enables businesses to grow faster by focusing on what matters most: customers.

At HubSpot, bold is our baseline. Our employees around the globe move fast, stay customer-obsessed, and win together. Our culture is grounded in four commitments: Solve for the Customer, Be Bold, Learn Fast, Align, Adapt & Go!, and Deliver with HEART. These commitments shape how we work, lead, and grow.

We’re building a company where people can do their best work. We focus on brilliant work, not badge swipes. By combining clarity, ownership, and trust, we create space for big thinking and meaningful progress. And we know that when our employees grow, our customers do too.

Recognized globally for our award-winning culture by Comparably, Glassdoor, Fortune, and more, HubSpot is headquartered in Cambridge, MA, with employees and offices around the world.
