jobs.description:
Quality Assurance Engineer (Manual + Automation | SaaS) – Remote

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours (flexibility for releases and sprints)

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Quality Assurance Engineer (QA Tester) to ensure software products are thoroughly tested, reliable, and production-ready before release.

This is a hands-on QA role combining manual testing, test automation, defect management, API testing, and close collaboration with engineering teams.

You’ll act as a critical quality gate throughout the software development lifecycle — identifying bugs, validating fixes, testing edge cases, and helping prevent issues from reaching production.

If you naturally look for what could break, think through edge cases, and care deeply about delivering reliable software, this role is a strong fit.

What You’ll Own

Test Planning & Coverage

  • Create and maintain:
    • Test plans
    • Test cases
    • Test scenarios
    • Acceptance criteria
  • Define appropriate test coverage across new features, integrations, and regression flows.
  • Review requirements and identify potential gaps or risks before development is completed.
  • Collaborate with Product and Engineering teams to ensure requirements are testable and clearly understood.

Manual Testing – Core Responsibility

  • Execute:
    • Functional testing
    • Regression testing
    • Integration testing
    • UI/UX validation
    • Cross-browser testing
    • Cross-device testing
  • Identify bugs, inconsistencies, and edge cases before release.
  • Log and manage defects using Jira, Azure DevOps, or similar platforms.
  • Provide developers with clear:
    • Reproduction steps
    • Expected vs. actual behavior
    • Screenshots or recordings
    • Environment details
  • Retest fixes and perform regression testing on impacted functionality.

Automation Testing

  • Build, maintain, and improve automated test scripts using tools such as:
    • Selenium
    • Cypress
    • Playwright
  • Automate repetitive and high-value regression scenarios.
  • Integrate automated tests into CI/CD workflows using:
    • GitHub Actions
    • Jenkins
    • GitLab CI
  • Investigate failed automated tests and distinguish product defects from test-script issues.

API & Performance Testing

  • Test APIs and backend functionality using Postman or similar tools.
  • Validate:
    • API responses
    • Status codes
    • Data integrity
    • Error handling
    • Integration behavior
  • Conduct performance, load, and stress testing using tools such as:
    • Apache JMeter
    • Locust
  • Support security and vulnerability testing where required.

Defect Tracking & Release Validation

  • Track bugs from discovery through resolution.
  • Prioritize issues based on severity, impact, and release risk.
  • Validate builds before production deployment.
  • Conduct regression and release-readiness testing.
  • Clearly communicate critical defects and potential release risks to stakeholders.

Documentation & Quality Reporting

  • Maintain organized documentation for:
    • Test plans
    • Test cases
    • Test results
    • Defects
    • Regression suites
  • Track quality metrics including:
    • Defect density
    • Test coverage
    • Pass/fail rates
    • Production defects
  • Provide stakeholders with clear visibility into product quality and release readiness.

Engineering Collaboration

  • Work closely with developers to reproduce and investigate defects.
  • Participate in:
    • Sprint planning
    • Daily standups
    • Retrospectives
    • Release discussions
  • Collaborate with Product and Engineering teams throughout the SDLC.
  • Advocate for quality without unnecessarily slowing down delivery.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

You’ll likely succeed in this role if you:

  • Naturally identify edge cases others overlook.
  • Write clear, structured, and repeatable test cases.
  • Are methodical without becoming a bottleneck.
  • Can clearly explain technical issues to developers.
  • Understand when automation adds value and when manual testing is more effective.
  • Take ownership of bugs through validation and resolution.
  • Care about the overall user experience, not simply whether a test passes.

Required Experience & Skills

  • 2+ years of professional QA or software testing experience.
  • Strong hands-on manual testing experience.
  • Experience with functional and regression testing.
  • Experience documenting and tracking defects using Jira or similar tools.
  • Familiarity with test management platforms such as:
    • TestRail
    • Zephyr
  • Familiarity with at least one automation framework:
    • Selenium
    • Cypress
    • Playwright
  • Strong understanding of:
    • Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC)
    • Agile development
    • QA methodologies
    • Defect lifecycle management
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Clear written and verbal English communication.

Nice to Have

  • Experience testing SaaS or enterprise software products.
  • Strong API testing experience using Postman or RestAssured.
  • Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Familiarity with performance testing using JMeter or Locust.
  • Exposure to security or vulnerability testing.
  • Experience working within compliance-heavy software environments.
  • Familiarity with Git and modern engineering workflows.

What a Typical Day Looks Like

Your day may start by reviewing new requirements and writing test cases for an upcoming feature. You’ll execute manual tests, run regression suites, investigate failed automated tests, and document any defects you uncover.

Throughout the day, you’ll work directly with developers to reproduce issues, validate fixes, test APIs or integrations, and assess whether builds are ready for release.

In short: you find and help resolve problems before customers encounter them.

Key Metrics for Success

  • High percentage of defects caught before production.
  • Strong regression test coverage.
  • Low number of critical production defects.
  • Fast and accurate defect validation.
  • Reliable automated test suites.
  • Clear and actionable bug documentation.
  • Efficient bug resolution turnaround.
  • Strong stakeholder confidence in release quality.

Why This Role Stands Out

  • Direct impact on software and release quality.
  • Hands-on exposure to both manual and automation testing.
  • Close collaboration with Product and Engineering teams.
  • Opportunity to improve QA processes and automation coverage.
  • Fully remote environment.
  • Career growth opportunities into:
    • Senior QA Engineer
    • QA Automation Engineer
    • Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET)
    • QA Lead
    • Quality Engineering Manager

Interview Process

  1. Initial Phone Screen
  2. Video Interview with Pavago Recruiter
  3. Practical QA Assessment
  4. Client/Technical Interview
  5. Offer & Background Verification

Apply Now

If you have hands-on QA experience, enjoy finding edge cases, and know how to combine manual testing with automation to deliver reliable software, we’d love to hear from you.

This is a strong opportunity to build your career in SaaS quality assurance, test automation, and software quality engineering.

Job Summary

The Global Study Manager II (GSM II) provides operational leadership throughout the study lifecycle, with accountability for oversight and execution of study management, site management, preferred Contract Research Organization (pCRO), and vendor deliverables for all study management deliverables in a study.

The Global Study Manager has exceptional knowledge within the organization for Study Management processes and deliverables. Additionally, the Global Study Manager will maintain expertise within their assigned Therapeutic Area and study in order to set the appropriate strategy, identify risks and to drive operational deliverables. The Global Study Manager will have good knowledge in understanding the responsibilities beyond their function in order to ensure goals are met for the study.

Key Accountabilities:

Study Management Oversight

  • Leads and coordinates the execution of a clinical trial globally from sourcing strategy and study specification development for requests for proposals to fully outsourced studies and ancillary vendors, study start up through database release and inspection readiness to ensure timely delivery of quality study data. May also provide input to and support compilation of sections to clinical study reports (CSRs) as needed

  • Provides quality oversight and coordination of regional and country operations and the pCRO for the tasks both owned by and delegated to Study Operational Managers (SOMs), if assigned to study, related to study execution

  • Provides leadership to the teams in setting recruitment targets and delivery milestones as the single point of accountability for detailed study start up, monitoring, and other study level plans and delivery to the agreed plans by partnering with cross functional colleagues

  • Serves as a critical member of the core team and represents the operational sub-team including applicable vendors and pCRO on matters of study execution

  • Drives decision making and works closely with the Clinical Study Team Lead (CSTL) to provide input to operational strategy

  • Provides supervision and/or mentorship to SOMs and possibly other GSMs

  • Ensures development of study level plans, including the study monitoring and study training plans

  • Develops, reviews, or approves the study startup, study monitoring, protocol recruitment, and training plans and other documents, guidelines, and plans. May delegate development of plans or components of plans to SOMs (if assigned) or to Clinical Study Team Assistants (CSTAs) as appropriate

  • Approves and oversees drug supply management, manages flow of drug supply to the sites, and sets up interactive randomization systems with supply chain lead

  • Ensures overall vendor oversight for vendors managed by SOMs (if assigned), action escalations related to vendor issues and escalate further as necessary

  • Reviews consolidated pre-trial assessment (PTA) reports and feasibility outputs in partnership with appropriate cross functional colleagues

  • Ensures applicable system closure at study completion

  • May support study level submission readiness

  • May participate in vendor user accountability testing (UAT) and system setup requirements review and approval [e.g., Interactive Response Technology (IRT), central lab]

Study Management Operations

  • Accountable for study management and oversight of all study management functions

  • Forms, oversees, and leads the operational sub team and requests resources as needed

  • Ensures the development of realistic detailed study startup and/or study management strategies and monitoring plans, including sourcing strategy, input into requests for proposals, and for the selection of vendors

  • Ensures country level feasibility is completed in collaboration with cross functional departmental colleagues, organizations, and pCRO, reviewing PTA report outputs, approving sites, and assessing site activation plans

  • Ensures Trial Master File (TMF) setup for study management and country and site level documents

  • Provides input into the risk planning process for the study

  • Coordinates development of study and protocol training and global investigator meetings (IMs)

  • Ensures that local IMs are coordinated by the SOM, if assigned to study

  • Develops and provides key inputs to clinical trial budget (e.g., per subject costs)

  • Ensures that SOMs are inputting into the budget for local/country level tasks (if assigned), and reviews cost variance, invoices, and purchase orders (POs) in a timely manner to ensure that spend is appropriate and on track with the forecast

  • Monitors the budget and contracts for assigned vendors [e.g., central labs, electronic patient reported outcomes (ePRO), radiology, pCRO]

  • Accountable for the delivery of the study against approved plans

  • Works directly with cross-functional and department lines and pCRO to resolve or triage site level issues

  • Leads inspection readiness activities related to study management and site readiness

  • Supports development and delivery of decentralized capabilities at investigator sites

  • Ensures timely study closure and release of internal and external resources as appropriate if assigned to study post database lock

  • Monitors vendor contracts for out of scope activities and budget spend and invoices for assigned vendors (e.g., central labs, ePRO, radiology)

  • Reviews study level metrics and analytics and ensures appropriate actions are taken to mitigate risks and resolve issues

  • Works independently and demonstrates resourcefulness

  • May, on occasion, take on the role and responsibilities of a SOM

Study Team Interface

  • Leads and oversees all elements of study startup and monitoring functions to ensure delivery and compliance with all applicable Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and quality standards, interfacing directly with CRO feasibility and study startup, monitoring and management, and site contracting groups

  • Works proactively with data management functions and department colleagues to ensure alignment on data flow and timely delivery

  • Regularly reviews data reports and dashboards to identify risks and drive appropriate actions

  • Shares and escalates plan deviations to CSTL and study team and drives and oversees mitigations

  • Review vendor expenses and workorders as per study budget for assigned vendors (e.g., central labs, ePRO, radiology, pCRO)

  • Provides ongoing assessment of subject enrollment and discontinuations to inform accurate forecasting for financial planning

  • Provides operational input into protocol design

  • Leads protocol deviation trend review, partnering with the clinical team

  • May lead and facilitate the routine study management vendor calls

The program is focused on outreach to patients at the start of a new specialty therapy, including enrollment support, clinical assessments, therapy education, response to patient inquiries, and referral to additional resources as directed by workflow. The frontline nurse role includes telephonic patient and caregiver education, clinical assessments, documentation, adverse event identification and escalation, physician outreach when clinically necessary, and adherence to quality and production standards.
The Team Lead will serve as the first level of operational and clinical support for nurses, helping to drive productivity, quality, documentation accuracy, adherence, attendance, engagement, and compliance. This position will also support onboarding, training, nesting, precepting, coaching, calibration, quality reviews, and operational readiness as the program scales.

Job title:

Clinical Operations Supervisor

Job Description:

Key Responsibilities

Operational Leadership

  • Oversee day-to-day performance and workflow execution for a team of telephonic Registered Nurses supporting the Specialty Pharmacy program.
  • Provide real-time guidance to nurses related to workflows, documentation expectations, patient interactions, systems navigation, escalation pathways, and operational processes.
  • Monitor daily productivity, attendance, adherence, quality outcomes, service levels, queue performance, and other operational metrics.

  • Support workload management, staffing coverage, queue awareness, and daily operational stability.
  • Identify operational risks, workflow barriers, training gaps, and performance trends, then partner with Operations leadership to implement corrective actions.
  • Support program ramp readiness, including onboarding, nesting, production transition, and stabilization activities.
  • Assist with client requests, audit readiness, reporting needs, and operational documentation as required.

Performance Management and Coaching

  • Monitor individual and team performance using dashboards, reports, quality findings, attendance data, and operational tools.
  • Conduct regular one-on-one coaching focused on productivity, call handling, documentation accuracy, workflow adherence, quality, compliance, attendance, and patient experience.
  • Complete coaching documentation and maintain accurate performance records.
  • Develop and track action plans for nurses requiring additional support.
  • Support performance improvement plans, corrective action documentation, attendance management, and escalation processes when needed.
  • Recognize strong performance and promote employee engagement, retention, and team morale.
  • Reinforce best practices through team huddles, side-by-side support, refresher coaching, and knowledge-sharing sessions.

Clinical Quality, Compliance, and Patient Experience

  • Reinforce adherence to clinical workflows, call handling expectations, documentation standards, escalation requirements, and approved patient education resources.
  • Support accurate completion of clinical assessments, patient education, documentation, and patient/caregiver follow-up in accordance with program requirements.
  • Ensure nurses follow internal processes for adverse event identification, notification, and management within the nursing scope of practice.
  • Support timely escalation of clinical concerns, medication adherence issues, new or unreported symptoms, and other health-related matters identified during the clinical assessment.
  • Partner with Quality, Training, Compliance, and Operations leadership to identify trends, close gaps, and drive improvement.
  • Participate in quality calibration sessions, call listening reviews, documentation audits, performance scorecard reviews, and audit-the-auditor activities.
  • Reinforce compliance with company, client, state, federal, FDA, pharmaceutical, HIPAA, and nursing scope of practice requirements.

Training, Onboarding, and Production Readiness

  • Support new hire training, onboarding, nesting, precepting, workflow reinforcement, and transition to independent production.
  • Partner with Training and Operations leadership to train or reinforce curriculum objectives and ensure nurses are prepared for live patient interaction.
  • Assist with readiness validation, documentation review, call monitoring, chart review follow-up, and targeted coaching.
  • Provide daily feedback during supervised execution and early production transition.
  • Support refresher training, process updates, remediation training, and ongoing program stabilization.
  • May occasionally serve as an interim trainer, facilitator, preceptor, mentor, or Subject Matter Expert for new hire classes, refresher training sessions, process updates, remediation training, and operational readiness activities.

Communication and Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Serve as a primary liaison between frontline nurses and Operations leadership.
  • Cascade workflow changes, client updates, compliance expectations, quality feedback, and operational announcements.
  • Partner with Workforce Management, Quality, Training, Compliance, HR, IT, Recruiting, Business Excellence, and Operations teams.
  • Participate in leadership meetings, readiness reviews, calibration sessions, governance discussions, and client-facing discussions as needed.
  • Escalate risks, performance concerns, staffing issues, system barriers, access issues, and workflow challenges in a timely and professional manner.
  • Promote alignment across teams to ensure consistent execution, communication, and performance expectations.

Administrative Responsibilities

  • Maintain accurate and timely documentation, including coaching logs, huddle notes, action plans, performance summaries, attendance tracking, quality follow-up, and corrective action documentation.
  • Support completion of team-level reporting, operational trackers, readiness documentation, quality follow-up, and client-related requests.
  • Ensure records are organized, audit-ready, and aligned with program expectations.
  • Complete assigned administrative tasks and deliverables within required timelines.

Required Qualifications

Education and Licensure

  • Active, unrestricted U.S. Registered Nurse license required.
  • RN license must be in good standing.
  • Must have an active unencumbered license in the state of residence.
  • Must be eligible to apply for or hold a compact license, as well as additional single-state licenses as program needs require.

Experience

  • Minimum three years of clinical experience as a Registered Nurse preferred.
  • Minimum one year of leadership, mentoring, coaching, precepting, Team Lead, Charge Nurse, Trainer, SME, or supervisory experience preferred.
  • Experience in specialty pharmacy, telephonic nursing, clinical operations, case management, care management, disease management, utilization management, patient education, or healthcare contact center operations preferred.
  • Experience supporting remote, hybrid, or geographically dispersed teams preferred.
  • Experience with new hire training, precepting, peer-to-peer documentation review, or clinical coaching preferred.

Knowledge, Skills, and Competencies

Leadership and People Management

  • Strong coaching, mentoring, employee development, and performance management skills.
  • Ability to lead difficult conversations with professionalism, consistency, and accountability.
  • Ability to support employee engagement, retention, team morale, and performance improvement.

Clinical and Operational Excellence

  • Ability to support patient-centered interactions while reinforcing approved protocols and nursing scope of practice.
  • Knowledge of productivity, quality, attendance, adherence, service level, and workforce management principles.

Analytical and Problem Solving

Communication and Collaboration

Technical Skills

Preferred Clinical Background

Success in This Role Means

jobs.description:
Job Title: Solutions Engineer

About Sezzle:

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

About the Role:

We are seeking a talented and motivated Solutions Engineer who is best in class with a high IQ plus a high EQ. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a rapidly growing team, with abundant prospects for career advancement.

As a Solutions Engineer, you are the technical owner of the merchant relationship from first sales conversation through live integration and beyond. You will focus on our enterprise and strategic merchants: the national retailers and high-volume brands running custom, hand-built integrations across web, mobile app, and in-store. These are our most complex merchants and our largest revenue drivers, and they do not come with an off-the-shelf plugin.

You will partner with Sales, Product, and Engineering to scope what a merchant needs, design the integration that gets them there, and stay with them once they are live. You own the technical side of pre-sales: demos, architecture discussions, RFP responses, and solution proposals. When a merchant needs something custom, you define the requirement, shape the solution with our engineering team, and drive it to launch.

This is a customer-facing engineering role. You will spend as much time on calls with merchant developers as you will in documentation and test environments, and you need to be credible in both rooms.

This role combines technical expertise and sales acumen to support sales teams. They work closely with the sales team and clients, understanding customer needs and translating them into effective, tailored solutions. Acting as a bridge between technical and business functions, a Solutions Engineer not only helps demonstrate and implement the product’s capabilities but also communicates complex technical details in a way that resonates with clients. Their role requires both the ability to engage with customers directly and the technical know-how to ensure the product meets client requirements effectively.

What You'll Do:

  • Own technical discovery for prospective merchants: understand their stack, their checkout flow, and their constraints, then map them to the right Sezzle integration path
  • Lead product demos and technical presentations for merchant engineering and business stakeholders
  • Design integration solutions across our API, SDKs, and platform plugins (Shopify, BigCommerce, Magento, WooCommerce, Wix, and custom builds)
  • Write technical proposals and complete RFP and security questionnaire responses
  • Support merchant mobile app integrations: SDK implementation, in-app checkout, and native versus webview handoff
  • Validate integrations in sandbox and in production before launch, including checkout flow, widget and messaging placement, redirect and handoff behavior, and settlement
  • Troubleshoot live integration issues alongside Support and Engineering, and own the technical narrative back to the merchant
  • Translate recurring merchant needs into product feedback, and push for the fixes that unblock revenue
  • Build and maintain integration documentation, runbooks, and internal enablement so the team scales without you in every call
  • Act as the trusted technical advisor for your merchants after launch, spotting optimization opportunities they haven't asked for yet

What We Look For:

  • 4+ years in a customer-facing technical role: solutions engineering, sales engineering, implementation, solutions architecture, or technical account management
  • Experience with mobile SDK integrations on iOS and Android, including the ability to guide merchant mobile developers through implementation and debug what breaks
  • Experience supporting enterprise merchants through complex, multi-stakeholder integrations with custom-built commerce stacks
  • Hands-on experience with REST APIs, webhooks, and reading API documentation critically
  • Working knowledge of web technologies: HTML, CSS, JavaScript
  • Familiarity with at least one major e-commerce platform (Shopify, BigCommerce, Magento, WooCommerce, Wix) and how payment methods integrate into it
  • Understanding of e-commerce workflows: cart, checkout, payment authorization and capture, refunds, shipping, and product management
  • Ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical audiences, and business context clearly to engineers
  • Strong written communication. You will produce documentation and proposals that merchants and internal teams rely on
  • Comfort managing several merchant integrations at once in a fast-moving environment
  • Ability to read code in at least one language well enough to debug a merchant's implementation
  • Demonstrated ability to use AI tools effectively in day-to-day work, including research, technical documentation, problem-solving, and workflow automation.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience at a payments company, PSP, or BNPL provider
  • Familiarity with payment gateway architecture and how alternative payment methods are surfaced at checkout
  • Experience with in-store or omnichannel payment integrations
  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, computer engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

About You:

  • You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.
  • You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things
  • You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.
  • You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.
  • You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.
  • You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.

What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome:

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators. We believe in surrounding ourselves with only the best and the brightest individuals. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.

jobs.title: Senior Infrastructure Engineer, PostgreSQL
jobs.excerpt: Laravel is looking for our first dedicated Senior Infrastructure Engineer, PostgreSQL to join our all-remote Laravel Cloud infrastructure team.
jobs.description:
Laravel is looking for our first dedicated Senior Infrastructure Engineer, PostgreSQL to join our all-remote Laravel Cloud infrastructure team. For this role we're only considering applications in the EU and Eastern US timezones.

We're on a mission to improve the experience of developers everywhere in the world. To do so, we don't only need to build beautiful software products, we also need to have a solid infrastructure foundation. We always look at products end-to-end when we build something new, and love to keep our users front and center regardless of which part of the product we're building, so we are not only looking for a person who knows how to work with cloud providers and infrastructure, but someone who is able to have empathy for our users and wants to build the best possible products possible.

Databases are the part of that foundation our users trust us with most - it's where their data lives, and it's the thing they can least afford to have go wrong. We're tackling some ambitious and exciting infrastructure projects, and we are looking for a colleague who can help us succeed with the mission - not just solve infrastructure problems. We are looking for someone who is pragmatic and a team player, someone who knows the best practices, but also knows when a custom solution is required.

For this role, we are specifically looking for someone to join the Infrastructure team, working on our Laravel Cloud platform. Laravel Cloud is a fully managed infrastructure platform built for developers and teams who just want to ship their next big idea, and it's relentlessly optimized for Laravel and PHP. Managed PostgreSQL is a core part of that platform, and we want someone to own it end to end: the operator that runs it, the automation around it, the reliability story, and the best practices we hold ourselves to.

This is a build-it-from-the-ground-up role. You will be the person who takes our PostgreSQL offering from "it works" to "it's excellent", and you'll have real latitude to decide what that means. Kubernetes, AWS, and Go are the tools you'll use to get there. If these things appeal to you, then please come join us on this exciting journey!

Infrastructure Engineering at Laravel

  • Work together with a world class team, touching the developer experience of hundreds of thousands of developers around the world.
  • Work on our most ambitious project yet, the recently announced Laravel Cloud platform.
  • Spend time researching the best solutions. We want to make sure we do the right things right.
  • Value the collaborative process, we often pair program or have quick huddles to tackle tricky problems and like to come up with solutions together.
  • Enjoy programming(!). Even though we're often working with cloud providers such as AWS, we also sometimes need to build custom tooling and integrations and we enjoy doing that ourselves.
  • Documentation is king, especially in an all-remote company. We pride ourselves in documenting for ourselves and for our users.
  • Flexible hours and minimum bureaucracy, allowing you the freedom to get your best work done whichever way you prefer.

What you'll be doing

  • Deploy, manage, and optimize PostgreSQL clusters on Kubernetes, owning high availability, performance, backups, and disaster recovery.
  • Develop, maintain, and enhance Kubernetes operators and controllers in Go to automate database and platform operations.
  • Design, build, and operate highly available cloud infrastructure on AWS across multiple accounts and regions.
  • Build and maintain Infrastructure as Code with Terraform, and automate the operational workflows that are still manual today.
  • Improve reliability, scalability, and security through monitoring, observability, and proactive capacity planning.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex production issues across PostgreSQL, Kubernetes, and cloud infrastructure.
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to improve developer experience, CI/CD pipelines, and platform automation.
  • Define and promote best practices for database operations, and mentor engineers as our PostgreSQL expertise grows around you.

What success looks like

  • First 30 days: You understand our PostgreSQL platform, the surrounding infrastructure, our workloads, and where the operational pain actually is.
  • First 60 days: You have taken ownership of PostgreSQL operations and started improving reliability, monitoring, and automation.
  • First 90 days: You have delivered measurable improvements in performance, scalability, and operational maturity, and you are setting the long-term direction for the platform.
  • After 12 months: You are the owner and the expert for PostgreSQL at Laravel. Operational complexity is lower, database practices are better, and engineering teams build and scale on top of PostgreSQL with confidence.

Requirements

  • 7+ years of experience in software, platform, or infrastructure engineering, preferably working closely with large scale production systems.
  • Deep expertise with PostgreSQL in production: performance tuning, replication, backups and recovery, high availability, major version upgrades, and troubleshooting under pressure.
  • Mastery of AWS (or GCP), designing, deploying, and operating production cloud infrastructure.
  • Preferably, you have worked in large AWS environments, dealing with customer data in multi-account setups spread across multiple regions.
  • Experience with Kubernetes (K8s) and container orchestration, including production cluster operations, stateful workloads, storage, networking, RBAC, cluster upgrades, and troubleshooting.
  • Strong proficiency in Go, with experience building and maintaining K8s operators and controllers using tools such as Kubebuilder, controller-runtime, and the Operator SDK.
  • Strong Linux systems administration and networking fundamentals - network protocols, load balancing, caching, and DNS management.
  • Experienced and comfortable with using IaC in a team (Terraform preferred), enforcing sanity checks and policies to help us scale.
  • Experience with CI/CD and GitOps workflows, using tools such as Argo CD or Flux.
  • Experienced and opinionated about logging, monitoring, and alerting tooling and processes (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry).
  • Preferably, you have run PostgreSQL on Kubernetes with an operator such as CloudNativePG or Crunchy Postgres for Kubernetes.

Benefits

  • Small tight-knit team where every developer counts
  • Fully remote and globally distributed working environment
  • Option to attend Laracon conferences around the world
  • Health care plan (Medical, Dental & Vision)
  • Paid time off (Vacation, Sick & Public holidays)
  • Family leave (Maternity, Paternity)
  • Pension plans (As locally applicable)
  • Performance based bonus plan
  • Company equity

At Gartner, Inc. (NYSE:IT), we guide the leaders who shape the world.

Our mission relies on expert analysis and bold ideas to deliver actionable, objective business and technology insights, helping enterprise leaders and their teams succeed with their mission-critical priorities.

Since our founding in 1979, we’ve grown to 20,000 associates globally who support over 13,000 client enterprises in ~90 countries and territories. It’s an exciting time to be at Gartner, with limitless opportunities to make a real impact, grow your skills, and build a lasting, meaningful career in a field that’s reshaping the way we operate. If you’re passionate about AI and want to be part of a team that’s guiding the leaders who shape the world, Gartner is the place for you.

Gartner offers world-class benefits, highly competitive compensation and disproportionate rewards for top performers.

Position: Director of Major Gifts

Reports to: Vice President of Philanthropy

Department: Philanthropy

Location: U.S.Remote

Who we are:

CIEE is a non-profit study abroad and intercultural exchange organization that transforms lives and builds bridges between individuals and nations through study abroad and international exchange experiences that help people develop skills for living in a globally interdependent and multi-cultural world.

Why work with us:

  • You will change the world. CIEE builds bridges between people, countries, and cultures. We help young people participate in high-quality international exchange and study abroad programs that bring the world together. We change lives; our alumni change the world. Be part of the change!
  • You will receive a competitive total rewards package (only applicable for U.S. employees).CIEE provides all employees with exceptional benefits offerings that increase total compensation by up to 25%. Our top-tier benefits include:
    • Paid time off and Parental leave
    • Gym Reimbursement Program
    • Employee Assistance Program
    • Short-term & Long-term Disability
    • 6 floating Fridays (based on our eligibility rules)
    • CIEE Study Abroad Program discounts
    • 403(b) Retirement Plan with employer contribution
    • Insurance Coverage (life, travel, medical, dental, and vision)
    • Flexible Spending Accounts/Health Savings Accounts (medical and dependent)
    • Voluntary Benefits (identity theft protection, pet insurance, accident, and critical illness)
  • You will be part of a fast-paced, international, and collaborative team of professionals. CIEE operates the largest nonprofit network of study abroad locations, with facilities and staff in over 30 countries. Additionally, we help international participants from over 140 countries come to the USA each year.  Committed to excellence and solving whatever problem the world throws at them, CIEE professionals work on international teams and are dedicated to advancing our almost 80-year-old mission to make the world a more peaceful place.

Who you are:

You are an experienced, resilient, and curious fundraiser who is equally comfortable opening new relationships and advancing established ones. You understand that discovery requires persistence, sound judgment, and the ability to distinguish genuine opportunity from polite interest. You are motivated by results, but you also know that sustainable fundraising is built through trust, disciplined followthrough, and strong internal collaboration,

What you’ll do:

  • Build and manage a growing portfolio of major and leadership gift donors and prospects, with an initial emphasis on discovery, qualification, and relationship development.
  • Conduct substantial proactive outreach to CIEE alumni and high-net-worth individuals who care about international education, including those with limited recent engagement with CIEE, and move promising relationships from initial contact to meaningful next steps and solicitation.
  • Prioritize and develop relationships with current donors who demonstrate potential for increased support, while also qualifying new prospects from CIEE's broader constituencies.
  • Develop and execute individualized cultivation, solicitation, and stewardship strategies that align donor interests with CIEE's established priorities and campaign goals.
  • Secure significant gifts and develop donors toward major-gift support, recognizing that a donor's first meaningful gift may be below CIEE's formal major-gift threshold.
  • Leverage the 80th anniversary and matching-gift opportunity to create timely, compelling pathways for engagement and giving while building relationships that extend beyond the campaign.
  • Prepare donor strategies, briefing materials, correspondence, proposals, and other materials tailored to donors' interests and decision-making needs.
  • Engage philanthropy leadership, executives, program leaders, alumni, board members, and other partners at the right moments in cultivation, solicitation, and stewardship.
  • Use available wealth-screening, donor data, institutional knowledge, and research resources to identify, prioritize, and evaluate donor prospects.
  • Recommend strategic travel plans that maximize donor engagement and make responsible use of organizational resources.
  • Maintain timely and accurate donor records, contact reports, next steps, gift opportunities, and revenue forecasts in Salesforce.
  • Coordinate closely with annual giving and alumni engagement to support high[1]volume outreach, avoid conflicting communications, and transition responsive prospects into personalized relationship development.
  • Help establish and refine qualification, portfolio management, moves management, stewardship, travel, and donor-engagement practices in partnership with philanthropy leadership and operations.
  • Identify appropriate planned-giving, family foundation, donor-advised fund, corporate, or other opportunities that emerge through assigned relationships, coordinating with colleagues as needed.
  • Contribute to a collaborative fundraising culture in which relationship strategy and revenue credit reflect meaningful team contributions.

What you’ll bring:

The ideal candidate will possess:

  • Bachelor's degree or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
  • Seven to ten years of progressively responsible fundraising experience preferred, including substantial experience with individual giving.
  • Proven track record of cultivating, soliciting, and closing significant gifts, including five- and six-figure commitments.
  • Demonstrated success initiating and developing donor relationships through proactive outreach, including relationships that were not previously qualified or fully developed.
  • Experience building or substantially expanding a donor portfolio rather than only managing a mature, inherited caseload.
  • Strong judgment in donor qualification, strategy development, solicitation timing, and the use of organizational leaders and partners.
  • Excellent interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills, including comfort engaging high-net-worth individuals and navigating complex relationships.
  • Ability to work effectively in a team-based environment where several colleagues may contribute materially to a donor relationship or gift.
  • Strong organizational skills, disciplined follow-through, and comfort working toward clear activity, pipeline, and revenue expectations.
  • Experience using fundraising CRM systems; Salesforce experience is strongly preferred.
  • Comfort using donor data, wealth-screening results, and qualitative information to prioritize outreach without treating capacity alone as qualification.
  • An entrepreneurial and practical approach to building systems, testing strategies, and improving results in an evolving program.
  • A genuine interest in international education, cultural exchange, and CIEE's mission. Prior CIEE involvement is valued but not required.
  • Ability to work effectively across cultures and with people from a wide range of backgrounds and experiences.
  • Ability to embrace CIEE's Core Values: Excellence, Integrity, Respect, Inclusion, and Problem Solving.

CIEE believes that professionals with varied backgrounds bring unique approaches and ideas to solving problems and advancing our mission to bring the world together. Qualified candidates from underrepresented groups are strongly encouraged to apply.

Due to federal regulations and CIEE policies, a background check, reference check, and education and employment verification will be conducted as conditions of employment.

Company:Driven Brands

The Automotive Training Institute (ATI), the largest coaching and training company for Owners of Independent Repair Shops in the US and Canada. With over 1700 shops actively engaged in our program, we provide coaching, training and the largest buying program in the automotive aftermarket for Independent Shop Owners. Our members have cumulatively increased their Gross Profits by almost $3.0 Billion dollars through the ATI program.

JOB DESCRIPTION:

The Senior Instructor, Mechanical is a senior-level member of ATI's instructional team, delivering ATI's curriculum to independent mechanical and general repair shop owners and their teams while taking on a broadened scope of responsibility for content quality, classroom standards, and the development of other instructors.

The Senior Instructor combines deep, credible mechanical-industry expertise with advanced instructional skill, translating complex business and operational concepts into practical, immediately applicable knowledge. Beyond individual classroom performance, the Senior Instructor is expected to model and elevate instructional standards across the mechanical instruction team, mentor newer instructors, and serve as a trusted content authority within the mechanical curriculum.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

Course Instruction (Mechanical)

  • Deliver ATI curriculum to independent mechanical and general repair shop owners and their teams across live, virtual, and on-demand formats.

  • Translate business concepts — financials, sales, leadership, succession, and operations — into practical, shop-floor applications for a mechanical/general repair audience.

  • Adapt delivery style and content to the format, audience, and experience level of each session, including advanced and owner-level cohorts.

  • Serve as lead or anchor instructor for flagship courses, multi-day events, and higher-stakes sessions as assigned.

Curriculum & Content Leadership

  • Partner closely with curriculum and instructional design staff to keep mechanical-relevant content accurate, current, and credible.

  • Provide subject-matter review and feedback on new or revised mechanical curriculum prior to broader rollout.

  • Identify content gaps and emerging mechanical-industry topics, and recommend new course or session development.

Content Research & Development

  • Dedicate regular, structured time to researching developments in the mechanical/general repair industry, including evolving technologies (EV service, ADAS, diagnostics, telematics), labor market shifts, parts supply dynamics, and changing shop economics.

  • Actively monitor industry publications, trade associations, OEM technical resources, and peer research to maintain current, credible subject-matter expertise across ATI's mechanical curriculum.

  • Review existing course materials on a defined cycle to assess continued relevance, accuracy, and alignment with the realities participants are facing in their shops today — recommending updates, retirements, or new content as warranted.

  • Synthesize industry research into actionable insights and translate those insights into curriculum recommendations, new session concepts, or in-course examples that reflect what is happening on the shop floor right now.

  • Collaborate with ATI's curriculum, instructional design, and market intelligence functions to ensure research findings move efficiently from discovery into updated course content.

  • Bring participant feedback from the classroom — questions asked, confusion surfaced, real-world situations raised — back into the content review process as a primary signal for curriculum improvement.

Instructor Mentorship & Team Development

  • Mentor and onboard newer or less experienced instructors, including classroom observation and constructive feedback.

  • Model exemplary classroom presence, facilitation of discussion, and member engagement for the broader instruction team.

  • Support the Department Leader in calibrating instructional quality standards across the mechanical instruction team.

Professional Development & Skills Building

  • Actively seek out and participate in skills-building opportunities — including ATI-provided training, industry conferences, instructional development programs, and peer learning — as an ongoing professional responsibility, not a periodic exception.

  • Engage fully with ATI's instructor development initiatives, including cohort debriefs, feedback sessions, and any formal development programming offered by ATI's Training & Development leadership.

  • Pursue continuous growth in instructional craft, facilitation technique, adult learning principles, and subject-matter depth. ATI is committed to supporting this development; candidates must be equally committed to pursuing it.

  • Model a genuine growth orientation for the broader instructor team — demonstrate that learning is an active, lifelong practice expected at every level of the organization.

General

  • Represent ATI professionally with members, partners, and at industry events.

  • Contribute mechanical-industry insight to the broader Training & Development team.

  • Perform other duties as assigned in support of ATI's mechanical-member experience.

Required Qualifications

  • Substantial mechanical/general repair industry experience with a record of credibility among shop owners and operators.

  • Demonstrated, sustained track record instructing or presenting to groups in live and/or virtual settings, including more advanced or experienced audiences.

  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills, including the judgment to guide discussion among experienced business owners.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

  • Demonstrated ability to mentor, coach, or develop other instructors or team members.

  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment and to travel occasionally for live events and meetings.

  • Demonstrated personal commitment to ongoing professional growth and skills development. Candidates who are not actively invested in their own learning are not a fit for this role, regardless of experience level.

*Note: Prior mechanical shop ownership is welcomed but not required. Demonstrated industry expertise and instructional ability take precedence.*

Demonstrated knowledge across several of the following mechanical/general repair domains is strongly preferred:

  • Shop financials, KPIs, and performance management

jobs.description:
Job Description

Director, Clinical Pharmacy Stars Performance

A bit about this role:

As Director, Clinical Pharmacy Stars Performance, you are the tactical owner of every clinical pharmacy-related measure in our Medicare Advantage and Part D Star Ratings portfolio. Your job is to drive our clinical pharmacy Stars enterprise strategy into daily reality, measure by measure, member by member, week by week. This is the most consequential set of measures we own.

You will be the enterprise clinical subject matter expert on pharmacy quality: the person Medical Directors call before they call anyone else, the person who reads the Technical Notes the day they drop, and the person who can tell us in February where a cut point is going to land in October and what we need to do about it now. You will also be the person building the tracker, setting the objectives and key results, and personally auditing whether the outreach was actually effective.

You will report directly to the AVP, Pharmacy, carrying the portfolio into executive meetings, leading cross-functional escalations, and owning outcomes.

Responsibilities and Impact will include:

  • Performance Management & Insight Generation. Own the performance trajectory of the full clinical pharmacy Star portfolio, including the triple-weighted medication adherence measures (Diabetes, RAS Antagonists, Statins), Statin Use in Persons with Diabetes (SUPD), Polypharmacy: Use of Multiple Anticholinergic Medications in Older Adults (Poly-ACH), and Concurrent Use of Opioids and Benzodiazepines (COB). Forecast measure trajectories against projected cut points, identify risk months before it shows up in a year-end score, and translate the analysis into daily, weekly, and monthly operating directives that internal teams and vendors can actually execute against.

  • Clinical Subject Matter Expertise & Clinical Collaboration. Serve as the authoritative clinical voice on pharmacy quality. Track regulatory specification changes and clinical guideline shifts and interpret what they mean for our operations. Lead peer-to-peer dialogue with clinical leaders within Devoted and our growing provider network.

  • Future Measure Readiness. Keep us ahead of the measure set rather than reacting to it. Track what CMS is developing, what sits on the display page, and what the measure developer pipeline is producing. Build the data and operational capability for a measure while it's still on display, so that when it enters Stars we are already performing instead of standing up a workflow. Own the read on every Advance Notice, Proposed Rule, and Final Rule, translate them into what specifically changes for Devoted, and bring us a point of view.

  • Strategy & Innovation. Design organization-wide strategies across the portfolio of clinical pharmacy measures to deliver 5-Star performance at scale. You will identify innovative opportunities to eliminate friction points along members’ healthcare journeys, empowering them to achieve their healthiest lives.

  • Excellent Cross-Functional Execution. Manage performance against operating KPIs and clinical outcomes metrics by partnering with internal Devoted teams and external partners, including our PBM, to design and implement solutions that improve clinical and care coordination interventions. You will translate goals into actionable strategies and guide initiatives from pilot phase through full-scale implementation across our member population as well as our provider and pharmacy networks.

  • Market Awareness. Keep a pulse on the vendor landscape: who is doing credible work in adherence stratification, pharmacist-led intervention, and pharmacy network engagement, what those platforms actually deliver versus what the sales deck promises, and whether there's a case for bringing one in. We build rather than buy by default. We expect you to have an informed opinion on when that calculus should change, and to be able to defend it either way.

  • Servant Leadership. Drive execution through a blend of direct management and leadership through influence, operating with a true servant-leader mindset that prioritizes enabling, unblocking, and supporting teams. You will translate complex operational goals into daily workflows that set our teams - and our members - up for success.

Required skills and experience:

  • PharmD or equivalent clinical degree. The role demands clinical credibility and independent clinical judgment on complex medication management strategies.

  • 7+ years of progressive leadership in managed care, a health plan, or a PBM, with dedicated ownership of Medicare Advantage and Part D quality programs and a documented, quantifiable track record of moving clinical pharmacy Stars measures in a volatile cut point environment.

  • Execution instinct. You are a relentless self-starter who refuses to let initiatives die in committee. You will roll up your sleeves to manipulate raw data, draft a workflow, or personally audit a vendor's call dispositions. You measure yourself on what shipped, not what was discussed. You thrive in environments where you need to move fast and adapt quickly.

  • Insight generation. Advanced analytical acumen and the ability to see past the surface of a dashboard to the root cause of non-adherence, then design the targeted, cost-effective intervention that addresses it. Comfort with business intelligence tooling and with sizing an opportunity before committing resources to it.

  • Demonstrated leadership impact and collaborative excellence, with experience successfully influencing outcomes across organizational levels, whether through direct management, cross-functional project leadership, or matrix reporting relationships that require building consensus without formal authority. You are energized by working with diverse backgrounds, and deeply motivated by helping our front line teams do their best work and members achieve their best, healthiest lives.

  • Clinical diplomacy. You can hold a nuanced clinical conversation with a skeptical clinical leader, earn their respect, and change prescribing behavior without authority over them.

Desired skills and experience:

  • Motivated by learning quickly in complex clinical and operational domains. You read the source material yourself and are excited to catch everyone up.

  • AI explorations. Curiosity about emerging technologies and a pragmatic approach to using them. Experience using LLMs to build complex prompts and tools is a strong plus.

  • Skill and rigor in using and analyzing data. You understand the pitfalls of metrics (e.g., how open vs. closed periods affect data, or how denominators shift over time). You are comfortable thinking in ranges and probabilities rather than false precision, and you can distinguish between a metric changing and the underlying reality changing.

Salary Range: $182,000 - $247,000 a year

jobs.excerpt: About Routeware, Inc.  Routeware is the industry leader in providing software and data analysis that enables public and private enterprises to improve the effectiveness of their waste and recycling programs.
jobs.description:
About Routeware, Inc.

Routeware is the industry leader in providing software and data analysis that enables public and private enterprises to improve the effectiveness of their waste and recycling programs. Our solutions help organizations save time and money, increase efficiency, improve safety and help make our world a greener place.

Based in Portland, Oregon, the company employs a distributed team across North America and the UK. Our brands, products, and services provide an all-in-one platform to municipal and private waste haulers and other fleet services. As part of an essential and growing industry, we seek solution-oriented team players who want to positively impact the environment. Our work environment is collaborative, dynamic, fast-paced, and fun with a strong appreciation for innovation and initiative.

Our Mission:

  • Transform waste collection to drive a better future for generations to come.

Our Values:

  • Adaptability - The waste industry and technology are ever-changing, and the Routeware team never stops adapting to be at the forefront of technology innovation, supporting our customers to stay ahead.
  • Mission-driven - At Routeware, it matters to us that our work has a lasting positive impact on our customers' outcomes, our fellow team members' well-being, and the long-term sustainability of our environment.
  • Human-first - While technology drives our products; the real, live, caring people at Routeware are the true drivers of meaningful outcomes for our customers.

POSITION OVERVIEW

Routeware’s Business Operations product line manages the all-in-one connected front and back office for private haulers. Our customer is a municipal program manager; our user is a resident who just wants to know if Tuesday is a holiday and whether pizza boxes go in recycling.

We’re hiring a Product Manager to help drive day-to-day execution on this product line. You’ll partner closely with the VP of Product, taking on roadmap delivery, story writing, sprint execution, and validation work. Over time, as we unify teams and integrate further with the rest of the Routeware platform, your scope and ownership will grow. You’ll also work with a distributed engineering team that includes offshore developers, which means written clarity, detailed acceptance criteria, and async-friendly working habits matter.

This is a meaningful seat for a PM with a few years under their belt who wants to ship product in a B2B SaaS environment with a real societal impact. It’s also a great place to apply AI to a real-world problem, both exploring opportunities and helping ship production features that drive adoption.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Roadmap Execution & Delivery: Partner closely with the VP of Product to execute the product line roadmap. Own daily execution: discovery, story writing, sprint planning, acceptance criteria, and validation. Ship clean, on time, and with quality.
  • Cross-Product Collaboration: Contribute to integration work between Business Operations and the broader Routeware platform. Partner with PMs on adjacent product lines as we work toward a more unified portfolio.
  • Distributed Delivery & Engineering Partnership: Work effectively with a distributed engineering team that includes offshore developers. Write specs that don’t require a hallway conversation to interpret. Run sprint ceremonies in an async-friendly way.
  • AI Feature Delivery: Help identify, scope, and ship AI-powered capabilities in the resident journey — smarter search, conversational sorting guidance, personalized education, contamination reduction.
  • Launch & Adoption: Partner with Marketing, CS, and Support on go-to-market — release readiness, internal enablement, customer comms, and adoption tracking after launch.
  • Voice of Customer & Measurement: Stay close to Support and Customer Success — triage escalations, feed real-world signal back into the roadmap, and track KPIs for your scope (adoption, engagement, education effectiveness).

QUALIFICATIONS

Required

  • Background shipping B2B products. You understand engagement, retention, and how to design for a non-expert end user.
  • 2–3+ years in Product Management or Product Ownership in SaaS, with progressive scope and ownership.
  • Strong agile fluency: backlog management, story writing, sprint planning, prioritization frameworks.
  • Experience working with distributed or offshore engineering teams — or strong evidence of the written clarity and async habits that make it work.
  • Strong analytical instincts — comfortable with product analytics, experimentation, and metrics-driven prioritization.
  • Familiarity with AI / LLM-powered product capabilities and the judgment to know where they add real value vs. where they’re overkill.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management; able to translate between customers, internal teams, and executives.
  • Hands-on fluency with Jira, Confluence, and a product analytics tool (Pendo, Amplitude, Mixpanel, similar).

Bonus

  • Background in civic tech, waste/recycling, utilities, or other municipal-adjacent SaaS.
  • Experience with behavior-change product design or educational/content-heavy product surfaces.
  • Track record contributing to product integration or unification work across multiple product lines.
  • Experience shipping AI features into a consumer-facing product.
  • Familiarity with localization, accessibility, and multi-tenant product configurability.

BENEFITS

  • Comprehensive benefits (medical with HSA option, vision, dental, and life insurance)
  • Paid parental leave
  • Medical and Dependent FSA
  • 401K match
  • Unlimited PTO
  • Ten company holidays
  • 1 Volunteer day
  • Summer Friday's

jobs.description:
Storyblok is a headless CMS that enables marketers and developers to create with joy and succeed in the AI-driven content era. It empowers you to deliver structured and consistent content everywhere: websites, apps, AI search, and beyond.

Marketers get a visual editor with reusable components, in-context preview, and workflows to launch fast and stay on brand. Developers have freedom to use their favorite frameworks and integrate with anything through the API-first platform. Brands get one source of truth for content that is accurate, flexible, and measurable.

Legendary brands like Virgin Media O2, Oatly, and TomTom use Storyblok to make a bigger, faster market impact. It’s Joyful Headless™, and it changes everything.

WHAT IS IN IT FOR YOU

You will be joining a growing company where you can contribute to many “firsts”. Plus these benefits:

  • Monthly remote work stipend (home internet costs, electricity). Home office equipment package right at the start (laptop, keyboard, monitor…)
  • Home office equipment upgrade (furniture, ear plugs …) or membership to a local co-working space after your onboarding
  • Sick leave benefit, parental leave and 25 days of annual leave plus your local national holidays
  • Personal development fund for courses, books, conferences, and material
  • VSOP (Virtual Stock Option Plan)
  • The annual international team-building trip, quarterly and monthly online get-togethers
  • As a fully remote company, with work-life balance at its core, you’ll enjoy flexible schedules
  • An international team that loves to have fun at work and works hard together to accomplish shared goals

JOB SUMMARY

We’re looking for a Senior QA Engineer who combines strong Playwright and TypeScript engineering skills with a proactive, collaborative mindset. You'll be a key contributor to how we deliver quality, raising the bar for our automation codebase and partnering closely with engineering to define how testing responsibility is shared across the team.

You’ll join our dynamic and growing Product Engineering team at Storyblok, playing an instrumental role in ensuring the quality and reliability of our flagship CMS platform. This platform empowers businesses to create and deliver seamless digital content experiences.

In this role, you'll work closely with product owners, designers, and developers to design and maintain clean, scalable, well-architected TypeScript automation, establish clear guidelines on which test level is right for a given change, and continuously refine QA strategies to maintain best-in-class software quality. Your work will directly contribute to delivering an exceptional user experience by ensuring flawless performance across every facet of our application.


ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS

  • Own projects end-to-end with clarity, technical excellence, and accountability, ensuring high-quality standards across teams.
  • Champion strong TypeScript engineering practices and coding standards across the QA codebase, promoting engineering excellence and driving continuous improvement.
  • Design, implement, and maintain efficient, well-typed, and reliable automated tests across frontend and backend using Playwright.
  • Raise the team's TypeScript bar: introduce stronger typing patterns, reusable abstractions, linting/tooling standards, and code review practices that improve maintainability across the automation codebase.
  • Partner with engineering to define, implement, and enforce the test pyramid in practice, establishing clear guidelines on which test level (unit, integration, E2E) is appropriate for a given change, and driving adoption so both developers and QAs consistently write tests at the right level.
  • Perform manual and exploratory testing; document, track, and verify defects to ensure product excellence and analyze test results and monitor key testing metrics to identify patterns and opportunities for improvement.
  • Participate actively in project kick-offs to understand requirements, anticipate risks, and influence testability from the earliest stages.
  • Identify and communicate issues, risks, or dependencies early, escalating to product leadership when necessary.
  • Mentor and support teammates on TypeScript proficiency and Playwright best practices, fostering an open, empathetic environment that encourages learning and feedback.

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related field.
  • 7+ years of relevant experience as a QA Engineer or Software Engineer in Test.
  • Deep proficiency in TypeScript, including a strong command of advanced typing and code architecture, as well as Playwright.
  • Practical experience partnering with engineers to define and roll out test pyramid guidelines, including setting expectations for which test level is appropriate and holding both developers and QAs accountable for following them.
  • Comprehensive knowledge of CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions) and experience creating and maintaining containerized test environments.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to influence and align across technical and product teams.
  • High attention to detail, proven ability to deliver results, and a strong motivation to contribute to organizational growth in a high-performing environment.
  • Experience mentoring engineers, defining and driving TypeScript and test automation standards across teams.
  • Demonstrates AI literacy, with the ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, decision-making, and quality of work while applying sound judgment and critical thinking.

NICE TO HAVE

  • Experience writing and maintaining Ruby on Rails code.
  • Experience with observability and error tracking tools (eg. Grafana, Kibana, Sentry) and identifying errors, trends, and issues.
  • Experience with performance testing and best practices.

MENTAL, PHYSICAL AND ENVIRONMENTAL REQUIREMENTS

Remote (home) work opportunity or funded by Storyblok co-working space

GENERAL TERMS

Tailscale is building the new Internet by delivering software that makes it easy to securely interconnect people and their devices, no matter where they are. From hobbyists to multinational corporations, teams of every size use Tailscale each day to protect their networks, share access to internal tools, and more. We're building a future for the Internet that's easy, sensible, and safe, like it used to be. Founded in 2019 and fully distributed, we're backed by Accel, CRV, Insight, Heavybit, and Uncork Capital.

About the Role

We’re seeking a talented and motivated full-time Software Engineer to join our growing team. You will work as part of the engineering team to:

  • Develop the Tailscale product, contributing to client code and backend services. The client code is a mix of C#, XAML, and Go. Prior Go expertise is not a requirement.
  • Bring a special focus on our Windows platform, building and maintaining our Windows client using the modern WinUI/Windows App SDK stack, while contributing to common code that supports macOS, mobile, and other core client platforms.

Because we’re an early-stage and fully remote company, we’re looking for a motivated individual who can help move the product forward. The ability to think on your feet, collaborate with highly technical teams, and comfort working asynchronously are essential.

Key Responsibilities

  • Work with engineers on a native Windows desktop client using Windows App SDK, WinUI, C#, XAML and Go
  • Implement support for the latest Windows platform features while maintaining compatibility with a subset of older versions
  • Develop and optimize product features on Windows, with a focus on UI components and platform integration
  • Develop and maintain unit and integration tests using Microsoft Testing Platform v2 and xUnit
  • Contribute to common, cross-platform Tailscale code

  • Strong understanding of software development principles, capabilities, and limitations of the Windows platform
  • Proficiency in C# and modern native UI frameworks (WinUI/UWP/WPF)

Nice to Have
