Ziply Fiber is a local internet service provider dedicated to elevating the connected lives of the communities we serve. We offer the fastest home internet in the nation, a refreshingly great customer experience, and affordable plans that put customers in charge.

As our state-of-the-art fiber network expands, so does our need for team members who can help us grow and realize our goals.

Our Company Values:

  • Genuinely Caring:We treat customers and colleagues like neighbors, with empathy and full attention.
  • Empowering You:We help customers choose what is best for them, and we support employees in implementing new ideas and solutions.
  • Innovation and Improvement:We constantly seek ways to improve how we serve customers and each other.
  • Earning Your Trust:We build trust through clear, honest, human communication.

Job Summary

Ziply Fiber is building one of the most technically advanced fiber-first broadband networks in the Pacific Northwest, and we're moving fast. As Vice President of Network Architecture & Engineering, you will serve as the chief technical authority for our full network stack — access, voice, subscriber edge, IP core, transport, and infrastructure. You will lead a team of Principal Architects and Directors, own the multi-year technology roadmap, and drive the transformation programs that reduce cost, accelerate deployment, and position Ziply for competitive leadership in every market we enter.

This is an executive role that demands equal command of technical depth and business impact. You will build the business cases, secure the investments, and deliver the results — measured in dollars saved, deployment velocity accelerated, and operational dependencies eliminated.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

The Essential Duties and Responsibilities listed below are a range of duties performed by the employee and not intended to reflect all duties performed.

Network Architecture Strategy & Transformation

·Define and own the multi-year network architecture roadmap across voice, access, subscriber edge, IP core & metro, transport, and infrastructure domains.

·Drive technology transformation programs: legacy platform exits, vendor-agnostic architecture adoption, zero-touch provisioning, and network automation.

Leadership & Organizational Capability

·Lead and scale a team of Principal Architects and Directors; build organizational capability through director- and principal-level hiring and development.

·Represent the technology organization in executive-level discussions, board briefings, and strategic partnership negotiations.

·Set clear objectives, success metrics, and accountability for architecture and engineering leaders; coach teams through complex technical, financial, and organizational tradeoffs.

·Develop succession depth and leadership bench strength for critical architecture and engineering functions.

Business Case, Investment & Financial Planning

·Develop and own business cases for major network investments — quantifying cost savings, stranded asset recovery, and competitive positioning for executive and board approval.

·Deliver measurable cost reductions through optics standardization, technology consolidation (DACS, legacy platforms), and operational independence from TSA and vendor lock-in agreements.

·Collaborate with the Enterprise Delivery Office on CapEx and OpEx planning for all network engineering initiatives.

Technology Certification, Vendor Strategy & Selection

·Establish and operate a technology certification program: device qualification, PoC lab management, vendor-donated equipment programs, and accelerated certification cycles.

·Own vendor and technology selection: RFPs, PoCs, architecture reviews, and contract negotiations across the network stack.

Cross-Functional Operations & Execution

·Partner with Network Planning, Platform Ops, IT/Platform Technology, and NOC to ensure architecture enables operational efficiency and autonomous network operations.

Other Duties

·Performs other duties as required to support the business and evolving organization.

Required Qualifications:

·High school diploma or GED.

·Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Telecommunications, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent combination of education and directly relevant experience.

·15+ years of progressive network engineering and architecture experience, with 5+ years in a senior leadership role at a broadband ISP, CLEC, or telco.

·Proven track record of delivering large-scale network transformation programs with quantifiable business impact — cost savings, asset recovery, or competitive differentiation measured in the tens to hundreds of millions.

·Experience scaling high-performance architecture or engineering teams; demonstrated ability to add director- and principal-level talent to strengthen organizational capability.

·Hands-on experience with transport (400G/100G), fiber voice/VoIP business cases, and CPE/modem platform migrations at scale.

·Deep familiarity with zero-touch provisioning, vendor-agnostic orchestration, and network automation platforms.

·Experience exiting legacy technology dependencies: TSA agreements, end-of-life platforms (DACS, TDM, legacy ACS), and third-party operational agreements.

·Strong business acumen: ability to build, defend, and deliver on multi-million-dollar investment cases at the executive level.

·Excellent cross-functional leadership: able to align engineering, operations, finance, and vendor partners around shared outcomes.

Preferred Qualifications:

·Advanced degree such as MS, MBA, or equivalent executive-level business or technical education.

·Experience establishing or operating a technology lab or architecture center (vendor certification, PoC environments, donated equipment programs).

·Background in digital transformation or operations modernization — omni-channel, automation, AI-assisted operations, or field technician tooling.

·Intellectual property, publication, patent, or industry thought-leadership experience in networking, automation, platform modernization, or subscriber experience domains.

·Prior experience at a fiber-first or fiber-overbuilder ISP in a competitive broadband market.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

·Ability to work independently and apply sound judgment and reasoning skills to a variety of situations.

·Ability to multi-task and collaborate effectively with other personnel to meet deadlines.

·Strong verbal and written communication, attention to detail, and organizational skills.

·Ability to work within critical deadlines.

·Ability to adjust to rapidly changing priorities and schedules.

·Ability to provide excellent customer service.

·Executive presence with the ability to influence across Technology, Operations, Finance, Legal, Product, and executive leadership.

·Strong analytical, financial, and decision-making skills with the ability to balance technical excellence, customer impact, operational risk, and business value.

·Ability to build trust, lead through ambiguity, and drive alignment in a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment.

Work Authorization

Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the US for any employer. Sponsorship is not available for this position.

Physical Requirements

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Essential and marginal functions may require maintaining physical condition necessary for bending, stooping, sitting, walking, or standing for prolonged periods of time; most of time is spent sitting in a comfortable position with frequent opportunity to move about. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by the job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus.

Work Environment

About the Role

At Pavago, we’re hiring a Video Editor for one of our clients to create engaging, polished, and performance-driven video content across social media, marketing campaigns, paid advertising, websites, and internal communications.

This is more than a technical editing role. You’ll be responsible for turning raw footage into compelling stories designed to capture attention, increase watch time, improve audience retention, and strengthen campaign performance.

You’ll create and optimize content across platforms including TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube, LinkedIn, websites, and paid advertising channels.

If you understand how editing pace, storytelling, hooks, visuals, and platform-specific formats influence content performance, this role is a strong fit.

What You’ll Own

Video Editing & Content Creation

  • Edit raw footage into polished, engaging, and professional videos.
  • Create both short-form and long-form content.
  • Work with editing platforms such as:
    • Adobe Premiere Pro
    • Final Cut Pro
    • DaVinci Resolve
  • Build edits around strong storytelling, pacing, and audience attention.
  • Create compelling openings and maintain viewer interest throughout each video.
  • Align every edit with brand guidelines, campaign objectives, and marketing goals.
  • Adapt editing styles based on platform, audience, and content purpose.

Social Media & Platform Optimization

  • Create platform-native video content for:
    • TikTok
    • Instagram Reels
    • YouTube & YouTube Shorts
    • LinkedIn
    • Websites
    • Paid advertising campaigns
  • Adapt content into multiple aspect ratios, including:
    • 16:9
    • 9:16
    • 1:1
  • Repurpose footage into multiple pieces of content without making each version feel repetitive.
  • Optimize exports for the appropriate combination of quality, file size, and platform requirements.
  • Understand how editing styles differ between short-form social content, long-form video, and advertising creative.

Motion Graphics & Visual Enhancements

  • Add professional:
    • Captions
    • Titles
    • Lower thirds
    • Motion graphics
    • Transitions
    • Visual overlays
  • Use tools such as Adobe After Effects and Canva when appropriate.
  • Maintain consistent typography, visual language, and brand presentation.
  • Enhance videos without over-editing or distracting from the core message.

Audio & Color

  • Clean and balance audio for professional output.
  • Improve dialogue clarity and reduce unwanted background noise.
  • Handle audio syncing and volume leveling.
  • Add appropriate licensed music and sound effects.
  • Perform color correction and grading.
  • Maintain visual consistency between different cameras, clips, and environments.

Footage & Project Management

  • Import, organize, and maintain raw footage and creative assets.
  • Keep project files and folder structures clean and consistent.
  • Maintain clear version control throughout revision cycles.
  • Archive completed projects so footage and assets can be easily retrieved and repurposed.
  • Manage multiple editing projects and deadlines simultaneously.

Collaboration & Revisions

  • Work closely with:
    • Marketing teams
    • Content strategists
    • Creative teams
  • Receive and manage feedback through tools such as Frame.io and shared review systems.
  • Turn revisions around quickly while maintaining quality.
  • Communicate clearly about timelines, creative requirements, and deliverables.
  • Incorporate stakeholder feedback without losing consistency or creative direction.

Performance Optimization

  • Review content performance metrics including:
    • Watch time
    • Audience retention
    • Engagement
    • CTR
  • Identify patterns in high- and low-performing content.
  • Apply performance insights to future edits.
  • Collaborate with marketing teams to test new hooks, formats, pacing, and creative approaches.
  • Continuously improve editing decisions based on actual audience behavior.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • You understand that great video editing is about storytelling and attention, not just transitions and effects.
  • You know how to make the opening seconds of a video count.
  • You can edit both short-form and long-form content effectively.
  • You understand how content consumption differs across TikTok, Reels, YouTube, LinkedIn, and paid ads.
  • You can execute quickly without sacrificing quality.
  • You’re highly organized and comfortable managing multiple projects.
  • You take ownership of your work from raw footage through final export.
  • You’re receptive to feedback and can handle revision cycles professionally.

Required Experience & Skills

  • 2+ years of professional video editing experience.
  • Strong proficiency with one or more of:
    • Adobe Premiere Pro
    • Final Cut Pro
    • DaVinci Resolve
  • Experience editing social media and marketing content.
  • Strong understanding of:
    • Video pacing
    • Storytelling
    • Viewer retention
    • Platform-specific content
  • Experience with:
    • Audio cleanup and syncing
    • Color correction
    • Captions and graphics
    • Multi-platform formatting
    • Platform-specific exports
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously.
  • Strong attention to detail.
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Portfolio demonstrating professional video editing work.

Preferred Experience

  • Adobe After Effects and motion graphics experience.
  • Experience editing:
    • Paid advertising creatives
    • UGC-style videos
    • Performance marketing content
    • Short-form social content
    • Long-form YouTube content
  • Familiarity with performance metrics such as:
    • Watch time
    • Audience retention
    • CTR
    • Engagement
  • Experience using Frame.io or similar creative review platforms.
  • Background supporting:
    • SaaS companies
    • E-commerce brands
    • Marketing agencies
    • Media companies

What a Typical Day Looks Like

A Video Editor’s day revolves around turning raw footage into content people actually want to watch. You will:

  • Review and organize incoming footage and creative briefs.
  • Edit short-form and long-form videos.
  • Create social media and marketing campaign content.
  • Add captions, graphics, transitions, and sound design.
  • Perform audio cleanup and color correction.
  • Create platform-specific versions and exports.
  • Review feedback and complete revisions.
  • Analyze content performance to improve future edits.

In short: you transform raw footage into polished, platform-native video content that captures attention, tells a compelling story, and drives measurable engagement.

Key Metrics for Success (KPIs)

  • On-time delivery of video projects.
  • Strong audience watch time and retention.

Why This Role Stands Out

Apply Now

jobs.description:
Executive Partner, Business Services – Chief Audit Executive (CAE)

About this role:

What makes Gartner a GREAT fit for you? When you join Gartner, you’ll be part of a fast-growing team that helps the world become smarter and more connected. We’re the world’s leading research and advisory company, achieving consistent double-digit growth by steering clients toward the right decisions with business and technology insights they can’t find anywhere else. Here you’ll enjoy a collaborative work environment supporting some of the best organizations in the world. If you like working with a curious, supportive, high-performing team, then Gartner is the place for you.

When you join the Gartner Executive Partner for Chief Audit Executive team, you will experience a high-performance work environment within a company that knows no limits. Gartner Executive Partners serve as trusted advisors to our clients, who are Chief Audit Executives from organizations across all industries. This is a brand new product and a very exciting time to join the organization.

About this role: Our clients, Chief Audit Executives or the senior-most individuals responsible for Internal Audit, find themselves challenged with the pace of change impacting the Audit function and their respective organizations as companies continue to adapt and shift their business models to move faster and grow their companies in a rapidly evolving risk environment. With the support of their Executive Partner, our Gartner for CAE clients more adeptly align their audit priorities to the organization’s most critical objectives and deliver the assurance needed to help the organization more confidently achieve its objectives and manage risks. As an Executive Partner, you will have the opportunity to deliver solutions for the most critical audit and oversight challenges facing companies across all industries.

Partnering with our clients means that no two days are the same; you could be supporting the development of the overall audit department strategy and long-term vision, providing recommendations on assessing audit department productivity and capacity and creating performance metrics and budgets, advising on the audit function’s effective use of technology (including AI), or helping the CAE increase audit’s impact on the business. Clients will also look to you for advice and support on working more closely with the Audit Committee and the broader Board, CEO, and the rest of the management team on critical business goals and risks, communicating the value of the audit function, and establishing effective governance and oversight processes. You will support clients as they work to provide assurance over emerging risks to the company and support the Audit Committee in performing their oversight role. Gartner for CAE EPs serve as accountability partners through delivery of Gartner research insights and personal experiences/expertise on key initiatives, priorities, and strategies of their CAE clients.

What You’ll Do

  • Provide executive advisory services to CAE members who work across all industries and business models.
  • Synthesize Gartner insights and data to deliver world class advisory support through ongoing bi-weekly client engagement and periodic client working sessions. The ability and willingness to operate independently to adapt materials fit for client use is required.
  • Host, facilitate, and/or participate in periodic client activities, including working sessions to develop strategy, peer roundtables, sessions and client meetings at the annual conference and virtual webinars. These activities may be delivered virtually or on-site depending on circumstance.
  • Define and deliver innovative solutions by assessing client needs and developing a customized value plan in accordance with overall Executive Program strategy and product deliverables.
  • Facilitate member interaction and peer collaboration through the Gartner for Audit member community portal and assisted member connections.
  • Work as a collaborative Gartner team member serving clients in conjunction with Client Support Professionals and Account Executives.
  • Participate in all phases of the client lifecycle: pre-sale, on-boarding, relationship management, delivery, review, and renewal.
  • While you will not be responsible for creating content, you will be partnering with Business and Technology Insights (BTI) Analysts to help identify potential gaps in material that is relevant and valuable to our clients.
  • There will be a considerable focus on sales enablement in this role. You are responsible for client retention and for contributing to account growth through direct support of Gartner Sales Associates:
  • Working with the sales teams to help them understand the true value of the Guided Product to the client vs the Self-Directed product.
  • Building their confidence and ability to effectively engage with and sell to this level of C-suite prospect.
  • Through the creation of Value Stories, enable the sales associates to bring the service to life.
  • You will be partnering with sales on account planning / development activities as well as being present in proof-of-concept (POC) engagements with prospective clients.

What You’ll Need

  • The Executive Partner will be an accomplished Chief Audit Executive, working with the C-suite, the Audit Committee and Board of Directors and a host of stakeholders, with a broad base of expertise who has operated at a senior leadership level and driven change at all levels.
  • Deep experience working as a CAE (or the highest audit role within an organization) and at least 15+ years of experience in areas critical to leading an audit function.
  • An in-depth understanding of the Audit function and other adjacent functions, e.g., Compliance, Legal & Risk.
  • Ideally with a background across multiple industries to be able to support a wide variety of member organizations.
  • Audit or Consulting Firm experience, including client relationship management, is also highly beneficial.
  • Technologically savvy; our model is lean, and you’ll leverage AI and other tools to work quickly, including completing administrative tasks.
  • Proficient in the use of Microsoft Office suite of tools to adapt Power Points, leverage Excel Spreadsheets, and to use Word to draft client-ready materials.
  • Consulting background a plus.
  • Financial Services and Banking industry experience is a plus

Who You Are

  • Critical thinker and problem solver, demonstrating the ability to assess our clients’ situations and provide actionable, outcome-based business/technical advice as well as the ability to leverage appropriate Gartner resources to help clients achieve results.
  • Ability to build strategic internal partnerships with key roles across the organization and positively impact change
  • This role is a client-facing position that requires a high level of executive presence and ability to quickly build trust and deliver value.
  • Demonstrate superior verbal and written communication skills as well as strong facilitation and presentation and facilitation skills. Excellent communication and relationship management skills
  • Willing to work independently and handle administrative tasks.

THIS IS A REMOTE POSITION THAT CAN BE LOCATED ANYWHERE IN THE MAINLAND UNITED STATES.

Who are we?

At Gartner, Inc. (NYSE:IT), we guide the leaders who shape the world.

Our mission relies on expert analysis and bold ideas to deliver actionable, objective business and technology insights, helping enterprise leaders and their teams succeed with their mission-critical priorities.

Since our founding in 1979, we’ve grown to 20,000 associates globally who support over 13,000 client enterprises in ~90 countries and territories. We do important, interesting and substantive work that matters. That’s why we hire associates with the intellectual curiosity, energy and drive to want to make a difference. The bar is unapologetically high. So is the impact you can have here.

What makes Gartner a great place to work?

Our vast, virtually untapped market potential offers limitless opportunities – opportunities that may not even exist right now – for you to grow professionally and flourish personally. How far you go is driven by your passion and performance.

We hire remarkable people who collaborate and win as a team. Together, our singular, unifying goal is to deliver results for our clients.

Our teams are inclusive and composed of individuals from different geographies, cultures, religions, ethnicities, races, genders, sexual orientations, abilities and generations.

We invest in great leaders who bring out the best in you and the company, enabling us to multiply our impact and results. This is why, year after year, we are recognized worldwide as a great place to work.

Gartner is the world authority on AI

At Gartner, you’ll join a company at the very center of the AI revolution. Gartner has proactive, objective guidance throughout clients’ AI journeys. We set the standard for how organizations leverage artificial intelligence to drive meaningful impact. You’ll have access to unmatched resources, expertise, and technology, and play a key role in helping Gartner and our clients innovate and grow as we leverage AI to transform business and technology landscapes.

It’s an exciting time to be at Gartner, with limitless opportunities to make a real impact, grow your skills, and build a lasting, meaningful career in a field that’s reshaping the way we operate. If you’re passionate about AI and want to be part of a team that’s guiding the leaders who shape the world, Gartner is the place for you.

What do we offer?

Gartner offers world-class benefits, highly competitive compensation and disproportionate rewards for top performers.

In our hybrid work environment, we provide the flexibility and support for you to thrive — working virtually when it's productive to do so and getting together with colleagues in a vibrant community that is purposeful, engaging and inspiring.

Ready to grow your career with Gartner? Join us.

Gartner believes in fair and equitable pay. A reasonable estimate of the base salary range for this role is 188,000 USD - 225,000 USD. Please note that actual salaries may vary within the range, or be above or below the range, based on factors including, but not limited to, education, training, experience, professional achievement, business need, and location. In addition to base salary, employees will participate in either an annual bonus plan based on company and individual performance, or a role-based, uncapped sales incentive plan. Our talent acquisition team will provide the specific opportunity on our bonus or incentive programs to eligible candidates. We also offer market leading benefit programs including generous PTO, a 401k match up to $7,200 per year, the opportunity to purchase company stock at a discount, and more.

Instead of integrating merchant by merchant, we integrate once into a platform merchants already use, and every merchant on that platform becomes reachable through that single integration. This role is responsible for:

This includes taking product ownership of Affirm's existing vertical software partnerships, and growing the broader portfolio of platform partners still being stood up.

  • Partner Acceleration Strategy - building the durable capabilities that make every future partner integration faster to launch and easier to scale, rather than solving the same problem one partner at a time.

As a Senior Product Manager, you will work closely with cross-functional teams including commercial, merchant risk, design, product analytics, and engineering to define, launch and grow integrations with platform partners. Effective stakeholder management and ability to successfully navigate organizational dynamics are a must for success. You should be outcomes-driven with a very high bias for action.

  • Develop success metrics/OKRs to measure the effectiveness of these initiatives.
  • Partner with commercial and product marketing teams to develop go-to-market strategies for new partner integrations and features.

What We Look For

  • Proven ability to multiple technical software products from kickoff to post-launch, driving meaningful business impact you can clearly articulate.
  • Skilled in cross-functional collaboration — diving into technical details with engineers, iterating with designers in Figma, and analyzing funnel performance with data analysts.
  • Strong organizational and communication skills to navigate complex dynamics and drive alignment.
  • Execution-oriented with a proactive approach to overcoming obstacles and blockers.

  • Comfortable engaging in the commercial aspects of product development, including representing the product externally, setting expectations, and influencing outcomes that benefit both Affirm and its partners.

jobs.description:
Steer offers a suite of software tools for today's automotive repair shop. We combine a mix of software tools that a repair shop needs to run a highly profitable shop, in one user-friendly, cost-effective platform. Through the Steer suite, we allow the shop owner to get back to focusing on what matters, and to stop worrying about marketing and customer retention.

Steer began as an online directory for drivers to find a local mechanic. Fast forward to today, Steer has launched a complete Customer Relationship Management (CRM) marketing suite, complete with text messaging, email automation, direct mail integration, reputation management, appointment reminders, declined/recommended services, and many other features. We are always innovating and we are proud to be a leader in the automotive repair industry. In August 2024 Steer acquired AutoOps - the leader in modern, intelligent, and fully integrated scheduling software for auto repair shops. AutoOps allows customers to smoothly schedule through a shop's website and Google Business Profile.

About the Role

As a Partner Operations Manager you will help operationalize and scale Steer’s rapidly growing partner ecosystem across the automotive aftermarket—including parts/tire suppliers, shop management systems, marketing platforms, AI providers, and enterprise repair networks. Reporting directly to the Sr. Director of Partnerships, your mission is to turn strategic partner relationships into repeatable, high-performing growth engines. You will own the operational execution of our channel programs, integrations, and Directory-as-a-Service (DaaS) initiatives, ensuring our internal teams and external partners are aligned for long-term success.

This role is 100% remote and available to US-based candidates.

You Are

  • An Ecosystem Operator: Highly organized and process-driven, you thrive on turning complex inputs from partners, product teams, and industry trends into clear, actionable operational plans.
  • A Collaborative Relationship Builder: You build deep trust with external partners and internal teams, taking time to understand mutual incentives and driving win-win outcomes.
  • An Automotive & Tech Translator: You speak the language of the automotive aftermarket and seamlessly translate technical and strategic concepts so partners and internal teams can easily execute.
  • A Scale-Minded Project Manager: You enjoy managing multiple cross-functional initiatives at once, taking ownership of the details that help turn high-level partnerships into tangible business results.

You Will

  • Scale Partner Program Operations: Own end-to-end partner reporting (enrollments, incentives, and performance), coordinate announcements, manage enablements/assets, and streamline billing alongside RevOps and HubSpot teams.
  • Drive Directory-as-a-Service (DaaS) Execution: Manage shop eligibility data, partner locator onboarding, and activation tracking, while coordinating cross-functionally with Sales, CS, and Marketing to convert partner-generated leads.
  • Coordinate Integration Ecosystems: Manage day-to-day integration partner communications, align Product and Engineering teams on launch readiness, support beta testing, and maintain internal integration documentation.
  • Manage Tech & Service Relationships: Act as the primary operational lead for marketing, loyalty, AI voice, and coaching partners—overseeing onboarding, issue resolution, and joint execution.
  • Enable Internal Teams: Ensure Sales and Customer Success have the resources, collateral, and knowledge required to support and close partner-driven opportunities.

You Have

Must Have

  • Industry & Ecosystem Experience: 4–7 years in partnerships, channel operations, or ecosystem management within the automotive aftermarket (automotive tech, repair SaaS, distribution, or repair networks).
  • Domain Knowledge: Deep understanding of how independent repair shops operate, evaluate software, acquire customers, and purchase parts.
  • Cross-Functional Project Management: Proven ability to coordinate complex, multi-party initiatives across Sales, CS, Product, Marketing, and RevOps.
  • Operations & Systems Acumen: Strong organizational skills with hands-on experience using CRMs and reporting tools (HubSpot preferred).

Nice to Have

  • SaaS & Integration Familiarity: Direct experience with repair shop management systems, automotive SaaS integrations, or technology ecosystems.

Join Steer to be part of a forward-thinking, flexible, and collaborative culture where you are empowered to do meaningful and impactful work.

jobs.title: Staff Salesforce Architect
jobs.excerpt: As Salesforce Architect, you will be the technical backbone of Marqeta's Business Systems team, a lean, high-impact group that serves as the internal Salesforce platform team for Go-To-Market (GTM), Product Support, and Legal, Risk & Compliance (LRC).
jobs.description:
As Salesforce Architect, you will be the technical backbone of Marqeta's Business Systems team, a lean, high-impact group that serves as the internal Salesforce platform team for Go-To-Market (GTM), Product Support, and Legal, Risk & Compliance (LRC). This is a heavily hands-on lead individual contributor role, you will be writing code, configuring the platform, and directly solving hard technical and business problems, not just producing designs for others to build.

We are looking for someone who has genuinely operated as an architect, owning architecture decisions, tradeoffs, and their consequences for at least 2 years, not an engineer aspiring to grow into the title. You will set the architectural direction for our Salesforce platform, conduct code reviews, lead architecture and design sessions, build and maintain the technical backlog, proactively identify gaps in systems and processes, and independently drive solutions to completion. You will also be a hands-on builder: configuring, coding, and deploying complex solutions across Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, and our ongoing migration from CPQ to Revenue Cloud. You will drive our Agentforce and AI strategy, own integrations with critical systems like Ironclad, Intacct, and the broader GTM toolchain, and play a lead role in ongoing security hardening of the Salesforce org.

Your work will directly support strategic company-wide initiatives, improve customer experience, and increase productivity for internal users across GTM, support, and compliance functions.

We work Flexible First. This role can be performed remotely in the United States, only in one of our National locations, which you can review here.

The Impact You'll Have

Architecture & Design

  • Own end-to-end Salesforce architecture across Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, and Revenue Cloud (including our active CPQ → Revenue Cloud migration)
  • Lead architecture and design sessions, producing clear design documents, solution options, and tradeoff analyses
  • Author and maintain coding and design standards for SFDC and ecosystem applications.
  • Conduct thorough code reviews and enforce engineering best practices, security standards, and declarative-first design principles
  • Build and maintain the technical backlog—translating platform observations, stakeholder needs, and audit findings into well-scoped engineering work
  • Proactively identify gaps in system design, data integrity, automation, and integrations; propose and deliver solutions before they become incidents
  • Conduct regular Org Health Assessments and define a continuous improvement roadmap for platform quality, security, and performance
  • Own Salesforce release management pipeline, sandbox strategy, source code control, CI/CD tooling and assessment ensuring clean, auditable deployments

Development & Delivery

  • Design, build, test, and deploy solutions in an Agile framework using Apex, Lightning Web Components, Flows, REST/SOAP APIs, and platform events
  • Lead the technical design and implementation of Agentforce and AI-powered automation across GTM, customer support, and compliance workflows
  • Design and build integrations with internal and external systems, including Ironclad (CLM), Snowflake, and other GTM/RevOps tooling
  • Define testing strategy, write test scripts, and execute tests to meet quality and coverage standards across releases
  • Maintain high sprint velocity while upholding code quality and documentation standards

Security & Platform Hardening

  • Own hands-on remediation of Salesforce security findings across the full spectrum, session/certificate hardening, sharing model and default access control fixes, data exposure and classification gaps, public link/OAuth and connected app governance, and secure-coding fixes (SOQL injection, XSS, hardcoded credentials, sharing violations) surfaced by code scans
  • Leverage Salesforce Shield Event Monitoring to capture and analyze login, API, and transaction logs moving from passive log collection to proactive threat detection, anomaly alerts, and audit-ready reporting
  • Design for appropriate data classification, access controls, and auditability across compliance-critical Salesforce objects
  • Evaluate and implement platform monitoring/SSPM tooling recommendations, working cross-functionally with security and compliance stakeholders
  • Implement and maintain the org's backup and recovery solution including configuring backup schedules, monitoring job health, and running restore/recovery procedures when needed

Technical Leadership & Collaboration

  • Provide technical mentorship and guidance to junior and mid-level engineers on the Business Systems team
  • Partner with the Engineering Manager to scope, estimate, and prioritize platform work
  • Translate complex business requirements from GTM, LRC, and Product Support into well-architected, scalable Salesforce solutions
  • Communicate technical tradeoffs and architecture decisions clearly to non-technical stakeholders
  • Lead stakeholder demos and participate in Agile ceremonies including standups, sprint planning, and retrospectives

Who You Are

  • 10+ years of Salesforce technical experience spanning development, configuration and architecture, including at least 2 years functioning in an actual Architect capacity with a strong, defensible point of view on technical direction(owning architecture decisions and their outcomes)
  • Deep hands-on experience with Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and Experience Cloud
  • Experience with Revenue Cloud or a strong CPQ background with a demonstrated path toward Revenue Cloud migration work
  • Proficiency in Apex, Lightning Web Components, Flows, REST/SOAP APIs, and platform events
  • Direct experience leading or heavily contributing to a Salesforce security hardening effort
  • Proven experience conducting code reviews and enforcing engineering best practices on a platform team
  • Demonstrated ability to build and manage a technical backlog translating org health findings, stakeholder requests, and architectural gaps into actionable engineering work
  • Experience proactively identifying system and process gaps and driving solutions to completion without requiring explicit direction
  • Experience architecting and building integrations with external systems (CLM, ERP, data platforms, or similar)
  • Familiarity with Agentforce, Einstein AI, or other Salesforce AI/automation capabilities
  • Excellent communication skills, able to engage credibly with both engineers and senior business stakeholders
  • Ability to reliably prioritize and complete work independently with minimal supervision

Nice-To-Haves

  • Salesforce Certified Technical Architect (CTA) or Application/System Architect credentials or equivalent demonstrated architect-level experience
  • Experience with SSPM/security monitoring tooling (e.g. Falcon Shield, Reco) or Salesforce Shield (Event Monitoring, Field Audit Trail)
  • Salesforce Revenue Cloud or CPQ Specialist certification
  • Experience with Ironclad or other CLM platforms
  • Experience with Tableau, Snowflake, Looker, or similar data platforms in a Salesforce integration context

Compensation and Benefits

Marqeta is a Flex First company which allows you to choose your best working environment, whether that be from home or at a company office. To support Flex First, we calibrate pay to a competitive value according to working location. Compensation is aligned according to three tiers within the United States:

  • National: A baseline tier that applies to most of the geographic territory of the United States.
  • Premium: Slightly elevated from the National tier, and oriented toward a narrower set of higher cost-of-living areas, such as Los Angeles CA and Seattle WA
  • Premium Plus: A tier for the most expensive working areas, like the San Francisco Bay area and New York City.

Visit this page or consult with a Recruiter to determine which tier would be applicable to you.

When determining salaries, we consider several factors including, but not limited to, skills, prior experience, and work location. The new-hire base salary range for this position is:

  • National: 138,100 - 172,600

We also believe in recognizing the contributions of our people. That's why we award annual bonuses to eligible employees, rewarding both individual performance and the success of the entire company.

Along with monetary compensation, Marqeta offers

  • Multiple health insurance options
  • Flexible time off – take what you need
  • Retirement savings program with company contribution and after tax contributions
  • Equity in a publicly-traded company and an Employee Stock Purchase Program
  • Family-forming benefits, fertility support, and up to 20 weeks of Parental Leave
  • Free therapy sessions, financial and professional coaching, and legal advice
  • Monthly stipend to support our remote work model
  • Annual “development dollars” to support our people growth and development
  • Through Flex First, the freedom to live and work wherever you and your family thrive

About Marqeta

Positions: 2 FTEs

About Emerging Tech

At Emerging Tech, we support government and public sector customers through technology, cybersecurity, and mission driven solutions. As a growing SDVOSB, 8(a), and HUBZone company, we provide our team with the opportunity to take ownership, work directly with clients and leadership, and contribute to meaningful government missions.

We’re big enough to take on meaningful government work, but still small enough that your expertise and ideas have a direct impact. If you enjoy solving complex problems, working with talented teams, and having a real role in building something that’s growing, you’ll fit right in at Emerging Tech.

Role Overview

The Senior Cybersecurity Subject Matter Expert will provide expert level technical execution and depth across cybersecurity assessment and testing activities.

This role will develop and execute advanced testing procedures, conduct controlled adversary simulations across selected stages of the cyber kill chain, validate cybersecurity controls, independently evaluate agency remediation efforts, and determine and document the root cause of detection outcomes.

One of the two positions will be designated as the Purple Team and Detection Lead, responsible for owning the technique catalog and detection gap methodology in partnership with the Technical Lead.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and execute controlled adversary simulations mapped to MITRE ATT&CK across selected kill chain stages.
  • Generate behavioral anomalies and validate whether client monitoring detects, correlates, analyzes, and escalates activity within defined thresholds.
  • Conduct access control stress testing, including password spray against lockout policies, Kerberoasting, legacy authentication bypass, privilege escalation path validation, and session and elevation expiry verification.
  • Query and analyze client SIEM content to reconcile emitted activity against observed telemetry, alerts, and analyst actions.
  • Classify non detections by root cause and document supporting evidence with synchronized timestamps.
  • Independently validate agency remediation claims, including re execution of original testing stimuli when remediation concerns detection capabilities.
  • Produce factual, timestamped findings suitable for inclusion in audit workpapers.
  • Mentor Technical Testers and review evidence packages for completeness, accuracy, and sufficiency.

Required Technical Skills

  • Deep expertise in adversary simulation, kill chain testing, behavioral anomaly generation, and detection validation aligned with MITRE ATT&CK.
  • Hands on proficiency querying at least one major SIEM platform, including Splunk SPL, Microsoft Sentinel KQL, or Elastic.
  • Experience assessing detection content coverage and log source completeness.
  • Strong technical knowledge of SIEM platforms, endpoint detection and response systems, network monitoring tools, and cloud native security controls.
  • Expertise assessing logging, alerting, escalation, and monitoring effectiveness from initial sensor activity through analyst action.
  • Advanced knowledge of Active Directory, Kerberos, Group Policy Objects, identity governance, and privilege management, including Active Directory Certificate Services misconfiguration classes.
  • Experience conducting penetration testing, vulnerability assessments, web application reviews, API testing, and cloud security assessments.
  • Proficiency across Microsoft Azure, Microsoft 365, AWS, and hybrid enterprise environments.
  • Ability to evaluate compliance with NIST CSF and state cybersecurity requirements, including Rule 60GG-2, F.A.C.
  • Experience analyzing remediation plans and independently validating corrective actions.
  • Ability to develop detailed root cause analyses and evidence based recommendations.
  • Experience performing forensic log reviews, incident reconstruction, and security event analysis.
  • Disciplined evidence handling, including synchronized timestamping, reproducible procedures, and defensible chain of custody.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience in cybersecurity assessment, penetration testing, cyber defense operations, or security architecture.
  • Demonstrated hands on adversary emulation or purple team experience in enterprise environments.
  • Proven experience validating detection and response capabilities, not solely verifying control configuration.
  • Experience producing technical findings that have withstood external audit, regulatory, or client quality review.

• Must reside in the state of Florida.

Certifications

Required:

Two certifications are mandatory at hire and are a condition of assignment.

One of the following:

  • CISSP

• CISA

And at least one of the following hands on technical certifications:

  • OSCP

• CRTO

• GPEN

  • GCIA
    • GCIH
    • GCDA

• GCPN

Preferred:

  • CEH

• SC-200

• GCFA

  • GXPN
    • AWS Security Specialty

• Azure Security Specialty

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience testing in multi tenant or federated government environments.
  • Detection content authoring experience in Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, or Elastic.
  • Prior experience supporting government cybersecurity programs or independent assessment functions.

Working Conditions

This is a remote position for Florida based candidates. The Tallahassee metro area, within approximately 50 miles, is preferred.

The role requires significant technical coordination with government stakeholders and cybersecurity teams across multiple testing environments and concurrent engagements.

The MSL will need to be fully engaged with pertinent professional societies, as well as other value-based institutions and associations including clinics and centers that are involved with the treatment of solid tumors, beginning with urologists, radiation and medical oncologists treating locally advanced prostate cancer. The MSL will be the field based scientific expert regarding our client’s products.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Function as the primary medical point of contact in geographic area.
  • Maintain clinical and scientific expertise in oncology with specific focus in standards of care related to the treatment of locally advanced prostate cancer and other solid tumors.

  • Develop and track key opinion leader (KOL) engagement plans - identify, develop, and maintain long-term collaborative relationships with KOLs within assigned region.

Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. Participation is project-based, not permanent employment.What this opportunity involves:
We're building a dataset to evaluate AI coding agents - how well a model handles real-world developer tasks.

You'll create challenging tasks and evaluation criteria within realistic simulated environments:

  • Build realistic developer environments - a virtual company with codebase, infrastructure, and context (tickets, docs, conversations) that forms a believable development history
  • Design tasks from intermediate states of these environments - craft the prompt, define what "solved" means, and ensure the task is solvable by an AI agent
  • Write tests that verify agent solutions - accept all valid approaches and reject incorrect ones, neither too strict nor too lenient
  • Iterate on tasks and tests based on QA feedback - review agent solutions, analyze failures, and refine until the evaluation is fair and robust

What this is NOT:

  • Not data labeling
  • Not prompt engineering
  • Not writing code from scratch - the agent writes most of the code; you guide and evaluate

What we look for:

  • 8+ years in software development
  • Core stack: Python (FastAPI), JavaScript/TypeScript (React), Docker, Postgres, Kafka, Redis
  • Experience writing tests (functional, integration)
  • English proficiency - B2+

Why this is hard:
Frontier models are already good at coding. Creating a task that genuinely challenges the best models is non-trivial. You need to deeply understand where models fail and what scenarios reveal the difference between a good and a bad solution. Tasks have many valid solutions - writing tests that accept all correct solutions and reject incorrect ones is harder than it sounds.

Apply → Pass qualification(s) → Join a project → Complete tasks → Get paidEffort estimate

  • Client Deliverables: Partner with clients to identify key business objectives and ensure the high-quality, strategic output of all client deliverables.

  • Value Realization: Ensure the team understands and communicates the ROI of their services, positioning themselves as expert guides rather than just technical resources.

  • Confidence & Ownership: Empower consultants to own client outcomes. Shift the team away from escalating all friction to management, coaching them instead to lead difficult conversations and present solutions directly to the client.

  • Solution-Oriented Delivery: Train the team to not only identify risks and problems but to immediately pair those findings with viable, expert-led solutions.

This role is a fit for you if...

  • You have 5+ years of progressive experience in professional services, implementation, or consulting, preferably within a SaaS or enterprise software environment.

  • You have 3+ years of direct experience managing a team of professional services consultants, project managers, or technical resources.

  • You have demonstrated ability to define and implement consulting methodologies that prioritize best practices, deep subject matter expertise, drive efficiency, and reduce scope creep.

  • You have exceptional leadership, coaching, and performance management skills with a strong track record of developing high-performing teams.

What we offer...

  • Optional from DAY ONE - Private Medical Coverage & Ride to Work Scheme
  • Unlimited Vacation

Bullhorn's core purpose is to create an incredible customer experience, and the organization has a sharp focus on delivering very high quality products and services to its customers. The company culture is shaped by five Core Values: Ownership, Energy, Speed & Agility, Service, and Being Human. Each value, and its underlying definition, serves as a behavioral guide for employees as they interact with customers and fellow coworkers and is an embedded way of operating across our organization.

We are a people-first culture where everyone’s contribution is valued and respected. We're looking for smart, forward-thinking individuals who aren't afraid to challenge the status quo and bring fresh perspectives to the table. If you're someone who thrives in a casual, yet fast-paced and agile environment, we'd love to have you join us.

Remote, US

Global Sales – Regular Full-Time / Remote

Build What Matters at Model N

At Model N, we help life sciences companies solve complex revenue challenges so they can operate smarter and bring important innovations to market faster. We are looking for people who value practical problem-solving, cross-functional collaboration, and delivering measurable customer impact.

If you are energized by navigating complex 340B regulatory and operational challenges, building trusted customer relationships, and driving revenue growth through consultative selling, this could be a great fit.

About the Role

We are seeking a Global Account Manager specializing in 340B Strategic Solutions to drive new customer acquisition and strategic account expansion within our 340B and Gross-to-Net portfolio.

Reporting to the Vice President of Strategic Accounts, you will manage a portfolio of strategic enterprise pharmaceutical and life sciences accounts, lead complex consultative sales cycles with healthcare executives and C-suite stakeholders, and serve as a trusted advisor helping customers optimize their 340B programs and Gross-to-Net revenue management.

You will work closely with Product, Solutions Engineering, and Customer Success to position Model N’s Truzo platform as the modern solution for 340B program administration and analytics, while building the pipeline and executing the commercial strategy to support Model N’s market growth objectives in this critical segment.

This is an ideal role if: - You have deep expertise in the 340B program and regulatory environment - You understand the business pressures facing pharmaceutical manufacturers in government pricing and programs - You can sell complex technology solutions through consultative, value-based selling to regulated enterprise accounts - You thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment and want to shape a market category

What You’ll Do

  • Lead 340B-focused new customer acquisition – Identify, pursue, and close enterprise pharmaceutical and life sciences customers looking to modernize their 340B program management and Gross-to-Net capabilities
  • Drive strategic account expansion – Expand wallet share within existing 340B customers through upsell, cross-sell, and adoption initiatives; serve as the primary executive relationship owner for complex accounts
  • Develop consultative sales strategies – Build and execute strategic commercial plans that address customer business challenges (program compliance, pricing accuracy, operational efficiency, regulatory risk)
  • Lead complex enterprise sales cycles – Navigate multi-stakeholder environments involving 340B program directors, finance, legal, compliance, market access, and executive leadership; handle complex negotiations and commercial discussions
  • Build trusted customer relationships – Establish and cultivate relationships with senior stakeholders across program management, commercial, finance, legal, and operations to promote solution adoption and value realization
  • Execute disciplined pipeline management – Maintain accurate pipeline and account data in Salesforce; establish clear forecasting and ensure consistent visibility into deal progress and customer engagement
  • Meet revenue targets – Consistently achieve or exceed pipeline development and bookings targets in line with Model N’s 340B commercial strategy
  • Collaborate cross-functionally – Partner with Solutions Engineering, Product, Marketing, and Customer Success to deliver customer value, incorporate market feedback into product roadmap, and strengthen 340B market positioning
  • Lead strategic customer engagements – Co-lead quarterly business reviews and strategic planning sessions with enterprise customers; position Model N as a thought leader in 340B program optimization
  • Advocate for customers – Communicate customer needs, competitive threats, and regulatory trends internally to inform product development and go-to-market priorities
  • Utilize Model N’s sales methodology – Apply “Model N Way” sales processes, tools, and disciplines; adopt and leverage AI tools to enhance productivity and decision-making

What We're Looking For

    Required Qualifications

    • 5+ years in enterprise software/SaaS sales with a proven quota-carrying track record and demonstrated success closing large enterprise deals
    • Deep expertise in the U.S. 340B program – Comprehensive understanding of 340B program mechanics, compliance requirements, pricing calculations, entity eligibility, and regulatory environment; ability to speak fluently with 340B program directors and senior pharmacy executives
    • Experience selling complex enterprise solutions – Proven track record selling sophisticated technology platforms (ERP, Quote-to-Cash, analytics, or compliance systems) into regulated healthcare environments
    • Strong background in life sciences sales – Experience selling to large pharmaceutical manufacturers, healthcare wholesalers, or healthcare service providers; understanding of pharma business models, pricing pressures, and government programs (Medicaid, Medicare, FSS, etc.)
    • Consultative and value-based selling skills – Expertise with MEDDPICC, solution selling, or similar methodologies; ability to diagnose customer business problems and position solutions as strategic investments
    • Executive presence and negotiation skills – Comfortable engaging with C-suite and senior leaders; strong communication, active listening, and negotiation abilities
    • Salesforce proficiency – Ability to maintain accurate CRM discipline, manage pipeline data, and utilize tools for forecasting and account planning
    • Strong work ethic and accountability – Demonstrated ability to work independently, manage complex accounts, and consistently meet or exceed targets in a fast-paced, matrixed environment
    • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience

      • Preferred Qualifications

      • Direct 340B program experience – Prior experience working within a 340B program (as a program director, compliance officer, or pharmacy leader) or selling directly into 340B programs
      • Gross-to-Net or pricing expertise – Background in Gross-to-Net programs, rebate management, or revenue optimization in pharmaceutical companies
      • Healthcare IT or SaaS background – Sales or operational experience in healthcare software, compliance platforms, or data analytics
      • Experience in regulated markets – Prior track record selling into highly regulated healthcare, pharmaceutical, or financial services environments
      • Generative AI tools adoption – Demonstrated experience using ChatGPT, Copilot, Claude, Gemini, or similar tools to improve productivity and decision-making

        • What Success Looks Like

        In Your First 90 Days

        • Build relationships with key 340B customers, internal stakeholders, and cross-functional partners
        • Develop a strong understanding of Model N’s 340B value proposition, competitive positioning, and Truzo platform capabilities
        • Assess current account strategies, sales pipeline, and growth opportunities in 340B segment
        • Establish clear operating rhythms for pipeline management, forecasting, and account planning aligned with the VP’s commercial strategy

          • In Your First 6-12 Months

          • Deliver measurable progress against 340B revenue and bookings targets
          • Build a healthy pipeline of enterprise 340B opportunities and advance deals through sales cycles
          • Expand relationships with key pharmaceutical and life sciences accounts in the 340B space
          • Improve platform adoption and customer success outcomes within strategic 340B accounts
          • Strengthen alignment across Commercial, Product, Solutions Engineering, and Customer Success on 340B market positioning

How You Will Grow and Make an Impact

At Model N, our competency model helps define growth and success:

  • Problem-Solving Leadership – Solve complex customer and market challenges that accelerate 340B modernization and revenue growth
  • Thought Leadership – Develop expertise in 340B market trends, regulatory developments, and solution trends; shape conversations with customers and internally
  • Operational Leadership – Demonstrate discipline in pipeline management, forecasting, and account planning; model accountability and rigor
  • Consultative Sales Excellence – Become a trusted advisor to pharmaceutical manufacturers on 340B program optimization and risk management
  • AI Leadership – Leverage generative AI tools to improve research, sales productivity, customer insights, and decision-making

How We Work

Our values—DREAM, ALIGN, RESPECT, and EXCEL—shape how we work together:

  • We solve practical problems that matter to our customers and teams
  • We work across functions and value clear, respectful communication
  • We recognize good work and support growth over time
  • We are curious about better ways to work, including thoughtful use of AI and modern tools

Compensation, Benefits, and Inclusion

At Model N, your well-being and growth matter. That’s why we offer a robust total rewards package designed to help you thrive personally and professionally.

Our benefits include:

  • Unlimited PTO for salaried employees—because flexibility fuels success
  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Health Savings & Flexible Spending Accounts
  • 401(k) with company match to invest in your future
  • Volunteer Time Off (VTO) to give back to causes you care about
  • Life and pet insurance for peace of mind
  • Employee Assistance & Mental Health Programs
  • Charitable giving opportunities
  • Professional coaching and career development

…and much more.

At Model N we offer fair, equitable and competitive salary ranges for all positions. Compensation varies depending on factors that may include a candidate’s relevant experience, education and/or certifications, location, training, and other skills.

The base salary for this position will be $160,000 - $185,000. If your salary expectations are outside of this range, feel free to apply and discuss your expectations with our recruiters. We are constantly opening new positions and you might match another opening at a different level.

About Model N

Model N is the leader in revenue optimization and compliance for pharmaceutical, medtech, and high-tech innovators. For more than 25 years, we have helped customers maximize revenue, streamline operations, and maintain compliance through cloud-based software, value-added services, and data-driven insights. With a focus on innovation and customer success, Model N empowers life sciences and high-tech manufacturers to bring life-changing products to the world more efficiently and profitably. Model N is trusted by over 150 of the world’s leading companies across more than 120 countries. For more information, visit .

jobs.description:
Business Unit:

Cubic Transportation Systems

Company Details:

When you join Cubic, you become part of a company that creates and delivers technology solutions in transportation to make people’s lives easier by simplifying their daily journeys, and defense capabilities to help promote mission success and safety for those who serve their nation. Led by our talented teams around the world, Cubic is committed to solving global issues through innovation and service to our customers and partners.

We have a top-tier portfolio of businesses, including Cubic Transportation Systems (CTS) and Cubic Defense (CD). Explore more on Cubic.com.

Job Details:

Job Summary

The Customer Success Operations Senior Program Manager is an experienced individual contributor responsible for leading and executing complex, high-impact operational programs across the Customer Success organization and its cross-functional partners. Reporting to the Customer Success Operations Senior Manager, this role operates with a higher degree of autonomy than a Program Manager, owning more complex program portfolios, driving strategic improvement initiatives, and providing informal guidance to less experienced team members.

The Senior Program Manager is a subject matter authority on how Customer Success operates, using that expertise to design better processes, elevate reporting quality, and drive cross-functional alignment across Global Tech Ops, Financial Services, Data Analytics, and Business Operations. This role is accountable for ensuring that the programs it owns deliver measurable outcomes and that the operational standards they produce are adopted, embedded, and sustained across the organization.

Key Responsibilities

Senior Program Ownership & Execution

  • Own end-to-end execution of a portfolio of complex operational programs, managing scope, milestones, dependencies, risks, and deliverables with a high degree of independence.
  • Lead programs that span multiple functions, regions, or workstreams, maintaining clarity on priorities and driving timely resolution of blockers and risks.
  • Anticipate issues before they escalate; develop and execute mitigation plans and bring recommendations rather than just problems to the Senior Manager.
  • Serve as a senior point of continuity for programs, ensuring context, history, and progress are well-documented and transferable.
  • Contribute to the definition of program scope and objectives, not just execution of defined plans.

Process Design & Operational Standards

  • Design, build, and improve core operational processes, playbooks, SOPs, and governance frameworks for assigned program areas, with a focus on scalability and long-term adoption.
  • Identify patterns across programs and functions that point to systemic process gaps; propose and lead improvement initiatives that address root causes, not just symptoms.
  • Ensure process documentation is accurate, accessible, and actively used rather than archived; lead periodic reviews to keep materials current.
  • Act as a senior voice in shaping how Customer Success standardizes its ways of working, contributing to decisions that affect the broader team.

Reporting, Governance & Insights

  • Produce high-quality operational reporting for assigned programs, including performance metrics, risk summaries, trend analysis, and actionable insights for leadership.
  • Lead preparation of Monthly Operating Review (MOR) materials and other governance inputs, ensuring pre-reads are data-accurate, narrative-strong, and decision-ready.
  • Identify opportunities to improve the quality, consistency, and efficiency of reporting across the team; bring recommendations to the Senior Manager.
  • Track and drive cross-functional action items through to closure, maintaining accountability at the right levels and escalating delays with context and proposed resolution.

Cross-Functional Coordination & Influence

  • Lead cross-functional working groups and coordination forums for assigned programs, driving decision-making, clear ownership, and follow-through.
  • Build trusted working relationships with counterparts in Global Tech Ops, Financial Services, Data Analytics, and Business Operations; use those relationships to remove friction and accelerate outcomes.
  • Represent Customer Success Operations credibly in cross-functional discussions, bringing both operational knowledge and strategic context to the conversation.
  • Identify misalignments between functions early and work to resolve them proactively, escalating to the Senior Manager where needed.

Enablement & Team Contribution

  • Develop and maintain onboarding materials, training content, and learning paths for CS roles, ensuring content reflects current processes, tools, and standards.
  • Provide informal guidance and support to Program Managers on their programs, sharing expertise and helping less experienced team members develop their skills.
  • Lead the rollout of new processes and tools within the team, including preparing enablement materials, running sessions, and tracking adoption.
  • Contribute to the broader team's ways of working, bringing ideas for improvement and supporting a culture of continuous learning.

Customer-Facing & Executive Support

  • Lead preparation of customer-facing reporting packages and QBR inputs for assigned programs, ensuring materials are consistent, data-backed, and aligned with agreed KPIs.
  • Support CS leaders and SDMs in preparing for customer operational forums and executive briefings, providing accurate operational context and analysis.
  • Contribute to operational updates presented at leadership and customer level as directed, with the ability to present independently where appropriate.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Operations, Information Technology, or a related discipline (or equivalent experience)
  • 10+ years' experience in program management, operations, or service delivery roles within complex, matrixed organizations
  • Demonstrated ability to independently manage complex, cross-functional programs from initiation through to closure with measurable outcomes
  • Experience designing and implementing operational processes, governance frameworks, and reporting standards at scale
  • Strong working knowledge of ITIL practices or structured service delivery frameworks
  • Proficient in program tracking tools, reporting platforms, and productivity suites (e.g., Excel/Sheets, PowerPoint, project management tools)
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills; experienced in preparing governance materials and presenting to senior stakeholders
  • Comfortable operating with autonomy and making sound judgments in ambiguous situations

Preferred Experience

  • Experience in transit, payments, public-sector technology, or high-availability managed services environments
  • Familiarity with FinOps concepts, cost-to-serve analysis, or P&L reporting in a services context
  • Exposure to CRM platforms (e.g., MSD CRM), service management tools (e.g., ServiceNow), or BI/data visualization platforms
  • Experience supporting or operating within a Centre of Excellence (CoE) model
  • Background working across NAM, EMEA, and APAC teams in a global organization

Personal Attributes

  • Deeply organized: manages a complex program portfolio without losing precision on details, deadlines, or follow-through.
  • Proactive and solutions-oriented: identifies risks and improvement opportunities early and brings structured recommendations to resolve them.
  • Collaborative and credible: builds strong cross-functional relationships and earns trust through consistent, high-quality execution.
  • Clear communicator: writes and presents with structure and confidence; adapts easily from working-level to executive audiences.
  • Accountable and outcome-focused: takes ownership of results, not just tasks, and drives programs through to meaningful closure.

Employee

  • Effectively maintains and retains existing customers by proactively reaching out to existing customers on a daily basis
  • Develops and maintains a thorough knowledge of the Company’s available services, lines of business, pricing structures, and offers additional services as appropriate to assigned existing customers.

For any concerns relating to Republic Services’ commitment to equal opportunity employment, you may contact the AWARE Line at 1-866-3-AWARE-4.

ABOUT THE COMPANY

Republic Services, Inc. (NYSE: RSG) is a leader in the environmental services industry. We provide customers with the most complete set of products and services, including recycling, waste, special waste, hazardous waste and field services. Our industry-leading commitments to advance circularity and support decarbonization are helping deliver on our vision to partner with customers to create a more sustainable world.


In 2025, Republic’s total company revenue was $16.6 billion, and adjusted EBITDA was $5.3 billion. We serve 13 million customers and operate more than 1,000 locations, including collection and transfer stations, recycling and polymer centers, treatment facilities, and landfills.


Although we operate across North America, the collection, recycling, treatment, or disposal of materials is a local business, and the dynamics and opportunities differ in each market we serve. By combining local operational management with standardized business practices, we drive greater operating efficiencies across the company while maintaining day-to-day operational decisions at the local level, closest to the customer.


Our customers, including small businesses, major corporations and municipalities, want a partner with the expertise and capabilities to effectively manage their multiple recycling and waste streams. They choose Republic Services because we are committed to exceeding their expectations and helping them achieve their sustainability goals. Our 42,000 team members understand that it's not just what we do that matters, but how we do it.


Our company values guide our daily actions:

  • Safe: We protect the livelihoods of our colleagues and communities.
  • Committed to Serve: We go above and beyond to exceed our customers’ expectations.
  • Environmentally Responsible: We take action to improve our environment.
  • Driven: We deliver results in the right way.
  • Human-Centered: We respect the dignity and unique potential of every person.

We are proud of our high employee engagement score of 86. We have an inclusive and diverse culture where every voice counts. In addition, our team positively impacted 5.1 million people in 2024 through the Republic Services Charitable Foundation and local community grants. These projects are designed to meet the specific needs of the communities we serve, with a focus on building sustainable neighborhoods.


STRATEGY

Republic Services’ strategy is designed to generate profitable growth. Through acquisitions and industry advancements, we safely and sustainably manage our customers’ multiple waste streams through a North American footprint of vertically integrated assets.

We focus on three areas of growth to meet the increasing needs of our customers: recycling and waste, environmental solutions and sustainability innovation.

With our integrated approach, strengthening our position in one area advances other areas of our business. For example, as we grow volume in recycling and waste, we collect additional material to bolster our circularity capabilities. And as we expand environmental solutions, we drive additional opportunities to provide these services to our existing recycling and waste customers.


Recycling and Waste

We continue to expand our recycling and waste business footprint throughout North America through organic growth and targeted acquisitions. The 13 million customers we serve and our more than 5 million pick-ups per day provide us with a distinct advantage. We aggregate materials at scale, unlocking new opportunities for advanced recycling. In addition, we are cross-selling new products and services to better meet our customers’ specific needs.


Environmental Solutions

Our comprehensive environmental solutions capabilities help customers safely manage their most technical waste streams. We are expanding both our capabilities and our geographic footprint. We see strong growth opportunities for our offerings, including PFAS remediation, an increasing customer need.

Sustainability Innovation

Republic’s recent innovations to advance circularity and decarbonization demonstrate our unique ability to leverage sustainability as a platform for growth.


The Republic Services Polymer Center is the nation’s first integrated plastics recycling facility. These innovative sites process rigid plastics from our recycling centers, producing recycled materials that promote true bottle-to-bottle circularity. We also formed Blue Polymers, a joint venture with Ravago, to develop facilities that will further process plastic material from our Polymer Centers to help meet the growing demand for sustainable packaging. We are building a network of Polymer Centers and Blue Polymer facilities across North America.


Our customers are increasingly looking for decarbonization solutions, and we are leveraging our network of landfills to meet that need. Republic is committed to harnessing landfill gas, a natural byproduct of decomposing waste, and converting it to energy. Republic has partnered with renewable gas developers to construct Renewable Natural Gas (RNG) plants at our landfills, expanding beyond the 77 projects we currently have to make progress towards our goal to beneficially reuse 50% more biogas by 2030 (2017 baseline year).


RECENT RECOGNITION

  • Barron’s 100 Most Sustainable Companies
  • CDP Discloser
  • Dow Jones Best-In-Class Indices
  • Ethisphere’s World’s Most Ethical Companies
  • Fortune World’s Most Admired Companies
  • Great Place to Work
  • Sustainability Yearbook S&P Global

Responsibilities

Since 2012, Peraton and its partners have been providing full life cycle support of the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) electronic Health Records (eHR) solution. The eHR is a U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) case management system for maintaining records of medical treatment provided to individuals detained by ICE. ICE detainees receive medical, dental, and mental health evaluations and treatment necessary and appropriate for the individual’s medical condition and length of stay. The ICE Health Services Corps (IHSC) provides health evaluations, treatment, and services to ICE detainees held in detention facilities across the country. IHSC personnel use the eHR to document health care provided to these detainees. The eHR is an integrated healthcare information system comprised of several components, which record and manage detainee healthcare evaluation and treatment information as well as process claims for payments to external healthcare providers.

The Functional Lead and Health Informaticist for the DHS ICE eHR Operations & Maintenance (O&M) program is key personnel that will be responsible to support development, functionality, quality assurance, compliance, user acceptance testing, training and deployment of several eHR applications. Additionally, the candidate will be responsible to deliver on the current O&M support contract, support additional DHS ICE eHR pursuits, and any follow-on client delivery work as applicable.   • Clinical Subject Matter Expert (SME) especially in electronic Health Records and Health informatics.
  • Conduct Agile Scrum Master Activities (Meeting facilitation, Meeting Notes, Coaching, Kanban Board administration, Daily Standup, etc.).
