jobs.description:
Rithum™ is the world’s most trusted commerce network, accelerating how brands, suppliers, and retailers work together to deliver seamless e-commerce experiences. We provide an unmatched platform for brands and retailers, enabling them to accelerate growth, optimize operations across channels, scale product offerings and enhance margins.

Today, more than 40,000 companies trust Rithum to grow their business across hundreds of channels, representing over $50 billion in annual GMV. Using our commerce, marketing, and delivery solutions, our customers create optimized consumer shopping journeys from beginning to end.

Overview

As a Key Account Executive, you are a highly strategic Hunter on our Core Sales team for our Brands products. responsible for acquiring new clients and expanding Rithum’s presence across global commerce ecosystems.

This role is designed for a disciplined, high-energy sales professional who thrives on prospecting, creating pipeline, and winning new logos. The successful candidate will build meaningful relationships with Core Sales (mid-market & enterprise) brands and retailers while positioning Rithum as the operational backbone enabling scalable marketplace and commerce growth.

At Rithum, we believe growth begins with disciplined inputs. Hunters are expected to generate their own pipeline, execute structured outreach, and maintain a consistent cadence of prospecting activity that fuels predictable revenue outcomes. Successful Hunters at Rithum demonstrate consistent creation of high-quality pipeline, acquisition of strategic new logos, strong engagement with C-suite & executive buyers, ability to run complex, value-based mid-market & enterprise sales cycles, and reliable execution of disciplined prospecting routines. At Rithum, Hunters are not order-takers. They are builders of opportunity. If you thrive on creating pipeline, engaging executive buyers, and winning new logos through disciplined execution, this is the role for you!

Responsibilities

  • New Logo Acquisition

  • Value Based Selling

  • Deal Execution

    • Maintain accurate pipeline visibility and forecast integrity.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of B2B SaaS or technology field sales experience in a closing role, focused on new logo acquisition with national key accounts ($50M–$1B+ revenue).
  • Proven success managing 6+ month sales cycles, including procurement, legal, and compliance processes.
  • Documented history of closing $50K+ ACV deals, including multi-year contracts; closing $75k+ ACV deals preferred.
  • Consistent recent quota attainment (100%+ for 4+ consecutive quarters) in a competitive, metrics-driven environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to build pipeline through self-generated outbound prospecting, with measurable activity standards (e.g., 40–60+ daily touchpoints, 10+ qualified meetings per month).
  • Strong hunter mindset, with resilience and persistence in competitive environments and accountability for pipeline creation.
  • Mastery of structured sales methodologies (e.g., MEDDIC, Challenger, SPIN, Miller Heiman, Solution Selling) with evidence of pipeline progression and forecast accuracy.
  • Proven ability to sell complex platforms or solution offerings in multi-stakeholder environments.
  • Experience engaging C-suite and senior executive stakeholders to build consensus and close complex new-logo deals.
  • Strong deal strategy and negotiation skills, including pricing, ROI justification, and defending business cases with executives.
  • Ability to manage 10+ concurrent opportunities while balancing prospecting, deal progression, and strategic follow-up.
  • Exceptional executive communication and presence, including clear, persuasive verbal and written communication.
  • Disciplined use of CRM and sales tools (Salesforce preferred) and sales engagement platforms (e.g., Outreach, Salesloft, HubSpot, LinkedIn Navigator, ZoomInfo) for pipeline, activity, and conversion tracking.
  • Proven ability to collaborate cross-functionally with Marketing, Product, Client Success, and Solutions Engineering to close new business.
  • Must be located in Central or Eastern US time zones.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, or related field.
  • Experience selling into commerce, retail technology, marketplaces, or digital ecosystem platforms.
  • Experience selling into multi-division or decentralized buying environments.
  • Familiarity with partner- or channel-influenced sales motions.
  • Experience positioning data-driven or AI-powered solutions.

Travel Required

Up to 50%

Other Duties

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

What it’s like to work at Rithum

When you join Rithum, you can expect to work with smart risk-takers, courageous collaborators, and curious minds.

As part of the Rithum team, you are valued, supported, and included. Guided by a transparent culture and accessible, approachable leadership, we offer career opportunities aligned to your ambitions and talents. To ensure work and life balance works for you, we also offer an array of resources to support you and your families, including comprehensive benefits and wellness plans.

jobs.description:
Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.

Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. Participation is project-based, not permanent employment.

What this opportunity involves

We're building a dataset to evaluate AI coding agents - how well a model handles real-world developer tasks.

You'll create challenging tasks and evaluation criteria within realistic simulated environments:

  • Build realistic developer environments - a virtual company with codebase, infrastructure, and context (tickets, docs, conversations) that forms a believable development history
  • Design tasks from intermediate states of these environments - craft the prompt, define what "solved" means, and ensure the task is solvable by an AI agent
  • Write tests that verify agent solutions - accept all valid approaches and reject incorrect ones, neither too strict nor too lenient
  • Iterate on tasks and tests based on QA feedback - review agent solutions, analyze failures, and refine until the evaluation is fair and robust

What this is NOT

  • Not data labeling
  • Not prompt engineering
  • Not writing code from scratch - the agent writes most of the code; you guide and evaluate

What we look for

  • 5+ years in software development
  • Core stack: Python (FastAPI), JavaScript/TypeScript (React), Docker, Postgres, Kafka, Redis
  • Experience writing tests (functional, integration)
  • English proficiency - B2+

Why this is hard

Frontier models are already good at coding. Creating a task that genuinely challenges the best models is non-trivial. You need to deeply understand where models fail and what scenarios reveal the difference between a good and a bad solution. Tasks have many valid solutions - writing tests that accept all correct solutions and reject incorrect ones is harder than it sounds.

How it works

Apply → Pass qualification(s) → Join a project → Complete tasks → Get paid

Effort estimate

Tasks for this project are estimated to take 20 hours to complete, depending on complexity. This is an estimate and not a schedule requirement; you choose when and how to work. Tasks must be submitted by the deadline and meet the listed acceptance criteria to be accepted.

Compensation

Up to $50/hr equivalent, depending on level and pace. Tasks are estimated at ~20 hours each; you set your own schedule.

jobs.excerpt: THE ROLE 📝 As a Senior Software Engineer at Form3, you’ll work on established, high-volume services that sit at the heart of Form3’s cloud-native payment platform.
jobs.description:
THE ROLE 📝

As a Senior Software Engineer at Form3, you’ll work on established, high-volume services that sit at the heart of Form3’s cloud-native payment platform. These are critical systems where reliability, resilience and operational excellence matter every single day.

This is a role for engineers who enjoy evolving critical systems at scale. You’ll be working on mature, high-volume services where thoughtful design, careful testing, operational discipline and reliability are just as important as delivering new capability.

You’ll solve complex engineering challenges across services that support real-time payment flows, high availability, fault tolerance, security and performance within a microservice architecture. You’ll need to think carefully about how changes are designed, tested, released and operated, balancing delivery speed with the discipline required for mission-critical financial infrastructure.

You’ll work closely with experienced engineers, product teams and operational stakeholders to improve, evolve and run services that customers depend on. This could include enhancing existing payment capabilities, improving service resilience, simplifying complex systems, reducing operational risk, or building new functionality into mature services without compromising stability.

WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING 🏗️

  • Designing, building, and running cloud-native microservices in Go that are the backbone of our real-time payments platform
  • Building systems that are highly available, low-latency, and scalable, handling billions of payment requests with precision and resilience
  • Taking full ownership of services: from initial design and implementation to deployment and production support
  • Working with a mindset where cost-efficiency, observability, and operational excellence are core to how we build
  • Collaborating closely with other engineers in a flat, autonomous team structure, with a strong focus on code quality, simplicity, and continuous improvement
  • Working with modern tooling and technologies such as Golang, Kubernetes, CockroachDB and NATS JetStream in a highly automated DevOps environment

WE’RE LOOKING FOR 🔍

  • Deep understanding of designing and building distributed systems
  • Enjoys working on complex challenges within critical software where high performance and robustness are essential
  • Familiarity with cloud and containerisation technologies, test automation tools and CI/CD pipelines
  • Interest in owning projects end-to-end and supporting them as they go live in production
  • Appreciation of clean code and software engineering best-practice
  • Experience with Go, along with a “right tool for the job” mentality
  • Great communication skills who enjoy sharing knowledge and collaborating with others

TECH STACK ⚙️

Here are a few of the tools and methodologies we utilise:

  • Infrastructure: AWS, GCP, Azure, Kubernetes
  • Platform: CockroachDB, NATS JetStream, Elasticsearch, Vault, Cilium
  • Tools: Terraform, Flux, GitHub, Prometheus, Pact.io, Tilt
  • Code: Go (and a little Java), containerised microservices, CQRS, open source
  • Ways of working: TDD/BDD, Pair Programming, 100% remote, SecDevOps

THE TEAM 👥

At Form3, our engineering team is the backbone of everything we do. A remote first group of highly skilled, collaborative, and forward-thinking individuals passionate about building secure, scalable, and reliable payment technology. We operate in a true DevOps model, where engineers take full ownership of the software lifecycle, from design and implementation to deployment and operation in production.

We value clean code, automation, simplicity, and continuous improvement. Our engineers work in small, autonomous teams with a flat structure and minimal bureaucracy, promoting a culture of trust, transparency, and accountability. We use modern technologies (Golang, Kubernetes, AWS, and more) and embrace a cloud-native, event-driven architecture to support our microservices platform.

Expect a culture of knowledge sharing, where pull requests are thoughtful conversations, and technical decisions are made collectively and with care. If you're motivated by solving complex problems at scale and enjoy working with other talented engineers who care deeply about doing things right, you'll feel right at home here.

INTERVIEW PROCESS ✍️

  • Stage 1: Screening Call with Talent Team
  • Stage 2: Take home test
  • Stage 3: Technical interview (may be separated into two parts)
  • Stage 4: Team interview

We always aim to stick to the above process, however there may be occasions when an additional interview stage is needed for us to be sure we find the best fit for the role!

HIRING LOCATIONS & SALARY RANGES📍💰

Here are the locations that we are hiring from for this position, along with the salary range per location.

Where you sit within the below range will depend on a number of factors, including experience, skills and market considerations. These ranges reflect base salary only - you'll also have access to our wider benefits package, which is outlined in the benefits section below.

All new joiners start their first day in our office to collect the equipment needed to work remotely. We'll also arrange for some of your team to come in to say hi, ensuring you're supported and have a positive first few days with Form3!

ABOUT FORM3 💭

Revolutionising the world of payments with our cutting-edge technology and innovative solutions. For more information about life at Form3 check out the following pages:

What we do | Life at Form3 | Benefits | Payments Cannot Fail Series | .Tech Podcast

OUR DEI&B COMMITMENT

We hire talented people from a variety of backgrounds and experiences and are committed to a work environment based on diversity, open-mindedness and curiosity. We’re united by our company values (we even created them together!) and we celebrate our unique differences.

Our employee lifecycle processes are designed to embrace equal opportunity and prevent discrimination against our people regardless of personal characteristics. It is our strong belief that the more inclusive and belonging we are as a business, the better our work will be.

Public Trust Eligibility Required

This is a contingent position, meaning employment is dependent upon the successful award of the associated contract to Aretum and completion of any required background investigation or security clearance verification.

About Aretum

Aretum is a mission-driven organization committed to delivering innovative, technology-enabled solutions to our customers across defense, civilian, and homeland security sectors. Our teams work at the intersection of strategy, technology, and transformation, helping agencies solve their most critical challenges. We believe in investing in our people and creating a culture where collaboration, inclusion, and professional growth are at the forefront.

Job Summary

Aretum is seeking a Software Engineer/Developer to join an Agile scrum team supporting a large-scale federal digital content management and systems integration program. This role is primarily backend engineering, with a secondary front-end component. Python is the primary development language on the program, and most of your work will involve building Python and Django services, REST APIs, and data transformation routines that acquire, process, validate, and exchange digital content (images, video, audio, and textual materials) and its associated metadata between major enterprise systems. Portions of the existing platform are implemented in Java, so working Java proficiency is required, though the majority of new development is expected to be in Python. You will also build and maintain accessible user-facing features in TypeScript and React for the workflow and administrative interfaces the team delivers. Working under the direction of the team's technical lead and alongside government developers, testers, and user experience staff, you will own well-defined stories end to end, from design through unit-tested, production-ready code.

Due to the nature of our work as a federal consulting organization, employees may be expected to handle Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI) and must adhere to applicable safeguarding and compliance requirements.

Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and unit test Python and Django backend services and REST APIs as a member of a scrum team working on a three-week sprint cadence, integrated with government developers, testers, and stakeholders.
  • Build data transformation and ETL routines that move content and metadata between integrated enterprise systems, including mapping, normalization, validation, and reconciliation handling.
  • Implement content identification and selection functions, including filtering logic, classification rules, business-rule-driven selection, and manual, scheduled, and event-driven triggers.
  • Implement API integration and content transfer features, including authentication and authorization, secure transport, retry and error-handling logic, and transaction logging for end-to-end traceability.
  • Develop against relational data models in PostgreSQL, writing and tuning queries and contributing to schema design and migrations for content registries, workflow state, and audit history.
  • Implement background and asynchronous processing for long-running or batched content operations, including queueing, retries, and status tracking.
  • Maintain and extend existing Java components where the platform requires it, following the team's established coding standards.
  • Integrate existing malware scanning, integrity validation, and routing utility services into content exchange workflows through their documented APIs.
  • Build backend support for workflow administration features, including work queues, role-based permissions, exception handling paths, and audit logging.
  • Implement and maintain search features using Solr and Elasticsearch, including indexing and query development.
  • Develop accessible, responsive user-facing features using TypeScript, React, JavaScript, HTML5, and CSS3 for workflow and administrative interfaces, conforming to WCAG 2.1 accessibility standards.
  • Deploy and maintain services across AWS-based development, test, staging, and production environments, contributing to Terraform infrastructure-as-code and Docker-based containerization.
  • Use Jenkins and Git for continuous integration, including automated build, test, and code quality checks such as SonarQube.
  • Author unit test scripts for your own code and processes, and collaborate with government QA and testing staff who perform acceptance, integration, and accessibility testing, including participating in the creation of acceptance and testing criteria.
  • Participate fully in Agile ceremonies, including user story creation sessions, daily stand-ups, backlog grooming, sprint planning, sprint reviews, and retrospectives, recording and scoring all work as user stories in JIRA.
  • Respond constructively to peer code review feedback and adhere to the client's coding standards and definition of done.
  • Handle all project information appropriately as Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI), performing all development within client-owned and client-managed systems and environments.
  • Support end-of-engagement closeout activities, including finalizing documentation and closing tickets.

Requirements

  • Minimum 3 years of professional software development experience on Agile teams.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent additional experience.
  • Strong hands-on experience building backend services and REST APIs in Python, including production experience with the Django framework.
  • Experience working with relational databases, particularly PostgreSQL, including writing and tuning queries and contributing to schema design.
  • Working proficiency in Java, sufficient to maintain, extend, and troubleshoot existing Java components on the platform.
  • Hands-on experience building front-end features with TypeScript and React.
  • Working experience with Solr and Elasticsearch.
  • Experience developing microservices and REST APIs, including authentication, authorization, and error handling.
  • Proficiency with HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript.
  • Experience developing and deploying applications in AWS environments.
  • Working experience with Terraform for infrastructure-as-code.
  • Experience with Jenkins continuous integration and Git-based source control.
  • Experience working in Agile and Scrum environments, including user-story-based development in JIRA with story-point estimation.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to work effectively on a fully remote, integrated government and contractor team.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting federal government clients.
  • Experience with digital content, digital collections, or digital asset management systems, including ingest, metadata exchange, or preservation workflows.
  • Experience building ETL or data integration pipelines between enterprise systems.
  • Experience with Celery or comparable distributed task queues for asynchronous processing.
  • Familiarity with accessibility testing and remediation practices under Section 508 and WCAG 2.1.
  • Experience with automated testing and code quality tools such as Selenium and SonarQube.
  • Experience with Docker, Red Hat Linux, and Apache.
  • Familiarity with Bootstrap, AJAX, or Angular.
  • Experience with reporting and monitoring tools such as Grafana or Tableau.
  • Experience working in environments with CUI handling or NIST SP 800-53 security control requirements.

Travel Requirements

This is a remote position; however, occasional travel may be required based on project needs, client meetings, team collaboration events, or training sessions. Travel is expected to be less than 10% and will be communicated in advance whenever possible.

Aretum is committed to fostering a workplace rooted in excellence, integrity, and equal opportunity for all. jobs.description:
Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.

Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. Participation is project-based, not permanent employment.

What this opportunity involves

We're building a dataset to evaluate AI coding agents - how well a model handles real-world developer tasks.

You'll create challenging tasks and evaluation criteria within realistic simulated environments:

  • Build realistic developer environments - a virtual company with codebase, infrastructure, and context (tickets, docs, conversations) that forms a believable development history
  • Design tasks from intermediate states of these environments - craft the prompt, define what "solved" means, and ensure the task is solvable by an AI agent
  • Write tests that verify agent solutions - accept all valid approaches and reject incorrect ones, neither too strict nor too lenient
  • Iterate on tasks and tests based on QA feedback - review agent solutions, analyze failures, and refine until the evaluation is fair and robust

What this is NOT

  • Not data labeling
  • Not prompt engineering
  • Not writing code from scratch - the agent writes most of the code; you guide and evaluate

What we look for

  • 5+ years in software development
  • Core stack: Python (FastAPI), JavaScript/TypeScript (React), Docker, Postgres, Kafka, Redis
  • Experience writing tests (functional, integration)
  • English proficiency - B2+

Why this is hard

Frontier models are already good at coding. Creating a task that genuinely challenges the best models is non-trivial. You need to deeply understand where models fail and what scenarios reveal the difference between a good and a bad solution. Tasks have many valid solutions - writing tests that accept all correct solutions and reject incorrect ones is harder than it sounds.

How it works

Apply → Pass qualification(s) → Join a project → Complete tasks → Get paid

Effort estimate

Tasks for this project are estimated to take 20 hours to complete, depending on complexity. This is an estimate and not a schedule requirement; you choose when and how to work. Tasks must be submitted by the deadline and meet the listed acceptance criteria to be accepted.

Compensation

Up to $50/hr equivalent, depending on level and pace. Tasks are estimated at ~20 hours each; you set your own schedule.

Candidate Profile

jobs.excerpt: 🇪🇬 Up to EUR 10,000 per year, on a full-time, permanent employment contract 🌎 Fully remote working from anywhere in Egypt!
jobs.description:
🇪🇬 Up to EUR 10,000 per year, on a full-time, permanent employment contract
🌎 Fully remote working from anywhere in Egypt!

🏖️ 33 Days Paid Leave and Benefits

✨ Working with globally recognisable brands in US Entertainment
💻 High-end, fast computer
💡 All the latest software and productivity tools you’ll need

About the Role

We are hiring a Client Operations Coordinator to support the day-to-day social operations of a major US entertainment client.

Reporting to the Account Manager on the account, you will coordinate the operating rhythm behind the work: content approvals, stakeholder follow-up, meeting preparation, campaign project management, file organisation, episode deliveries, social-account access, and cross-workstream status visibility.

This is not passive administration. The role is about making complex work visible, organised, and dependable. You will know what is moving, what is waiting for approval, who owns the next step, where the latest file lives, and when a blocker needs to be escalated.

You will work across a high volume of moving parts and stakeholders, helping Storm and the client stay aligned as content, campaigns, meetings, approvals, assets, and access requirements move forward.

A significant part of the role is follow-through. You will be expected to chase inputs, maintain accurate trackers, capture decisions clearly, surface risks early, and make sure agreed actions actually happen.

If you enjoy bringing order to fast-moving work involving lots of people, deadlines, systems, and dependencies, this role will suit you well.

About Storm Ideas

Founded in 2008, Storm Ideas is an international team working with globally recognised clients, particularly across the US TV and entertainment industry.

Our work sits at the intersection of media, technology, creativity, and operations. We produce social content at scale, support major entertainment brands, build products, and keep improving how our teams work.

We are a remote-first, fast-moving company with established clients, an international team, and a strong appetite for better tools, better systems, and better ways of working.

We use modern technology, including carefully selected AI-assisted tools, to create clearer workflows, make better decisions, catch problems earlier, and deliver consistently high-quality work.

What You Will Do

  • Coordinate high-volume social-content approvals, feedback, revisions, deadlines, and final sign-off across Storm and client stakeholders
  • Prepare for recurring meetings, capture decisions and actions, and make sure follow-ups are completed
  • Project-manage smaller social campaigns, maintaining clear timelines, owners, dependencies, approvals, assets, and risks
  • Keep client files, episode deliveries, social-account access, permissions, and related operational processes organised and up to date
  • Maintain shared trackers, calendars, and documentation so priorities, deadlines, blockers, and responsibilities remain visible
  • Chase inputs, surface risks early, escalate blockers appropriately, and keep work moving across multiple teams and stakeholders
  • Keep operational processes, templates, contacts, and handover information current so work is reliable and repeatable

What We Are Looking For

  • Experience supporting client operations, social-content workflows, project delivery, account teams, or another fast-moving environment involving multiple stakeholders, deadlines, and approval routes
  • Strong organisation across multiple workstreams, deadlines, approval paths, versions, and dependencies
  • High ownership and a proactive approach to keeping work moving
  • Clear written communication and the ability to turn scattered feedback or ambiguous requests into concise actions, owners, and decisions
  • Experience preparing for recurring meetings, producing useful recaps, and following actions through to completion
  • Confidence coordinating high-volume approval workflows involving internal teams, senior stakeholders, legal review, or multiple revision rounds
  • Practical experience with file-management and project-management systems such as Box, Monday.com, Airtable, spreadsheets, or comparable tools
  • Good judgement about when to follow up, when to challenge, when to escalate, and when a decision sits outside your authority
  • A calm and dependable approach when work is late, unclear, blocked, or changing quickly
  • Confidence using modern productivity tools, including AI-assisted tools where appropriate, to prepare, organise, check, and follow through on work
  • Good judgement around checking AI-assisted outputs and handling confidential information carefully

What Success Looks Like

  • Approvals move through the correct stakeholders with accurate statuses, complete feedback, and no lost decisions
  • Meetings are properly prepared, decisions are clearly documented, actions have owners, and follow-up happens without repeated prompting
  • Campaign teams can quickly see the latest milestones, assets, versions, risks, approvals, and delivery status
  • Client and agency teams trust the operational picture because updates are clear, details are accurate, and blockers are raised early
  • Episode deliveries, files, account access, and recurring operational tasks are organised and dependable
  • Important context carries cleanly between Storm and client meetings rather than being lost between teams
  • Scope changes are made visible and discussed rather than quietly absorbed into the role
  • You do not wait for someone else to notice that something is slipping; you identify it, make it visible, and help drive it towards resolution

This Role Will Suit You If

  • You enjoy the operational side of social and campaign work: coordination, approvals, meetings, systems, timing, and follow-through
  • You like bringing order to work that spans many people, tools, and deadlines
  • You are naturally good at keeping track of details without losing sight of the bigger picture
  • You communicate warmly and clearly while still being willing to chase, challenge, and escalate
  • You like being the person who knows where things stand and what needs to happen next
  • You are comfortable working independently within clear boundaries and asking precise questions when authority or scope is unclear
  • You take satisfaction from making complicated workflows more reliable and easier for other people to work within

What It's Like To Work Here

Modern Tech Stack
We use modern collaboration, file-management, project-management, social-platform, password-management, and AI-enabled workflow tools to support our teams and clients.

Agility and Openness for Ideas
We actively encourage people to improve how work is organised and delivered. Operating with the agility of a growing company alongside the support of an established organisation means we value practical ideas, quick problem-solving, and strong follow-through.

Team-based
This is a dedicated, embedded role working closely with both Storm Ideas and client stakeholders. You will work with the Account Manager, strategy leads, production teams, and other client and agency stakeholders, with clear escalation routes for decisions and approvals.

Flexibility
Storm is a remote-first company. This particular role requires consistent working hours aligned to Pacific Time, currently expected to be approximately 9:00am–5:30pm PT, Monday to Friday.

Recruitment Process

Online video interview with short recorded answers to role-relevant questions.

First interview with Account Management leadership or the recruitment team

Practical exercise based on realistic operational inputs, asking you to produce a prioritised action plan and client update and explain how you used and checked the tools that supported your work, including AI where relevant
Second interview and exercise review with a senior leader

And that's it!

Not sure you tick every box? Apply anyway if this sounds like how you already work. We are more interested in your operational judgement, reliability, follow-through, and ability to use modern tools well than in a perfect traditional CV.

Privacy Notice
We process your personal data for recruitment purposes in line with UK data protection law. AI tools may assist in reviewing applications, but decisions are made by our team. We retain data only as necessary for recruitment and compliance. You can request access or deletion of your data at any time by emailing .

substance use disorders interventions to Spring Health’s member network.

    co-occurring mental health conditions, using interventions such as Motivational

    meetings
    ● Follow Spring Health policies and maintain all confidentiality, compliance, and ethical
    standards.

care.

level clinical care navigators.

Backed by Toloka’s deep expertise in scalable data generation, crowd technology, and applied ML systems, Mindrift enables experts to shape how next-generation generative models learn, reason, and perform.

We are launching a Management Consulting domain focused on translating real-world consulting engagements into structured learning environments for advanced AI systems. To do this credibly, we are assembling a team of strategy consultants from top-tier firms who can convert authentic project experience into end-to-end examples — from problem structuring and work planning to analysis, synthesis, and client-ready recommendations.

You will join a growing team of consultants from leading strategy firms shaping how AI learns high-level business reasoning.

Important: This role is exclusively for consultants with direct experience at a top-tier strategy consulting firm. If you do not have hands-on project experience at one of the firms listed below, please do not apply. This requirement ensures the domain is built by practitioners trained to the highest standards of structured problem-solving and client delivery.

Who We’re Looking For

Consultants with 3+ years of experience at one of the firms listed above, with hands-on project experience in:

  • Structuring ambiguous client problems into workable analytical plans
  • Building financial models, market analyses, or synthesized findings from messy inputs
  • Producing client-ready deliverables under time pressure
  • Forming and defending recommendations under uncertainty

No deep technical background is required — we will onboard you on the lightweight tools involved.

What You’ll Do

  • Build realistic consulting project environments — create detailed project scenarios grounded in real engagement dynamics: industry context, financials, constraints, conflicting inputs, and incomplete information.

  • High attention to logical consistency and output quality
  • Independent, self-directed working style
  • Clear written English (B2+)

Job Description:

Deliver simple solutions to complex problems as a Solutions Architect SME at GDIT. Here, you will tailor cutting-edge solutions to the unique requirements of our federal clients, and we will make your career growth our priority. At GDIT, people are our differentiator.

Our work depends on a Solutions Architect SME joining our team to provide technical leadership across both program delivery and growth for our Health sector — designing solutions that hold up under scrutiny, and standing behind them from proposal through deployment.

This position allows for primarily remote work, with potential need for travel during proposal development activities and key program milestones

This is a hybrid delivery and growth role. The majority of your time will be spent as the delivery architect for the Unified Claims Acceleration Platform (UCAP) at the Department of Veterans Affairs, providing business and technical architectural guidance to development teams, defining milestone delivery and success metrics, and overseeing technical implementation of the functional capability being developed and deployed. The balance of your time will be spent as the technical solution lead on growth opportunities — most immediately with the Social Security Administration (SSA), and more broadly across the federal health space.

The ideal candidate possesses strong knowledge of information technology and commercial solutions across all layers of the IT stack, with significant experience designing and developing technical solutions in multiple disciplines — cloud, application development, data and AI, and cyber security — and a track record of large, complex proposal delivery. You are equally comfortable defining success metrics for a program already underway and defending a solution and its basis of estimate in a color review.

HOW A SOLUTIONS ARCHITECT SME WILL MAKE AN IMPACT:

  • Provide software and product architecture for UCAP — define milestone delivery and success metrics, and oversee all facets of technical implementation of the functional capability being developed and deployed
  • Identify solutions based on business and technical criteria, and define and implement solution designs and patterns in an AWS cloud environment
  • Lead a multi-disciplined staff of IT professionals and ensure technical architecture teams deliver efficient and effective system solutions that support business goals and objectives
  • Identify customer requirements, analyze alternatives, and conduct product recommendations related to software, platform, and network configurations; develop, enhance, and maintain established service design by applying process frameworks and methodologies
  • Prepare and deliver technical presentations, briefings, and reports to government stakeholders, and provide updates on solution milestones
  • Support change management activities that lead to successful adoption of functionality being deployed and matured, and apply critical thinking and research to improve program processes and resolve issues affecting program performance
  • Lead winning solution development for growth opportunities — with SSA and across the broader federal health space — including solution scans, solution design, and cost estimation
  • Prepare and develop proposal content that articulates GDIT solutions, participate in color reviews, and develop bill-of-materials (BOM) where required
  • Develop realistic staffing plans with supporting basis of estimates (BOE), along with lifecycle cost estimates for the proposed technical solution
  • Coordinate “reach back” with technical subject matter experts (SMEs) across GDIT to obtain the specific knowledge or expertise needed to address technical issues
  • Provide thought leadership and technical support to assist business areas and programs in retaining and growing both new and current work, in support of GDIT’s Innovate Everywhere strategy
  • Act as technical liaison between customer technical points of contact and GDIT staff to facilitate IT strategic planning, and build relationships across GDIT business units and with key vendor partners to align capture, program execution, and emerging technology with sector growth pipelines

WHAT YOU’LL NEED TO SUCCEED:

  • Bachelor’s degree required
  • 15+ years of software development, design, and product experience related to the development and deployment of outcome-based functional capability, spanning all layers of the IT stack
  • 7+ years of direct experience designing and deploying AWS cloud-based managed service solutions
  • 5+ years creating solutions for federal government proposals​
  • Solution architecture experience across multiple technical disciplines
  • Ability to lead projects and proposals and provide technical oversight to ensure alignment with strategic goals and objectives
  • Strong knowledge of government procurement and proposal processes
  • Strong knowledge of commercial products and solutions, especially COTS software application products
  • Experience developing lifecycle cost estimates for technical solutions
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication, presentation, and facilitation skills, with the ability to present to business leaders
  • Ability to work independently or as part of a cross-functional team
  • Maintain technical proficiency by keeping current with the latest technologies, trends, standards, and products
  • Customer service orientation

WHAT WOULD BE EVEN BETTER:

  • Experience implementing or developing solutions in several of the following areas: Agile and Lean principles and methodologies for application development; no-code/low-code iBPM and/or CRM solutions; ITSM automation and orchestration; big data analytics, data warehousing, and data lake; machine learning and AI, including Gen AI technologies and foundational models; large-scale cloud migration (application, data, infrastructure); and next-gen cyber defense capabilities such as proactive threat detection and automated response
  • Prior work experience with SSA, the Department of Veterans Affairs, or federal health agencies, either as a government official or a contractor
  • Certifications such as AWS AI Practitioner, Machine Learning Engineer Associate, Generative AI Developer Professional, or Machine Learning Specialty
  • Experience writing and presenting business cases and white papers
  • Knowledge and experience in government contracting and business-to-government (B2G) sales
  • Must be able to obtain a Position of Trust and successfully pass a thorough Government background screening process requiring the completion of detailed forms and fingerprinting

GDIT IS YOUR PLACE
At GDIT, the mission is our purpose, and our people are at the center of everything we do.

  • Growth: AI-powered career tool that identifies career steps and learning opportunities
  • Support: An internal mobility team focused on helping you achieve your career goals
  • Rewards: Comprehensive benefits and wellness packages, 401K with company match, and competitive pay and paid time off
  • Flexibility: Full-flex work week to own your priorities at work and at home
  • Community: Award-winning culture of innovation and a military-friendly workplace

OWN YOUR OPPORTUNITY
Explore a career at GDIT and you’ll find endless opportunities to grow alongside colleagues who share your sense of ownership and pride in the meaningful work we do.

The likely salary range for this position is $189,635 - $256,565. This is not, however, a guarantee of compensation or salary. Rather, salary will be set based on experience, geographic location and possibly contractual requirements and could fall outside of this range.

Scheduled Weekly Hours:

40

Travel Required:

None

Telecommuting Options:

Remote

Work Location:

Any Location / Remote

Additional Work Locations:

Total Rewards at GDIT:

Our benefits package for all US-based employees includes a variety of medical plan options, some with Health Savings Accounts, dental plan options, a vision plan, and a 401(k) plan offering the ability to contribute both pre and post-tax dollars up to the IRS annual limits and receive a company match. To encourage work/life balance, GDIT offers employees full flex work weeks where possible and a variety of paid time off plans, including vacation, sick and personal time, holidays, paid parental, military, bereavement and jury duty leave. GDIT typically provides new employees with 15 days of paid leave per calendar year to be used for vacations, personal business, and illness and an additional 10 paid holidays per year. Paid leave and paid holidays are prorated based on the employee’s date of hire. The GDIT Paid Family Leave program provides a total of up to 160 hours of paid leave in a rolling 12 month period for eligible employees. To ensure our employees are able to protect their income, other offerings such as short and long-term disability benefits, life, accidental death and dismemberment, personal accident, critical illness and business travel and accident insurance are provided or available. We regularly review our Total Rewards package to ensure our offerings are competitive and reflect what our employees have told us they value most.

Our Identity Verification Process:

As part of the hiring process, we will ask you to complete an identity verification process that leverages advanced biometrics and artificial intelligence to ensure authenticity and protect against identity fraud. You are expected to be on camera during virtual interviews. We reserve the right to take your picture to verify your identity and prevent fraud. By proceeding, you authorize the collection, processing, and use of your biometric data for identity verification and security purposes.

Our 26,000 experts extract the power of technology to create immediate value and deliver solutions at the edge of innovation. jobs.description:
Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States. This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title

Cloud-Native Architect

Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $130,000–$180,000 Annually (based on experience)
Experience Required:10+ Years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary

Bright Vision Technologies is seeking a highly experienced Cloud-Native Architect with 10+ years of software engineering experience, including extensive experience designing cloud-native platforms and distributed systems. The ideal candidate will lead the architecture and modernization of enterprise-scale applications using microservices, Kubernetes, container platforms, and cloud-native technologies while driving engineering standards, platform strategy, and technical excellence across multiple teams.

Key Responsibilities

  • Define enterprise-wide microservices architecture standards, service boundaries, and domain-driven design (DDD) principles.
  • Lead the modernization of legacy monolithic applications into scalable, independently deployable cloud-native services.
  • Design secure, resilient, and highly available distributed systems using REST APIs, gRPC, asynchronous messaging, and event-driven architectures.
  • Establish API governance, schema management, versioning strategies, and service lifecycle best practices.
  • Architect resilient systems using patterns such as circuit breakers, retries, bulkheads, graceful degradation, Saga, CQRS, Event Sourcing, and Outbox.
  • Define data ownership strategies, distributed transaction models, and scalable persistence architectures.
  • Design and implement cloud-native platform capabilities, including Kubernetes, service mesh, API gateways, identity management, observability, and platform automation.
  • Drive performance engineering, scalability planning, capacity management, and system reliability across mission-critical services.
  • Establish CI/CD, GitOps, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), automated testing, and deployment strategies for cloud-native applications.
  • Define enterprise observability standards leveraging distributed tracing, centralized logging, metrics, dashboards, and SLO/SLI-based monitoring.
  • Partner with security teams to implement Zero Trust architecture, secrets management, runtime security, compliance, and cloud governance.
  • Lead architecture reviews, technical design sessions, and technology evaluations across multiple engineering organizations.
  • Mentor architects, technical leads, and senior engineers while promoting cloud-native engineering best practices.
  • Evaluate emerging cloud-native technologies and recommend strategic adoption based on business value and technical maturity.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • 10+ years of professional software engineering experience, including significant experience in software architecture and cloud-native solution design.
  • Deep expertise in microservices architecture, Domain-Driven Design (DDD), distributed systems, and enterprise integration patterns.
  • Extensive hands-on experience with Kubernetes, container orchestration, Docker, and cloud-native platforms.
  • Strong proficiency in one or more backend programming languages such as Java, Go, C#, or Python.
  • Strong knowledge of API design, asynchronous messaging, event streaming technologies (Kafka, RabbitMQ, Azure Service Bus, or similar), and distributed application architecture.
  • Experience designing and operating highly available, latency-sensitive production systems at enterprise scale.
  • Strong expertise with at least one major cloud platform, including AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform, Pulumi, CloudFormation, or Bicep.
  • Excellent leadership, communication, stakeholder management, and technical mentoring skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience building Internal Developer Platforms (IDPs) and platform engineering capabilities.
  • Hands-on experience with service mesh technologies such as Istio, Linkerd, Envoy, or Consul Connect.
  • Knowledge of GitOps tools such as Argo CD or Flux.
  • Experience with FinOps, cloud governance, and enterprise cloud cost optimization.
  • Public speaking, open-source leadership, published technical content, or conference presentations.
  • Experience working in regulated industries such as Healthcare, Financial Services, Insurance, or Government.
  • Cloud architecture certifications such as AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional, Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert, or Google Professional Cloud Architect.
How to Apply
Would you like to know more about this opportunity? For immediate consideration, please send your resume to or contact us at (908) 505-3545. Learn more about Bright Vision Technologies at www.bvteck.com.
Bright Vision Technologies is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

This commitment extends to all aspects of employment, including recruitment, hiring, training, compensation, promotion, transfer, leaves of absence, termination, layoffs, and recall.

BV Teck expressly prohibits any form of workplace harassment or discrimination. Any improper interference with employees' ability to perform their job duties may result in disciplinary action up to and including termination of employment.

zz

jobs.description:
About JerseySTEM

All JerseySTEM roles are pro-bono (unpaid) positions.JerseySTEM is a mission-driven professional network of pro-bono contributors dedicated to improving access to STEM education and career pathways for underserved middle school girls in New Jersey.

Members contribute their professional skills and leverage their networks in service of the organization’s gender-equity agenda.Membership is a minimum six-month commitment of approximately six flexible hours per week and includes a $100 refundable deposit, returned after six months of active membership. K–12 educators, retirees, veterans, interns, and students are exempt from the deposit.

Overview

Please note: This is an unpaid position.

JerseySTEM is seeking skilled Agile Product Owners to help implement and execute transformational organization outcomes. The candidate will have demonstrated expertise and application of Agile methodologies, techniques and frameworks, a successful track record of driving and facilitating teams, commitment to continuous learning and mindset of relentless improvement.

Candidates will be evaluated by JerseySTEM's Operational Excellence Management team which includes a technical committee of Agile coaches and business managers.

Candidates will focus on one of following domains:

  • Outreach Information System : Built around a backbone of Salesforce augmented by a series of supplemental applications such as Email marketing integration, Quickbooks integration,...the OIS-PO will oversee the evolution of the current solution as the needs evolve and new integrations become available.
  • Human Resources Information System: Established around the Applicant Tracking System (iCIMS) and the Onboarding platform (Enboarder), the Product own will shepherd the evolution of our information system supporting the Human Capital department. (HRIS-PO)

Responsibilities

What can you expect in a Product Owner role at JerseySTEM:

  • Organize and oversee the requirement gathering and Business Analysis of the solutions to be developed.
  • Manage and prioritize the product backlog for an Agile team
  • Attend weekly meetings with the team
  • Work with stakeholders to understand their needs, and with the team to understand technical and practical constraints
  • Help clarify user stories, set acceptance criteria, answer questions
  • Review the team's progress periodically, and adjust the backlog as needed
  • Identify process and communications issues
  • Minimum time commitment: 5-7 hours/ week with committed work times, for a minimum 6 months period.

Qualifications

Technical Qualifications:

  • 3-4 years of experience as Product Owner or Project Manager in a Corporate setting preferred
  • Proven track record as a PO or Product Manager
  • Excellent communication, analytical, mentoring and problem-solving skills
  • Certified Product Owner (CSPO) , PMP, SAFe certifications preferred
  • Experience using Jira, Kanban Board, Slack

jobs.excerpt: We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Accountantwith robust US GAAP and controllership experience to anchor our accounting function during a pivotal period of growth and transformation.
jobs.description:
We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Accountantwith robust US GAAP and controllership experience to anchor our accounting function during a pivotal period of growth and transformation.

Our current team handles day-to-day transactional processing and routine bookkeeping efficiently. However, as we advance through an active audit, a major software migration, and broader process improvement initiatives, we require a senior-level technical expert. Your primary focus will not be high-volume transactional work, but rather providing the deep accounting judgment, rigorous review capabilities, and control structures needed to ensure absolute technical accuracy and audit readiness.

You will partner directly with leadership to bridge the gap between day-to-day operations and high-level strategic financial oversight.


Key Responsibilities & Challenges to Solve

Technical GAAP & Specialized Accounting

  • Lease Accounting (ASC 842): Take full ownership of the review and ongoing management of Right-of-Use (ROU) assets and lease liabilities. Assess new contracts and modifications, ensuring all documentation is robust and audit-ready.

  • Fixed Assets & Capitalization: Oversee PPE accounting, refine and enforce capitalization policies, manage asset disposals, evaluate impairment considerations, and ensure the fixed asset register is flawlessly maintained.

  • Technical GAAP Review: Act as the critical second line of defense. Review complex transactions, contract assessments, and financing arrangements, making definitive accounting treatment decisions before they become audit findings.

Controllership, Month-End, & Oversight

  • Month-End Close & Accruals: Partner with leadership to strengthen accrual methodologies, strictly enforce cut-off procedures, and significantly reduce the manual adjustments identified during close.

  • Balance Sheet Reconciliations & Controls: Establish and enforce elevated reconciliation standards, design stronger review controls, and foster clear ownership across all key accounts.

  • Audit Management & Documentation: Prepare detailed audit schedules, reports, and technical documentation for review by management and external auditors, ensuring full compliance with US GAAP standards.

Process Improvement & System Transformation

  • System Migration & Workflow Design: Active partner in our upcoming software migration. Document current processes, identify internal control gaps, redesign workflows, and ensure complex accounting requirements are accurately mapped into the new system.

  • Fraud Prevention & Risk Mitigation: Continually assess financial risk, investigate discrepancies, and implement improvements to internal control systems to prevent errors and fraud.

Qualifications & Requirements

  • Technical Skills: Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and required experience with QuickBooks Online. Experience with NetSuite is preferred, along with familiarity navigating complex accounting systems and software migrations

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field is required.

  • Certification: CPA or CIA designation is highly preferred.

  • Experience: Proven experience as a Senior Accountant, Financial Auditor, or Assistant Controller with deep, hands-on expertise in US GAAP, specifically including ASC 842 and complex capitalization policies.

  • Analytical Depth: Exceptional analytical skills with a proven ability to interpret complex financial data and apply high-level accounting judgment.

  • Execution: Strong organizational skills with a meticulous attention to detail. Ability to work independently, manage shifting timelines, and thrive in a fully remote environment.

  • Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, capable of educating staff on policies and presenting clear findings to external auditors and leadership.

jobs.description:
About the Company

The mining industry has steadily become worse at finding new ore deposits, requiring >10X more capital to make discoveries compared to 30 years ago. The easy-to-find, near-surface deposits have largely been found, and the industry has chronically under-invested in new exploration technology, relying on the manual techniques of yesteryear – even as demand accelerates for copper, lithium, and other metals to build electric vehicles, renewable energy, and data centers.

KoBold builds AI models for mineral exploration and deploys those models—alongside our novel sensors—to guide decisions on KoBold-owned-and-operated exploration programs. In the six years since founding, KoBold has become by far both the largest independent mineral exploration company and the largest exploration technology developer. Our data scientists and software engineers, who come from leading technology companies, jointly lead exploration programs with our renowned exploration geologists.

KoBold has proven its first discovery with materially less capital than the industry average and found one of the best copper deposits ever discovered: the copper is far more concentrated than the global average of copper mines, and this asset alone is expected to generate meaningful revenue for decades. KoBold has a portfolio of more than 60 other projects, each of which has the potential for another high-quality discovery.

KoBold is privately held; investors include institutional asset managers T. Rowe Price and Canada Pension Plan Investments; technology venture capitalists Andreessen Horowitz, Breakthrough Energy Ventures, BOND Capital, Durable Capital, StepStone, and Standard Investments; and natural resources companies Equinor, BHP, and Mitsubishi.

About the Role

KoBold is seeking an experienced International Tax Senior Manager, to join KoBold’s Global Tax and Finance Team and assist in developing and executing tax planning strategies and maintain global tax compliance in a dynamic mining environment. As part of the Global Tax and Finance Team, you will manage international tax compliance while driving global tax strategy and planning. You will work closely with our Associate Director of Tax and Senior Manager of International Accounting to ensure compliance across 13 jurisdictions, and coordinate with the rest of the Global Tax and Finance Team and KoBold's external tax and accounting advisors. This position requires both technical tax expertise and strategic thinking, and since KoBold is a startup company, your role and responsibilities will be dynamic and will evolve as the company grows.

This is a remote position reporting to the Associate Director of Tax.

Responsibilities

  • Manage international direct tax compliance for multiple jurisdictions including Canada, the Nordic Region, UK, Europe, Australia, serving as primary liaison with external advisors; and act as a key team member for compliance in Zambia and the Democratic Republic of Congo.
  • Strategize, research, and plan for tax implications of global operations, coordinating U.S. and foreign tax laws to develop optimal tax planning strategies
  • Support the development and execution of corporate restructurings, entity reorganizations, and capitalization strategies. Analyze tax implications of structural changes, model alternative scenarios, and coordinate with Legal, Finance, and external advisors to implement tax-efficient structures across multiple jurisdictions
  • Develop and maintain tax systems that leverage Ai to support strategic decision-making, including cash tax forecasting, scenario analysis, capital structure optimization, thin capitalization monitoring, and evaluation of tax implications for corporate transactions and operational initiatives
  • Provide technical expertise and operational support for indirect taxes (VAT, withholding taxes, sales/use taxes, customs duties) across key jurisdictions as needed, and partner with local finance teams to resolve complex issues, ensure timely compliance, and identify optimization opportunities
  • Partner with Procurement, Supply Chain, Technology, Operations, Finance, and Legal on tax and customs implications of business decisions
  • Partner with non-tax departments and leadership to support legal entity structuring for new operations and business expansion
  • Research and identify tax planning opportunities including incentives, credits, duty relief programs, and treaty benefits and assist with existing mining tax credit and SR&ED calculations in Canada; with an ability to take beginning to end ownership of research to execution
  • Assist with tax audits and controversy matters by coordinating responses and developing technical positions
  • Build scalable processes and documentation as the company transitions from exploration to production

Qualifications

  • Minimum of 8 years of tax experience, with public accounting, law firm and/or in-house experience preferred
  • CPA, JD and LLM (Tax) (or equivalent) preferred
  • Strong knowledge of U.S. and international tax regimes
  • Advanced proficiency in Excel and use of Ai applications
  • Strong organizational skills and proactive communicator and collaborator
  • Ability to work effectively across cultures and collaborate with international teams
  • Intellectual curiosity and eagerness to learn about all aspects of mineral exploration, particularly in the geology domain. Enjoys constantly learning such that you are driving insights through using our tools in exploration and willing to work directly with geologists in the field.
  • Ability to explain technical problems to and collaborate on solutions with domain experts who are not within the tax or accounting function. A strong communicator who enjoys working with colleagues across the company.
  • Excitement about joining a fast-growing early-stage company, comfort with a dynamic work environment, and eagerness to take on an evolving range of responsibilities.
  • Keen not just to build cool technology, but to figure out what technical product to build to best achieve the business objectives of the company.
  • A valid passport and willingness to travel to observe our work at Mingomba or at an exploration site around the world. Travel for this role typically does not exceed 3-5 trips per year.
  • A high degree of independence and the ability to work effectively with limited supervision

jobs.description:
Airtable is the no-code app platform that empowers people closest to the work to accelerate their most critical business processes. More than 500,000 organizations, including 80% of the Fortune 100, rely on Airtable to transform how work gets done.

Work is being redesigned, and Airtable is built for that moment: the same platform humans run their most critical workflows on is where agents now operate alongside them. Professional Services is where that redesign happens.

The Technical Project Manager runs delivery on our most complex engagements. This is not a coordination role; it's a technical delivery lead position with accountability across an Airtable PS team, external development partners, and enterprise customer stakeholders, all moving toward shared milestones across different cadences, compliance requirements, and organizational dynamics. You sequence the work, hold the relationships, and make real-time decisions when plans meet reality.

What you'll do

  • Serve as the primary delivery lead for enterprise customers, owning the relationship, the plan, and the outcome from kickoff through go-live and beyond.
  • Run delivery across all workstreams: internal team, external partners, customer stakeholders, managing progress, blockers, and alignment simultaneously.
  • Own the project plan end to end: scope, schedule, budget, risk register, and RAID log across the full engagement lifecycle.
  • Make technical sequencing decisions when platform constraints, compliance requirements, or partner dependencies force tradeoffs.
  • Guide customers through AI workflow transformation, helping them move from human-run processes to AI-augmented and agent-assisted operations, and managing the organizational dynamics that come with it.
  • Use AI tools actively in your own delivery operations: status reporting, risk synthesis, documentation, and stakeholder communication. You don't just manage teams using AI; you use it yourself.
  • Manage scope formally: track change requests, assess impact on timeline and budget, and run the change order process when the engagement evolves beyond the original SOW.
  • Sequence work across Agile sprint cycles and Waterfall delivery milestones depending on what the engagement demands, and shift the model when reality requires it.
  • Hold external partners accountable across organizational boundaries, by relationship and clarity, not authority.
  • Coordinate compliance, security, access management, and third-party approvals in regulated enterprise environments.
  • Keep executive stakeholders accurately informed without requiring them to understand the technical details.
  • Work directly in Airtable as an operational tool; hands-on platform fluency is required.

Who you are

  • You have delivered technical programs for external customers in a professional services or consulting context, not just managed internal projects. You've run steering committees, managed scope conversations, and owned customer outcomes with real accountability.
  • 5+ years managing technical delivery in complex, multi-stakeholder environments, with accountability for outcomes across teams you don't directly control. You lead through influence and clarity, not organizational authority.
  • You are genuinely fluent with AI tools, not aspirationally. You use AI in your daily delivery workflow, have an informed perspective on where agentic systems create leverage and where they introduce risk, and can help customers navigate both.
  • You have worked directly in Airtable or a comparable platform, not managed people who do. You understand how components interact, identify dependency and sequencing issues by looking at the system, and build the tools your team uses to run delivery operations.
  • PMP or equivalent PMO certification. You know formal project management methodology and apply it as the structure that keeps complex engagements from quietly going off course.
  • You operate fluidly across Agile and Waterfall. You know which model fits the engagement and can run both without defaulting to whichever is more comfortable.
  • When plans break, you create order. You don't wait for someone else to lead.
  • Delivered in enterprise environments with real compliance, security, and access management requirements. You plan around constraints, not past them.
  • Track record of coordinating delivery across organizational boundaries: external partners, customer teams, or both.
  • You communicate across the full room: executive-ready updates for C-level stakeholders, direct technical direction for delivery teams, and clear framing for the business SMEs whose work is changing.

Estamos construyendo con IA en nuestra operación core; desde comercio conversacional, hasta marketing generativo, hasta sistemas que extraen insights de millones de interacciones. Somos un equipo que imagina lo imposible, lo construye y vive la disrupción, la proactividad y la ambición en un contexto de hipercrecimiento.

Kavak Talent

1. Deliver Impact: You prioritize what generates measurable results and raise the bar using technology and data. You have a consistent track record of delivering relevant and measurable results.
2. Engage Fast: You act on problems and opportunities. You decide on time, advance in short cycles, and adjust when necessary without compromising standards.
3. Engage with Purpose: You act with extreme ownership, taking total responsibility for results that impact your work and aligning decisions with Kavak's vision and purpose.
4. Play to Win Together: You prioritize collective results over individual success.

Sobre el Rol

Buscamos un perfil senior de diseño de producto enfocado en experiencia de catálogo y compra, para unirse al equipo de Kavak. Esta posición se ubica en la intersección entre negocio, datos y diseño, trabajando de forma transversal con Producto, Ingeniería y otras áreas para llevar experiencias de su versión 1.0 a su versión 2.0.

  • Colaborar con Producto e Ingeniería en la definición del roadmap y la estrategia de producto.

  • Llevar productos existentes de una versión 1.0 a una 2.0, elevando significativamente la calidad de la experiencia.

Requisitos

  • 6 -8 o más años de experiencia en diseño de producto, UX/UI o roles similares.
  • Práctica sólida en diseño centrado en el usuario incluyendo investigación, definición de flujos y validación.
  • Dominio de herramientas como Adobe Creative Suite y Figma.
  • Experiencia en fases de discovery: investigación de competidores, definición de modelos conceptuales y análisis de comportamiento de usuarios.

About the Team:

The AlphaSense Finance team is responsible for efficiently driving the creation of enterprise value by supporting capital allocation decisions across the business. We exist to help the company make intelligent, data-driven decisions through financial analysis, scenario modeling, tracking, interpreting and disseminating key performance indicators, and by serving as a critical thought partner to senior leadership.

About the Role:

We are seeking a Senior Accounting Manager to lead and develop the accounting team while owning the month-end close for operational expenses. Reporting to the Corporate Controller, this role partners closely with the broader accounting organization to ensure operating expenses are recorded accurately, on time, and in compliance with U.S. GAAP and internal policy.

This is a hands-on leadership role for a technically strong accountant who brings deep expertise in accrual accounting, prepaid assets, and fixed asset capitalization; and who can lead an AP team with clarity and motivate them to operate at a high standard. You will be the go-to expert for operational expense accounting, driving the close process while managing a team of direct reports and overseeing AP operations across our tech stack (NetSuite, Ramp, and Navan).

Who You Are:

  • 7+ years of progressive accounting experience; 2-3+ years in a people manager role, with experience managing individual contributors and a team lead or manager.
  • CPA required.
  • Deep U.S. GAAP expertise: accrual accounting, prepaid assets, fixed asset capitalization (ASC 360), and lease accounting (ASC 842).
  • Proficiency in NetSuite; experience with Ramp and/or Navan strongly preferred.
  • Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to communicate effectively with both internal and external stakeholders.
  • Public accounting and public company experience with SaaS or technology industry experience preferred.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Proven time management skills, demonstrates the ability to prioritize tasks and meet deadlines while leading a team.

What You’ll Do:

  • Support the month-end close process by managing detailed vendor expense analyses, accrual schedules, prepaids, fixed assets (ASC 360), and lease accounting under ASC 842, ensuring entries are prepared, reviewed, and posted timely.
  • Review balance account reconciliations and flux analyses
  • Partner with the Technical Accounting team to operationalize new accounting guidance and policies into the close process.
  • Lead and mentor direct reports setting clear expectations and to support professional growth.
  • Establish and maintain team workflows, desk procedures, and SLAs to drive consistency, accuracy, and timeliness.
  • Manage the end-to-end AP process: invoice intake and coding, purchase order matching, vendor onboarding, payment runs, and vendor statement reconciliations.
  • Oversee the corporate card program (Ramp) and corporate travel program (Navan), enforcing policy compliance, reviewing transactions, and serving as the escalation point for employee questions.
  • Maintain a strong controls environment over AP and the expense close, including SOX controls.
  • Serve as a power user for NetSuite, Ramp, and Navan; optimizing workflows, configuration and reporting across all three.
  • Support external audits and other operational requests.
  • Ensure compliance with company expense policies and support any tax-related AP requirements (e.g., 1099 preparation).

As the Sr. Motion Designer on the AlphaSense Brand & Creative team, you will be the bridge between high-end cinematic motion and the future of AI-driven production. You aren't just an animator; you are a creative architect. You’ll be responsible for defining & executing the visual language of our brand in motion—from product UI reveals to high-concept brand films—while simultaneously building the repeatable, AI-augmented workflows that allow our team to scale.

This role is equal parts "craft" and "innovation." You will spend your time in the timeline (After Effects, C4D) and in the laboratory (ComfyUI, RunWay, Midjourney), finding ways to marry traditional motion excellence with emerging generative tools. Your goal is to ensure AlphaSense doesn't just keep up with the pace of AI, but leads the industry in how it’s applied to world-class brand storytelling.

  • A Master of Motion: 8+ years of experience in motion graphics and animation, with a portfolio that shows a deep understanding of timing, physics, typography, and storytelling.
  • Product Animation Expert: Deep experience animating SaaS and complex UI systems — from feature reveals to full product narratives. You understand interaction design, states, transitions, and micro-interactions, and can make dense workflows feel intuitive, elegant, and alive.
  • Systems Thinker: You love the challenge of "how do we do this again, but faster?" You have experience building MOGRTs, scripts, or automated pipelines that empower other designers.
  • Technical Polyglot: You are an expert in After Effects and the Adobe Suite. Familiarity with 3D (C4D/Blender) and Houdini is a massive plus.
  • Product Design Fluency: Comfortable working in Figma and collaborating directly with Product Designers to translate complex UI into pixel-accurate marketing motion.
  • AI-Native: You don't just "know" AI exists; you are actively experimenting with tools like Stable Diffusion, ComfyUI, Runway Gen-3, or Luma. You understand how to use AI for rotoscoping, texture generation, style transfer, or frame interpolation.
  • Strategic Maker: You can take a complex abstract concept—like "market intelligence"—and turn it into a visual metaphor that is both beautiful and easy to understand.
  • Adaptive & Scrappy: You thrive in the "grey area" of emerging tech. You are comfortable with tools that might change or break every week and enjoy the process of troubleshooting.

  • Design & Animate: Create high-fidelity motion graphics for brand campaigns, product launches, social channels, and executive keynotes.
  • Architect Workflows: Design and implement repeatable animation systems that leverage AI to reduce manual "grunt work" (e.g., automated versioning, AI-assisted cleanup, or generative backgrounds).
  • Define the Motion Identity: Partner with Brand Leads to evolve the AlphaSense motion guidelines, ensuring a consistent "look and feel" across all global touchpoints.
  • R&D & Evangelism: Stay on the bleeding edge of creative technology. Regularly demo new tools and techniques to the broader creative team to uplevel our collective output.
  • Collaborate across Functions: Work closely with Product Designers, pulling directly from Figma files to translate software UI into beautiful, "pixel-perfect" marketing animations.
  • Scale through Systems: Build a library of motion assets and templates that allow for rapid iteration without sacrificing quality.
  • Develop Deep Product & Market Fluency: Gain a thorough understanding of the AlphaSense platform, our customers, and the broader B2B enterprise landscape to ensure motion work reflects real product value, use cases, and buyer context — not just surface-level aesthetics.

  • Retainer Services: In some cases, you'll collaborate closely with clients on an ongoing basis, serving as an extension of their team. Retainer work necessitates exceptional communication skills and the ability to foster strong relationships.
